zh: 放我出去！放我出去！
en: Let me out! Let me out!

zh: 我在這兒啊！放我出去哪！
en: I'm in here! Let me out!

zh: 誰在甕裡喊話？
en: Who's shouting from inside that urn?

zh: 這裡面好黑哪！嗚‧‧‧放我出去啊
放　　不放
en: It's so dark in here! Boo hoo... let me out!

zh: 咭咭咭！謝謝你們放了我啊！笨小子
en: Hee hee hee! Thanks for letting me out, you
little fools!

zh: 樓上傳來驚叫聲
en: A scream comes from upstairs.

zh: 臭小子！你們給我走著瞧！
en: Brats! You haven't seen the last of me!

zh: 啊？！你們快快離開那個甕！那妖女
專吃男人的心哪！
en: What?! Get away from that urn, quickly!
That witch feeds on men's hearts!

zh: 丘道人出関了，他在樓上等你們。
en: Taoist Qiu has come out of seclusion. He's
waiting for you upstairs.

zh: 有什麼事嗎？
en: What can I do for you?

zh: 無妄老人要我們來找你。他說你可以
為我們解決神池毒霧的問題。
en: Old Man Wuwang sent us to you. He said you
could help us with the poison mist over the
Sacred Pool.

zh: 嘖！那個老傢伙老是替我找麻煩！真
是氣煞人了！
en: Tch! That old coot is always making trouble
for me! It drives me mad!

zh: 你想知道什麼？
神池
毒霧
解決方式　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Sacred Pool
{>13}Poison mist
{>13}A way through{>169}Leave
Oh~ Is that so?...

zh: 你要不要給他東西呢？
好　　不好
en: Will you give him something?

zh: 開玩笑！你把我看成誰啦！
en: You must be joking! Who do you take me
for?!

zh: 你也把我看得忒小了吧！
en: You think that little of me, do you?

zh: 這種東西虧你也拿得出來！
en: You have the nerve to offer me this?!

zh: 謝了！這種東西您自己留著用吧！
en: Thanks, but you'd better keep that for
yourself!

zh: 嗯！這才合乎禮儀嘛！對了！你剛剛
問我什麼來著？
en: Mm! Now that's proper manners! Oh, right!
What was it you asked me just now?

zh: 其実神池本非如此的！但在十七年前
，突然被黑霧籠罩，再見不得天日了
！據說那裡有個宝貝，因為妖魔怕被
人奪走了，所以佈惡陣封住它！
en: The Sacred Pool wasn't always like this!
Seventeen years ago a black mist shrouded
it. They say a treasure lies there, sealed
by the demons with an evil array!

zh: 那裡黑霧終年不散，若是吸入太多，
就會全身發黑而亡！恐怖的是不只是
那霧有毒；魔鈴塔側的鈴聲，也會傷
人於無形！
en: The mist never clears. Breathe too much of
it and your whole body turns black and you
die! Worse, the bells of the Demon Bell Tower
can also harm you without a trace!

zh: 我這裡有些”辟邪丹”，在進入神池
之前，將它含在口中，則可以避免受
到毒霧之侵害！但是関於那魔鈴，我
就沒辦法了！
en: I have some Ward Pills. Hold one in your
mouth before you enter the Sacred Pool and
the mist can't harm you! But as for the
demon bells, there's nothing I can do!

zh: 還有什麼事？！東西都給你了，你還
要幹嘛！
en: What now?! I've already given you the
stuff. What else do you want?!

zh: 這個‧‧‧
你還有辟邪丹可以給我嗎？
你可以多告訴我們一點消息嗎？
嗯～哦～大家辛苦了　　　離開
en: Well...
{>13}Could you spare more Ward Pills?
{>13}Could you tell us a little more?
{>13}Uh... thanks for everything{>169}Leave

zh: 你以為我是做慈善事業的嗎？！要的
話，拿錢來吧！二百銖錢而已
買　　不買
en: Do I look like a charity?! If you want them,
pay up! Only 200 gold.

zh: 好吧，勉強賣了。這是你要的辟邪丹
en: Fine, I'll sell, reluctantly. Here are your
Ward Pills...

zh: 對不起！無可奉告！
en: Sorry! I have nothing to say!

zh: 你們小孩子怎麼亂摸別人的東西！如
果你們要的話，就得開個價吧！
en: Don't you kids go touching other people's
things! If you want it, name your price!

zh: 你們會發現這小東西挺管用的。
en: You'll find this little thing comes in handy.

zh: 算了！等你們有點兒誠意再來吧！
en: Forget it! Come back when you're serious!

zh: 怎樣？有東西來交換了嗎？
en: Well? Got something to trade yet?

zh: 喂！不要亂動！
en: Hey! Hands off!

zh: 得到辟邪丹
en: Received a Ward Pill.

zh: 得到辟邪丹
en: Received a Ward Pill.

zh: 錢不夠吧！那想都別想！
en: Not enough money? Then don't even think
about it!

zh: 當然是把辟邪丹含著啊！難不成得塞
在鼻孔才有用嗎？飯桶，還問同樣的
蠢問題！
en: You hold the Ward Pill in your mouth, of
course! Or did you think it goes up your
nose? Blockhead, asking the same dumb
question!

zh: 發現耳塞
en: Found the Earplugs.

zh: 那咱們就出‧‧‧
５０銖錢
７０銖錢
１００銖錢　　　　　　　不買了
en: Then we'll offer...
{>13}100 gold{>169}No deal

zh: 哇～您開的價碼可真高啊！‧‧‧‧
‧‧不賣！
en: Wow~ What a generous price!... ...Not selling!

zh: 這種宝貝，真的只值這一點錢嗎？既
然你都敢開出這種價碼，那我也只好
en: A treasure like this, worth only that much?
If you dare offer such a price, then I'll
just have to... not sell!

zh: 年輕人，口袋裏沒什麼錢就不要逞英
雄，漫天開價‧‧‧
en: Young man, if your pockets are empty,
don't play the hero and haggle like that...

zh: 我正想將不世絕學，傳給有理想有抱
負的年輕人，見你們資質不錯，可想
學學這驚世法術？
要　　不要
en: I seek ambitious youths to inherit my
peerless arts. You seem gifted. Care to
learn an astounding art?

zh: 好。不過在我傳各種法門之前，按照
古禮，你們必須奉上“束脩“，表示
尊重與誠意‧‧‧
en: Good. But before I teach any of my
methods, ancient custom demands you offer
a tuition gift, as a sign of respect and
sincerity...

zh: 好，那我們就出‧‧‧
４００銖錢
５００銖錢
６００銖錢　　　　　　　不學了
en: All right, we'll offer...
{>13}600 gold{>169}Forget it

zh: 什麼，只有４００銖錢，也好，那我
就傳給你們淺顯一點的“封剋術法“
它可以讓你們在對陣的時候，封住敵
人的術法，使他們無法施展。
en: What, only 400 gold? Very well, I'll teach
you the basic Sealing Art. In battle it seals
the enemy's arts so they can't use them.

zh: 不錯，你們還蠻有誠意的；那我就多
用點心，傳出本家千年絕學秘笈－－
“封剋術法“，這個術法，可以制住
敵人術法，進而制敵機先，獲得勝利
en: Not bad, you're sincere. Then I'll pass on
my family's thousand-year secret: the
Sealing Art! It binds the enemy's arts so
you strike first and win!

zh: 好極了，你們這樣有誠意，我也傾盡
所學，傳給你們超古代禁断的秘咒，
也是所有術法家夢寐以求，一輩子瘋
狂追求的秘策－－封剋術法。
en: Splendid! For such sincerity I'll give you all
I have: a forbidden spell from the dawn of
time, the secret every sorcerer chases all
his life: the Sealing Art!

zh: 傳說這封剋術法，乃超遠古時代，天
神將盤古封印在混沌宇宙中的“神之
術法“；後來盤古在混沌中悟出森羅
萬象的法則，才得以解開封印，進而
en: Legend says that in ancient times the gods
used the Sealing Art to bind Pangu in the
primal chaos. There Pangu grasped the laws
of all things, broke the seal and...

zh: 炸出“大霹雳“，劃開天與地的界線
造了現在的世界；而這“封印術法“
也就是盤古託女媧，要她傳給第一個
造出的“人“，也就是我的祖先‧‧
en: ...set off the Big Bang, splitting heaven
from earth. Pangu gave the Sealing Art to
Nuwa, to pass on to the first human she
made: my ancestor...

zh: 女媧並以先前隨手捏出的三種奇獸－
龍，駿，鰡為我祖先的姓名，也就因
為創世以來的第一人姓“龍“，所以
後世皆自稱為“龍的傳人“‧‧‧
en: Nuwa named my ancestor after three beasts
she had shaped, first the dragon, "Long". So
the first man was surnamed Long, and his
heirs are the heirs of the dragon...

zh: 這封印術法，既然可封住盤古，其威
力不容置疑，何況要封住一般妖魔人
類的術法‧‧‧雖然這些都是遠古先
人傳說，但絕對有其意義的！
en: A seal that could bind Pangu is mighty
beyond doubt, let alone one for the arts of
mere demons and men... These are ancient
legends, but they surely mean something!

zh: 不過，當今天地異變，妖魔横行，遠
古的術法，不知能否完全封住天地充
塞的邪氣‧‧‧真令人擔憂。
en: But now heaven and earth are in upheaval
and demons run rampant. Can the ancient
arts still seal off all the evil in the
world?... It truly worries me.

zh: 不要？！如果不是你現在數值剛好，
我洪明承還懶得傳你‧‧‧算了！一
切靜待有緣！
en: No?! If your stats weren't just right, I,
Hong Mingcheng, wouldn't bother teaching
you... Never mind! All in good time!

zh: 得到封剋術法
en: Learned the Sealing Art.

zh: 哎啊！你錢根本不夠嗎～年輕人，想
學愈高深的術法，一定得付出相對的
代價，這是天經地義的事！最好一次
就決定好你要學那一級！
en: Ah! You don't have enough money~ Young
man, the deeper the art, the higher the
price. That's the way of the world! Decide
on your level once and for all!

zh: 學會這一種就好了，何必太貪心呢？
en: Learning one is enough. Why be so greedy?

zh: 我有最好的防具－－魔衣術法，只要
你一施展，嘿！當場魔衣就把你給遮
起來，別人就看不到你，也打不到你
en: I have the best armor: the Demon Robe art!
Cast it and, hey! A demon robe covers you,
so no one can see you or hit you!

zh: 不過，你要知道，當你隱形起來之後
，你也不能打別人了，不然魔衣就會
消失了。怎麼樣？三百銖銅錢而已‧
‧‧　　　　　　　　買　　不買
en: But know this: while you're invisible you
can't attack either, or the robe vanishes.
How about it? Only 300 gold...

zh: 好好地善用身辺所有的防具武器，才
會發揮制敵先機的功用。
en: Make good use of all your armor and
weapons, and you'll gain the upper hand.

zh: 好了，東西是你的了‧‧‧
en: There, it's yours now...

zh: 不買也好，等到真正識貨的人，搞不
好可以有更好的價錢‧‧‧
en: Fine, don't buy it. Someone who knows its
worth may pay me better...

zh: 小兄弟，我看你錢不夠，下次再來吧
en: Little brother, you don't have enough
money. Come again next time!

zh: 嘿！小兄弟，有沒有什麼需要？
買賣
交談
其他　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Hey! Little brother, need anything?
{>13}Trade
{>13}Talk
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 觀迎光臨，休息只要１０銖錢，很便
宜的啦‧‧‧
要　　不要
en: Welcome! A rest is only 10 gold, very
cheap...

zh: 那你好好休息吧！但請不要打擾到其
他的客人。
en: Then have a good rest! But please don't
disturb the other guests.

zh: 好吧！那也不打緊。不過，看客官您
大概是從外地來的吧！還是充分地休
息一下比較好。
en: All right, no matter. But you look like
you've come from far away. You'd better
get a good rest!

zh: 啊！你錢不夠吧？！下次再來吧！
en: Ah! Not enough money?! Come again next
time!

zh: 你要知道：「魚是因為嘴被鉤住而死
；人類也是嘴發生問題！」所以絕對
不可不慎啊！
en: Remember: "A fish dies because its mouth
gets hooked, and so do people!" So always
mind your tongue!

zh: 你有沒有算過，如果少說話或閒扯淡
，我們一天會多出多少時間，而且會
少闖多少禍呢？
en: Ever counted how much time we'd save each
day if we talked less nonsense, and how
much less trouble we'd get into?

zh: 嘿！我這有個特別的東西，想不想看
看啊？
好　　不好
en: Hey! I've got something special here. Want a
look?

zh: 這就是了。
en: Here it is.

zh: 他拿出了一本「断門槍譜」
en: He takes out a manual: "Gatesplit Spear".

zh: 怎樣，有沒有興趣？我可以二百銖賣
給你。
好　　不好
en: Well, interested? I'll sell it to you for 200
gold.

zh: ‧‧‧如果任何人問你槍譜從那兒來
的，你千萬不要說是我賣給你的啊！
en: ...If anyone asks where you got this
manual, don't you dare say I sold it to
you!

zh: 那就算了。
en: Never mind, then.

zh: 嘿，你有什麼事嗎？
en: Hey, what do you want?

zh: ‧‧‧嗯‧‧‧你剛剛說有什麼東西
en: ...Um... Did you say you had something to sell
just now?...

zh: 啊？你不要誣賴我啊！我那有什麼東
西要賣！
en: What? Don't slander me! What would I have
to sell?!

zh: 錢不夠？那算了吧！
en: Not enough money? Forget it, then!

zh: 來這兒的感覺真好；清靜的生活，可
以讓我舒坦。但是我目前還不考慮出
家修行。
en: It feels good here. A quiet life puts me at
ease. But I'm not thinking of becoming a
monk just yet.

zh: 得到護身咒法
en: Learned the Ward Song.

zh: 得到大還丹
en: Received an Elixir.

zh: 請問有什麼事嗎？
en: May I help you?

zh: 我是來找丘道人的。
en: I've come to see Taoist Qiu.

zh: 很抱歉，丘道人正在閉関。麻煩你等
等。丘道人應該快出関了。
en: I'm sorry, Taoist Qiu is in secluded
meditation. Please wait a while. He should
come out soon.

zh: 我們這兒荷花很有名，您參觀過嗎？
en: Our lotus flowers are famous here. Have
you seen them?

zh: 本人閉関，諸親友請勿打擾
en: In seclusion. Friends, please do not disturb.

zh: 丘道人！你還好嗎？
en: Taoist Qiu! Are you all right?

zh: 那個妖女怎麼會出來的？
en: How did that witch get out?

zh: ‧‧‧對不起‧‧‧我們不知道‧‧
en: ...I'm sorry... We didn't know...

zh: 不知道？！「不知道」害死多少人你
知不知道？‧‧‧咳‧‧‧
en: Didn't know?! Do you know how many people
"didn't know" has killed?!... *cough*...

zh: 現在怎麼辦呢？
en: What do we do now?

zh: 我被那妖女暗算，傷得很重，除非有
神池的「復活草」，否則‧‧‧
en: That witch caught me off guard. I'm badly
hurt. Unless I get the Life Herb from the
Sacred Pool...

zh: 他昏過去了。
en: He's passed out.

zh: 你來了。
en: So you've come.

zh: 你知道我們會來？
en: You knew we'd come?

zh: 是的。但你來得比我想像中要晚得多
了。
en: Yes. But you came much later than I
expected.
...You are...

zh: 我是沈皓，我父親是沈君平‧‧‧‧‧‧
en: I'm Shen Hao. My father is Shen Junping......

zh: 請稍等一下，讓老夫起個身子。
en: One moment. Let this old man sit up.

zh: 好的。
en: Of course.

zh: 你可真會給我惹麻煩！有話就說吧！
en: You really do bring me trouble! Say what
you came to say!

zh: 我父親已經過逝了，他臨終遺言要我
來找你。
en: My father has passed away. His dying wish
was for me to find you.

zh: 這事我已知道。他留了件東西在我這
兒。
en: I know of it already. He left something with
me.

zh: 據說這関係到另一把神兵利器的秘密
en: They say it concerns the secret of another
divine weapon.

zh: 你想知道什麼呢？
神兵利器
父親的死
山魅　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What would you like to know?
{>13}Divine weapons
{>13}Father's death
{>13}Hill Wraith{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道関於‧‧‧
生銹的天劍
月刀
離開
en: What about...
{>13}The rusted Sky Sword
{>13}The Moon Blade
{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道関於月刀‧‧‧
月刀所在
壁飾碎片
離開
en: About the Moon Blade...
{>13}Where it is
{>13}The mural shard
{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道関於‧‧‧
三大術法
何處獲得
離開
en: What about...
{>13}The three great arts
{>13}Where to learn them
{>169}Leave

zh: 據說天劍和月刀是採集非人間之物的
”天鉄”及”天銅”所鑄成的神兵利
器。並傳言當二械合使的時候，其力
能劈日月，裂天地！
en: The Sky Sword and Moon Blade were forged
from unearthly "sky iron" and "sky bronze".
Wielded together, they can split the sun and
moon, heaven and earth!

zh: 我並不知道你父親為誰所殺。但那日
他交給我這東西時，曾提過要去追查
宝珠的下落‧‧‧其他的我就不清楚
了。
en: I don't know who killed your father. But the
day he gave me this, he said he was going to
trace the jewels... I know nothing more.

zh: ‧‧‧傻小子，想報仇啊？以你的実
力，我看你是甭想了。‧‧‧除非你
能學到三大術法其中之一，或許還能
跟他拚上一拚！
en: ...Silly boy, you want revenge? With your
skill, forget it... Unless you learn one of
the three great arts. Then you might stand
a chance against him!

zh: 天劍被山魅施法給禁錮住了，威力大
減；唯一之計也只有先找到月刀了！
en: The Hill Wraith put a curse on the Sky
Sword and weakened it. Our only hope is to
find the Moon Blade first!

zh: 據說月刀是把金色的刀戈。聽說當天
劍和月刀相會，會產生一種共振，就
像陰陽相吸一般！
en: They say the Moon Blade is a golden blade.
When the Sky Sword and Moon Blade meet,
they resonate, drawn together like yin and
yang!

zh: 「水中之刀，月中之燄」，這是形容
月刀所在位置，但你父親窮其一生都
參不透它到底所言何處。
en: "A blade in the water, a flame in the moon."
That describes where the Moon Blade lies,
but your father never worked out what it
meant.

zh: 有人說月刀是深深的埋在一座湖底的
聖城裡‧‧‧但從沒人知道它到底在
那裡‧‧‧
en: Some say the Moon Blade is buried deep in a
holy city at the bottom of a lake... but no
one has ever known where.

zh: 據說這塊壁飾碎片関係著月刀所在的
秘密。但到底如何，也沒人能說出個
所以然來。唉！想當初如果你爹娘找
得到月刀的話，也就不必怕山魅了！
en: This mural shard is said to hold the secret
of the Moon Blade, but no one can read it.
Sigh! Had your parents found the blade,
they'd not have feared the Hill Wraith!

zh: 所謂的三大術法，即分別是”天絕陣
”，”地烈陣”以及”寒冰陣”三大
陣術！
en: The three great arts are three formations:
the Sky Array, the Rock Array and the Ice
Array!

zh: 這一切就看你這小子的機緣了！
en: It all depends on your fate, boy!

zh: 你們要離開時，記得來我這兒一趟！
en: When you leave, be sure to come see me!

zh: 你這麼小，就要對抗自己的命運‧‧‧
記得啊！跌倒了再爬起來就對了！
en: So young, and already fighting your own
fate... Remember! When you fall, just get
back up!

zh: 這十幾年來，山魅的勢力越來越大，
甚至敢跟魔王作對！你要找他很簡單
，只要循著這個標誌，就可以知道他
的行蹤。
en: For over ten years the Hill Wraith has
grown stronger, even daring to defy the
Demon King! Finding him is easy: just follow
this mark and you'll track him down.

zh: 我了解你要復仇之心，但要記得，不
要被仇恨遮蔽了你的心啊！
en: I understand your wish for revenge, but
remember: don't let hatred blind your heart!

zh: 此去恐怕越來越艱難，這些東西你們
就帶在身上吧。
en: The road ahead will only get harder. Take
these things with you.

zh: 如果沒事，你們就早點動身吧。時間
不多了！
en: If there's nothing else, set off soon. Time is
short!

zh: 記得啊！善惡一念間啊！
en: Remember! Good and evil are but one
thought apart!

zh: 孩子，你需不需要我的加入呢？
要　　不要
en: Child, do you need me to join you?

zh: 就讓我這老骨頭再為故人之子盡點力
吧！我們出發吧。
en: Then let these old bones do a little more for
my old friend's son! Let's go.

zh: 這樣也好。我這老骨頭也不中用了！
en: That's fine too. These old bones aren't
much use anymore!

zh: 得到一片壁飾碎片
en: Received a mural shard.

zh: 使用復活草
en: Used the Life Herb.

zh: 你是誰？
en: Who are you?

zh: 我‧‧‧我叫沈皓。
en: I... I'm Shen Hao.

zh: 算了，一切皆是命；這是你父親要我
親手交給你的‧‧‧
en: Never mind, it's all fate. Your father asked
me to give this to you in person...

zh: 荷葉坪少有外地人來呢，你們來這兒
有何貴幹呢？
發問　離開
en: Outsiders rarely come to Heyeping. What
brings you here?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你說吧。
荷葉坪
丘道人
神池　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Go ahead.
{>13}Heyeping
{>13}Taoist Qiu
{>13}Sacred Pool{>169}Leave

zh: 我們這兒全是修行者，有的念佛，有
的煉丹，有的拜阿拉，有的信基督‧
‧‧應有盡有。所以外辺人又稱我們
為”世界大同村”。
en: Everyone here pursues a path: some chant
to Buddha, some brew elixirs, some pray to
Allah, some follow Christ... So outsiders call
us "World Harmony Village".

zh: 他就住在荷葉池上辺，紅門的那棟。
但你來得不巧。他正在閉関。
en: He lives up by the lotus pond, in the house
with the red door. But your timing is bad:
he's in seclusion.

zh: 你問那兒幹嘛？那兒是黑色區域，碰
不得的！沒有人能從那兒生還回來的
en: Why do you ask about that? It's in the
Black Zone. Don't go near it! No one has
ever come back alive!

zh: 這兒的人不喜歡人太多話，知道嗎？
en: People here don't like chatterboxes, got it?

zh: 修行，不是修外在，内在的才重要啊
en: Cultivation isn't about the outside. It's
what's inside that matters!

zh: 其実所有的事情還不都是自己的一顆
心在作祟！正所謂的「魔由心生」啊
en: In truth, everything comes down to your
own heart! As they say, "Demons are born
of the mind!"

zh: 你說吧。
荷葉坪
丘道人
神池　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Go ahead.
{>13}Heyeping
{>13}Taoist Qiu
{>13}Sacred Pool{>169}Leave

zh: 這道士村已有五百年的歷史了，如果
你小子有緣的話，或許還可以學到些
不傳之秘呢！
en: This Taoist village is five hundred years old.
If fate smiles on you, boy, you might even
learn some secret arts!

zh: 你可能見不到他。他好像在閉関。
en: You probably can't see him. I think he's in
seclusion.

zh: 神池本是通往隔壁島一條重要之路，
現在終年受黑毒霧所籠罩，根本沒人
敢去了！
en: The Sacred Pool was once the main road to
the next island. Now black poison mist
covers it all year, and no one dares go
there!

zh: 你若要通過神池，得先解決毒霧問題
！関於這點，或許可以去找藍道人幫
忙。他就住在村南那辺，去的時候，
帶點禮物吧，那傢伙最貪了！
en: To cross the Sacred Pool you must deal with
the mist first! Taoist Lan may help. He lives
in the south of the village. Bring a gift,
he's the greediest man alive!

zh: 過了荷葉坪之後就是所謂的黑色區域
。‧‧據說現在許多沉睡多年的妖魔
們均漸漸的甦醒，是為了要迎接傳說
中「邪惡之子」的登基大典。
en: Past Heyeping lies the Black Zone... They
say demons long asleep are waking, to greet
the coronation of the legendary "Son of
Evil".

zh: 有什麼問題呢？
黑色區域
邪惡之子
登基大典　　　　　　　　離開
en: What's your question?
{>13}The Black Zone
{>13}The Son of Evil
{>13}The coronation{>169}Leave

zh: 人有人界，妖有妖界。而所謂的黑色
區域，就是妖魔所佔據之所，人類是
去不得的！
en: Men have their world, demons theirs. The
Black Zone is the land the demons hold.
Humans can't go there!

zh: 古籍”地冥錄”曾有段預言：「當天
地變色、陰陽顛倒之際，將有邪惡之
子挾帶烈燄而生，席捲世間、毀滅萬
en: The old "Records of the Underworld" say:
"When the skies change and yin and yang
reverse, a Son of Evil shall be born in
flames to sweep away all things!"...

zh: 看來真像是描述世界末日，不是嗎？
en: Sounds just like the end of the world,
doesn't it?

zh: 當五種顛倒的天象顯現後，據說魔界
將舉辦盛大的慶典，慶祝邪惡之子之
降世！到那時，就是魔界統治萬物的
時候了！
en: They say that when five reversed omens
appear in the sky, the demon world will hold
a great festival for the Son of Evil's
coming. Then the demons will rule all things!

zh: 我在想，難道沒有挽救的方式嗎？‧
‧‧但似乎墮落的力量太強了‧‧‧
人們總是以為我在危言聳聽！
en: I wonder, is there no way to stop it?... But
the forces of darkness seem too strong...
And people always think I'm fearmongering!

zh: 人們常說拿出証據來，他們才相信！
難道說不信地獄的人，就也一定要真
去見到地獄了，才肯相信嗎？
en: People always say, "Show us proof and we'll
believe!" Must those who doubt hell really go
see it before they'll believe?

zh: 不要吵，我正在想一些你現在想要問
的問題呢！
en: Quiet, I'm thinking about the very questions
you want to ask!

zh: 最近大家都在談論”邪惡之子“的事
。有人說是世界末日來臨，有人說是
廣告噱頭，還甚至有人說這個什麼之
子的是”人妖魔合體”？！真是科幻
en: Everyone's talking about this "Son of Evil".
Some say the world is ending, some say it's
an ad gimmick, some even say this son is a
"human-demon hybrid"?! Someone's read

zh: 小說看太多了！咖咖！笑死人了！‧
en: too much sci-fi! Ha ha! What a joke!...

zh: 你說吧。
邪惡之子
人妖魔合體
神池　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Go ahead.
{>13}The Son of Evil
{>13}Human-demon hybrid
{>13}Sacred Pool{>169}Leave

zh: 如果你問我，我會說我根本不相信這
回事。血流星與日月並明，我看只是
天氣變化所產生的視覺錯亂！偏偏有
人拿它大作文章！
en: If you ask me, I don't believe a word of it.
A blood-red meteor shining with the sun and
moon? Just an illusion from the weather!
Yet people make such a fuss over it!

zh: 有人說邪惡之子是人與妖所生，而他
又把靈魂賣給魔界換取榮華富貴！所
以成為人妖魔合體，同時擁有三界的
力量！‧‧‧我看那些人真該去寫科
en: Some say the Son of Evil was born of man
and demon, and sold his soul to the demons
for power! So he holds the might of all three
realms!... Those people should

zh: 幻小說，真會瞎掰！
en: write sci-fi. What nonsense!

zh: 那兒可不是開玩笑的！黑霧終年不散
，而且霧中有毒，吸入者不死也去半
條命！
en: That place is no joke! The black mist never
clears, and it's poisonous. Breathe it in,
and if it doesn't kill you, it'll half kill you!

zh: 人類說話常常不算數的，真真假假，
「鵝毛變吐血」的事天天發生，所以
凡事也甭太當真了！
en: People seldom keep their word. Truth and
lies, rumors blown out of all proportion
every day... so don't take anything too
seriously!

zh: 真希望能發明能讓人「廢話少說」的
藥！
en: I wish someone would invent a pill that
makes people talk less nonsense!

zh: 你摸到一個油布包
en: You feel an oilcloth bundle.

zh: 要不要打開來看看呢？
要　　不要
en: Should we open it and look?

zh: 忽然有毒氣噴出
en: Poison gas suddenly sprays out!

zh: 也好，免得惹些麻煩上身！丟掉吧！
en: Just as well. Let's not ask for trouble!
Throw it away!

zh: 方天弓中毒
en: Fang Tiangong is poisoned.

zh: 芙蓉中毒
en: Furong is poisoned.

zh: 彩衣女中毒
en: Caiyi is poisoned.

zh: 洪元通中毒
en: Hong Yuantong is poisoned.

zh: 丘道人中毒
en: Taoist Qiu is poisoned.

zh: 呼爾穆珠中毒
en: Hurmuzhu is poisoned.

zh: 無名中毒
en: Wuming is poisoned.

zh: 沈皓中毒
en: Shen Hao is poisoned.

zh: 丘道人不是要我們在離開前，再前往
他那兒走一趙嗎？
en: Didn't Taoist Qiu ask us to stop by before
we leave?

zh: 喂！我們還沒找到丘道人咧！
en: Hey! We still haven't found Taoist Qiu!

zh: 老僧雲遊四海去也，歸期不知
en: This old monk has gone wandering. Return
date unknown.

zh: 反正時間不趕，再到處看看吧！
en: We're in no hurry. Let's look around some
more!

zh: 神池魔鈴還不知如何解決，再到處看
看怎麼解決吧！
en: We still don't know how to deal with the bells
at the Sacred Pool. Let's look around for a
way!

zh: 這裡是清靜的修行村落，日後，如果
你覺得心裡煩悶或不安，儘可回來；
一定可以讓你獲得平靜。
en: This is a quiet village for cultivation. If
someday you feel troubled or uneasy, come
back. You're sure to find peace here.

zh: 唉‧‧‧為什麼我喜歡的人不喜歡我
？為什麼我想要的東西要不到手？‧
‧‧難道我命裡就是那麼悲哀？還是
老天爺真的愛開那種惡意的玩笑？
en: Sigh... Why doesn't the one I love love me?
Why can't I get what I want?... Am I fated
to be this sad? Or does heaven just love
cruel jokes?

zh: 什麼事，小夥子？
十里舖
荷葉坪
丘道人　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What is it, lad?
{>13}Shilipu
{>13}Heyeping
{>13}Taoist Qiu{>169}Leave

zh: 什麼事，小夥子？
十里舖
荷葉坪
洪元通　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What is it, lad?
{>13}Shilipu
{>13}Heyeping
{>13}Hong Yuantong{>169}Leave

zh: 這地方還不就這樣子嗎？我看它一千
年以後還是這付德性！
en: This place is what it is. A thousand years
from now it'll still look just the same!

zh: 那地方你可別去！那兒都是群想不開
的人！人生在世活得已經夠苦了，他
們還堅持什麼"修行"的，動不動就不
吃不睡，簡直是自我虐待嘛！
en: Don't you go there! It's full of people who
can't let go! Life is hard enough, yet they
insist on "cultivation", fasting and going
without sleep. It's self-torture!

zh: 你說誰啊？我不認識啊！
en: Who? Never heard of him!

zh: 喂！你相信"宿命難違"這句話嗎？
en: Hey! Do you believe "there's no escaping
fate"?

zh: 唉‧‧‧人生在世，半點不由人啊！
en: Sigh... In this life, nothing goes the way you
want!

zh: 我這裏剛好有一本“天眼通“，讓你
們一眼看穿對方虛実！３００銖銅錢
怎麼樣，有沒有興趣啊！
要　　不要
en: I happen to have a "Third Eye" manual here.
See through any foe at a glance! 300 gold,
interested?

zh: 成交，你們拿回去練吧！
en: Deal! Take it home and practice!

zh: 千载難逢的機會，你們竟然拒之千里
？真是各種人都有哪‧‧‧
en: The chance of a lifetime, and you turn it
down? Takes all kinds...

zh: 沈兄今天來有何貴幹嗎？
en: What brings you here today, Brother Shen?

zh: 沈兄到底有什麼事呢？
en: What is it you need, Brother Shen?

zh: 沒什麼事，過來看看而已。
你還願意參加我的隊伍嗎？
你還有什麼消息可以告訴我嗎？
en: {>13}Nothing, just dropping by.
{>13}Will you join my party again?
{>13}Do you have any news for me?

zh: 當然了。我們馬上動身吧！
en: Of course. Let's go at once!

zh: ‧‧‧對不起，現在臨時想不起來。
en: ...Sorry, nothing comes to mind right now.

zh: 錢不夠？！那下次再說吧。
en: Not enough money?! Next time, then.

zh: 請問‧‧‧
en: Excuse me...

zh: 請什麼請？問什麼問？你煩不煩啊！
沒事不要在這兒吵！
en: Excuse what? What do you want? Don't you
ever stop pestering?! If it's nothing, don't
make a racket here!

zh: 這先生脾氣還真大啊。
en: This gentleman sure has a temper.

zh: 聽說你在找人為你辦件事。
en: We hear you're looking for someone to do a
job.

zh: 就你們這幾個無毛奶娃啊！我先警告
你們！已經有十個人失敗了，當然他
們也沒活著回來！不過，看你們也挺
有心的，也許會成功也說不定！
en: You hairless babes? I'm warning you! Ten
people have already failed, and none came
back alive! But you look keen, so maybe
you'll succeed!

zh: 這件事情說起來很簡單，只要你們去
北辺的神池，為我拿到一個銅製的小
盒子就可以了。要如何找到這個銅盒
，這張紙條上有很清楚的指示‧‧‧
en: It's simple: go to the Sacred Pool in the
north and bring me a small copper box. This
note says clearly how to find it...

zh: 完成任務後，我當重重酬謝你們。
en: Do the job and I'll reward you handsomely.

zh: 對了！拿到銅盒後，你們千萬不可以
打開它！要趕緊交給我！知道嗎？
en: Oh, and once you have the box, you must
not open it! Bring it straight to me!
Understood?

zh: 要去神池，有兩件麻煩的問題：一是
會奪人魂魄的鈴聲，另一則是毒霧。
関於那魔鈴的事，據我知道只要除去
塔第三層的那個魔鈴母，就可以停止
en: The Sacred Pool has two dangers:
soul-stealing bells and the poison mist. I
hear that destroying the Mother Bell on the
tower's third floor will stop

zh: 魔鈴的催魂聲！但是你們必須在自己
氣力耗竭之前，把它打倒，否則下場
就難看了‧‧‧至於関於毒霧的事，
你們可以前往荷葉坪，找位藍道人。
en: their deadly toll! But you must beat it
before your strength runs out, or it'll end
badly... As for the mist, go to Heyeping and
find Taoist Lan.

zh: 還不快去！還囉嗦什麼？
en: Well, get going! Why are you still dawdling?

zh: 不要就走開！不要浪費我的時間！
en: If you don't want it, go away! Don't waste
my time!

zh: 幹嘛？你們又要去了嗎？
要　　不要
en: What? You're going again?

zh: 你們沒有完成我們的承諾，回來幹嘛
呢？
en: You haven't kept your promise. Why come
back?

zh: 你們回來啦！
en: You're back!

zh: 給予老者小銅盒
en: Gave the old man the Copper Box.

zh: 太好了！為了酬謝你們，這是可辟百
邪，解百毒的「藥王咒」，只要依此
多修練，將可不再懼怕任何毒物！
en: Wonderful! As a reward, here is the "Heal
Song", which wards off evil and cures all
poisons. Practice it and you'll never fear
poison again!

zh: 你知道嗎？還好你們沒打開！據說這
這盒子裝著的是「惡運」的詛咒！凡
是打開它的，都會遭到不幸的事件！
en: Lucky you didn't open it! They say this box
holds the curse called "Ill Fate"! Whoever
opens it meets with misfortune!

zh: 我要好好的研究研究！
en: I must study this carefully!

zh: 你們回來啦！‧‧‧啊！你們已經打
開那盒子了！
en: You're back!... Ah! You've opened the box!

zh: 你怎麼知道？！
en: How did you know?!

zh: 你們臉色黑氣衝天，誰會不知道呢！
你們為何不聽話呢？那盒子裡裝著的
是人稱「惡運」的詛咒！據說凡是打
開它的，都會遭到不幸的事件！
en: Your faces are black with ill omen. Who
wouldn't know? Why didn't you listen? That
box holds the curse called "Ill Fate"!
Whoever opens it meets with misfortune!

zh: 那我們怎麼辦？
en: Then what do we do?

zh: ‧‧‧唉‧‧‧我也沒辦法啊！誰叫
你們太貪心了呢！
en: ...Sigh... There's nothing I can do! You were
too greedy!

zh: 你們自求多福吧！我也沒辦法啊。
en: You're on your own. There's nothing I can
do.

zh: 多做點好事吧，或許可以化解災難！
en: Do some good deeds. Perhaps that will ward
off disaster!

zh: 得到紙條
en: Received a Note.

zh: 謝謝前輩給我們這個機會！
en: Thank you, sir, for giving us this chance!

zh: 得到藥王咒
en: Learned the Heal Song.

zh: 小子！你想占占運氣嗎？只要５０
銖銅錢就好了。
要　　不要
en: Boy! Want your fortune told? Only 50 gold.

zh: ‧‧‧奇怪啊‧‧‧似乎兩股善惡的
力量在爭鬥不休著‧‧我從來沒見過
這麼複雜的命‧‧‧
en: ...Strange... Two forces, good and evil, are
locked in an endless struggle... I've never
seen such a tangled fate...

zh: 不過還好，現在似乎善的這辺稍佔上
風。不過‧‧‧可不能大意啊！小子
！若稍一閃神，則你將墮入萬劫不復
的深淵啊！
en: Luckily, good seems to have the upper hand
for now. But... don't let your guard down,
boy! One lapse, and you'll fall into an
abyss with no return!

zh: 人生的禍福，往往都是在心念一瞬間
決定的！切記啊！
en: Fortune and disaster are often decided in a
single thought! Never forget it!

zh: ‧‧‧唉‧‧‧孩子，不要被惡念所
縛啊！我看見你漸漸的被黑雲所覆啊
！‧‧‧一定要掙脫命運的束縛啊！
en: ...Sigh... Child, don't let evil thoughts bind
you! I see black clouds slowly covering
you!... You must break free of your fate!...

zh: 說命還需運，定業未嘗不可轉！命運
，就看你用何心態去面對了！強者造
命，弱者被命所造！
en: Fate needs luck, and even karma can
change! It all depends on how you face it!
The strong make their fate; the weak are
made by it!

zh: 總而言之一句話：「纏脫只在自心」
，就看你怎麼去面對了！
en: In short: "Bound or free, it's all in your
own heart." It depends on how you face it!

zh: 沒関係‧‧‧你想算時再來好了
en: That's all right... Come back when you want
a reading.

zh: 我一算就知道你錢不夠，下次再來好
了。
en: I can tell at a glance you're short of
money. Come again next time.

zh: 也是有緣，你就把它拿去吧。
en: It must be fate. Take it.

zh: 嘿！住宿只要３０銖錢，休息一下吧
休息　不休息
en: Hey! A room is only 30 gold. Have a rest!

zh: 錢不夠？錢不夠還敢來啊！
en: No money? And you dare come here without
it?!

zh: ‧‧‧我‧‧‧我突然覺得全身好冷
en: ...I... I suddenly feel so cold all over.

zh: 沈皓！你怎麼了？
en: Shen Hao! What's wrong?

zh: 沈大哥！你的臉好恐怖啊‧‧‧
en: Brother Shen! Your face looks so scary...

zh: 邪惡的因子已經漸漸的侵入他的心！
我們要儘快找到其他摩尼宝珠！
en: Evil is slowly seeping into his heart! We must
find the other Mani Jewels quickly!

zh: 有什麼事呢？
買賣
談話
離開
en: What can I do for you?
{>13}Trade
{>13}Talk
{>13}Leave

zh: 你想問什麼，說吧‧‧‧
十里舖
再往前去
其他　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to ask? Go on...
{>13}Shilipu
{>13}Further ahead
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 你問到這點，我正想告訴你！我想，
這個機會或許你們可以試試看！
en: Funny you should ask, I was about to tell
you! I think you might want to try this
opportunity!

zh: 我們鎮上有位高人，人稱「無妄老人
」，文武醫術樣樣精通，就是個性孤
僻了些！前陣子他聲稱，若有人能幫
他辦成一件事，他就傳他一樣法宝！
en: A master in our town, "Old Man Wuwang",
knows letters, arms and medicine, though
he's a loner! He says whoever does a job
for him will get a magic treasure!

zh: 但是到現在還沒人成功過！你要不要
試試啊？
en: But no one has managed it yet! Want to
give it a try?

zh: 你考慮看看吧，無妄老人就住在鎮的
西辺，防具店的隔壁！
en: Think it over. Old Man Wuwang lives on the
west side of town, next to the armor shop!

zh: 從沒有人敢去那兒的！據說那兒有奪
人魂魄的鈴聲！小兄弟！你可千萬別
去那兒！
en: No one dares go there! They say bells there
steal your soul! Little brother, don't you
ever go there!

zh: 再往北就是荷葉坪了，那也叫做道士
村。去那兒凡事要小心，不要亂說話
，否則惹惱了人，隨便做個法，讓你
吃不完兜著走！
en: North of here is Heyeping, also called the
Taoist Village. Be careful there and mind
your tongue. Anger someone and they'll
cast a spell that you'll regret!

zh: 嘿！我們以前在清江城見過面！
en: Hey! We met before in Qingjiang City!

zh: 你們真的答應無妄老人的任務？我雖
然不是很清楚那是怎樣一件事，但是
該是滿刺激的！不是嗎？先預祝你們
成功！
en: You really took Old Man Wuwang's job? I'm
not sure what it involves, but it must be
pretty exciting, right? Good luck to you!

zh: 這樣吧，要遠途歷險，還是多準備些
藥物，以備不時之需，我就送些藥物
給你們吧！
en: Tell you what: for a long, risky journey
you'll want plenty of medicine, just in case.
Let me give you some!

zh: 得到當歸
en: Received Angelica.

zh: 得到黃蓮
en: Received Goldthread.

zh: 早點啟程吧！
en: Set off early!

zh: 想不到你們竟然真的成功了，有空到
十里舖來玩！
en: I can't believe you actually did it! Come
visit Shilipu when you have time!

zh: 看到櫃内一本斧譜
en: You see an axe manual in the cabinet.

zh: 怎麼？對這個有興趣嗎？....嗯，看
你們也是練家子。如果想要的話，意
思意思，120銖銅錢賣給你們好了！
要　　不要
en: What? Interested in this?... Hmm, you look
like fighters. If you want it, I'll let you
have it for a token 120 gold!

zh: 好，這是你的了！
en: Good, it's yours!

zh: 沒関係，有緣再說。
en: No matter. Maybe another time.

zh: 我跟蹤你很久了。我知道関於你的事
，且希望能幫助你。
en: I've been following you for a long time. I
know about you, and I want to help.

zh: 有什麼問題，你問吧‧‧‧
你是‧‧
為何跟蹤
為何幫助
en: Ask whatever you like...
{>13}Who are you?
{>13}Why follow me?
{>13}Why help me?

zh: 我叫洪元通。早在三年前，有位高人
要我今日在此處等一位叫做沈皓的年
輕人，他說：若你我結為夥伴，將可
共創出一番事業！
en: My name is Hong Yuantong. Three years ago
a master told me to wait here today for a
young man named Shen Hao. He said that
together we'd achieve great things!

zh: 我想確定你是否是沈皓。因為最近江
湖上盛傳你的事躋，甚至有人冒你的
名字做起廣告來了！
en: I wanted to be sure you were Shen Hao.
Stories of your deeds are all over the land.
Someone's even using your name in
advertisements!

zh: 你說什麼？我被仿冒了？！
en: What? Someone's copying me?!

zh: 是的。自從你在清江城打敗妖僧，水
城誅殺蜘蛛精之後，你已名揚千里；
而且大家也在猜測，你到底是不是傳
說中的邪惡之子。
en: Yes. Since you beat the demon monk in
Qingjiang and slew the spider fiend in Water
City, you're famous. People even wonder if
you're the legendary Son of Evil.

zh: 你從來都沒想過，自己到底擁有什麼
樣的力量吧！我倒想跟那「命中註定
」四個字賭一賭！我才不信"宿命"那
一套呢！
en: You've never thought about what power you
really hold, have you? I'd like to take a bet
against "destiny"! I don't believe in all that
"fate" stuff!

zh: 你願意讓我加入嗎？
好　　不好
en: Will you let me join you?

zh: 太好了！傳說在不遠的神池的黑水池
裡，有顆摩尼宝珠。時間不多了，讓
我們趕緊出發吧！
en: Wonderful! Legend says a Mani Jewel lies in
the black pool of the nearby Sacred Pool.
Time is short, let's go at once!

zh: ‧‧‧唉，既然如此我也不勉強‧‧
‧離這不遠的神池，終年黑霧繚繞，
妖物非常厲害！但是在黑水池下，埋
著一顆摩尼宝珠‧‧‧
en: ...Sigh, then I won't force you... The Sacred
Pool nearby is shrouded in black mist and
full of fierce monsters! But beneath the
black pool lies a Mani Jewel...

zh: 你們此去取宝珠，一定要非常小心。
en: Be very careful when you go for the jewel.

zh: 你們一切小心了！我就住在鎮上的客
棧，如果有什麼問題，歡迎隨時來找
我。
en: Take care, all of you! I'm staying at the
inn in town. If you have any questions,
come find me anytime.

zh: 有些事情還不知曉，是否該進一步查
清楚再走‧‧‧
en: There are still things we don't know.
Shouldn't we look into them before we go...

zh: 救命啊！
en: Help!

zh: 有人喊救命！
en: Someone's calling for help!

zh: 閒事少管吧！誰知道那是不是陷阱！
管　　不管
en: Mind your own business! Who knows if it's a
trap!
{>130}Help{>169}Ignore

zh: 救命啊！有妖怪！
en: Help! Monsters!

zh: 咦？剛剛那個人呢？
en: Huh? Where did that man go?

zh: 早跑掉啦！
en: He ran off ages ago!

zh: 啊？！我們幫他打得死去活來，他竟
然連聲謝謝都沒有？！
en: What?! We fought half to death for him, and
he didn't even say thanks?!

zh: 算了！算了！反正我們本來也不是為
了那句謝謝而救他的，不是嗎？
en: Forget it! Forget it! We didn't save him for
a thank-you anyway, did we?

zh: 話是沒錯！但心裡就是不對勁。
en: True! But it still doesn't feel right.

zh: 你真的需要鑰匙Ｊ
en: You really need Key J.

zh: 牆上有個圓圓的凹洞
en: There's a round hollow in the wall.

zh: 我們沒有適當的宝物鑲崁於此凹槽！
en: We have no treasure that fits this hollow!

zh: 你要鑲崁上水晶球嗎？
要　　不要
en: Set the Crystal in it?

zh: 是誰召喚知曉未來的六鼻鏡？
我能回答你一個問題。只有一個。
en: Who summons the Six-Nosed Mirror that
knows the future?
I can answer one question. Only one.

zh: 你要問‧‧‧
我真的是邪惡之子嗎？
其他摩尼宝珠的位置？
請給我未來的指引吧！
en: You ask...
{>13}Am I really the Son of Evil?
{>13}Where are the other jewels?
{>13}Guide me to the future!

zh: 是的。
en: Yes.

zh: 其中一顆在我前面的宝箱中。其他分
在神池、鉄辺城、青銅峽，白崖。
en: One is in the chest before me. The others
are at the Sacred Pool, Tiebian Castle,
Bronze Gorge and White Cliff.

zh: 你需要天劍之威與月刀之芒。
en: You need the might of the Sky Sword and
the gleam of the Moon Blade.

zh: 有三顆明珠會幫助你，接受它們參加
你的隊伍吧！
en: Three bright pearls will help you. Accept
them into your party!

zh: 善用你的心志，善用你的心志！
en: Use your will well, use your will well!

zh: 慎選你的夥伴！
en: Choose your companions with care!

zh: 留心帶水的男子。
en: Beware the man who carries water.

zh: 咖！你怎麼這麼好騙，謝謝你的水晶
球啦！
en: Ha! How gullible you are! Thanks for the
crystal ball!

zh: 龍柱出現缺口，隱隱發出光芒
en: A gap opens in the dragon pillar, glowing
faintly.

zh: 妖道！你還要做惡到幾時！今天我一
定要收拾你！
en: Demon priest! How long will you go on doing
evil? Today I'll finish you!

zh: 那就要看你有沒有這個能耐了！
en: That depends on whether you're up to it!

zh: 救命啊！救命！不要殺我啊！
en: Help! Help! Don't kill me!

zh: 怎麼辦？
先救人
先宰了妖僧
en: What do we do?
{>13}Save her first
{>13}Kill the monk first

zh: 不要怕！我來救你！
en: Don't be afraid! I'll save you!

zh: 謝謝你‧‧‧
en: Thank you...

zh: 妳！妳們竟然暗算我‧‧‧
en: You! You tricked me...

zh: 那只有怪你笨啊！生存守則第一條：
認清敵我！
en: Blame your own stupidity! First rule of
survival: know friend from foe!

zh: 姐妹們！這小子好生無情！我們宰了
他！蚩蛇，你先下來休息一下吧！
en: Sisters! This boy is heartless! Let's kill him!
Chishe, come down and rest a while!

zh: 哼！原來你們是一夥的！
en: Hmph! So you're all in it together!

zh: 到現在知道可能有點晚了！你這不懂
憐香惜玉的混蛋！
en: A bit late to figure that out now! You brute
who can't treat a lady kindly!

zh: 臭小子！你竟敢殺了我三個愛徒！看
我怎麼收拾你們！
en: Brat! You dare kill my three beloved
disciples! Now see what I do to you!

zh: 真是險惡的妖魔，三番兩次蒙騙於我
，引我入甕；真是可惡至極！
en: Vile demons! Tricking me again and again,
luring me into your trap. Utterly despicable!

zh: 多行不義必自斃！你今天終於嘗到惡
果了！
en: Evil brings its own ruin! Today you finally
reap what you've sown!

zh: 咖....咖....你少假正經了....你以
為我不知道你是誰嗎？....邪惡之子
en: Heh... heh... Stop pretending to be so
righteous... You think I don't know who you
are?... Son of Evil!

zh: 你的手將會染滿比我們更多的鮮血！
你竟還敢滿口仁義道德？咖‧‧‧咖
‧‧‧笑死人了！
en: Your hands will be stained with more blood
than ours! And you dare preach virtue?
Heh... heh... Hilarious!

zh: 他死了。
en: He's dead.

zh: 我的雙手將會染滿鮮血嗎？
en: Will my hands really be stained with blood?

zh: 忽然來女孩子叫聲
en: A girl's cry suddenly rings out.

zh: 咦？！我爹給的那把劍不断的振動！
‧‧‧哇！力量大得都快握不住了！
en: Huh?! The sword Father gave me keeps
shaking! ...Whoa! It's so strong I can barely
hold it!

zh: ‧‧‧剛剛到底怎麼一回事？‧‧‧
en: ...What on earth just happened?...

zh: 哇！又來了！
en: Whoa! Again!

zh: ‧‧‧難道跟這個壁飾有関？‧‧‧
en: ...Could it have something to do with this
mural?...

zh: 我們走吧！
en: Let's go!

zh: 古劍忽然不断振動
en: The Old Sword suddenly keeps shaking.

zh: 目前古堡在整修，很多地方都很危險
，還是不要隨便亂逛比較好‧‧‧
en: The old castle is being repaired, and many
places are dangerous. Better not wander
around...

zh: 古堡很多地方都封起來了，你們還是
過些日子再來吧！
en: Much of the old castle is sealed off. Come
back in a few days!

zh: 有什麼事嗎？
en: Can I help you?

zh: 你要知道什麼呢？
水城
古堡
荷葉坪　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What would you like to know?
{>13}Water City
{>13}Old castle
{>13}Heyeping{>169}Leave

zh: 傳說水城是被貶下凡間的仙人們所建
造的。因為心眼兒鬥不過人類，所以
就建這座城堡，跟外界人類隔開，以
求自保。
en: Legend says Water City was built by
immortals banished to the mortal world.
Unable to match human cunning, they built
this castle to keep themselves apart.

zh: 聽說裡面有許多仙人遺留下來的宝物
呢！但從來沒人看到過！
en: They say it's full of treasures the
immortals left behind! But no one has ever
seen them!

zh: 這地方離這兒還蠻遠的呢！你得要先
搭船到十里舖，再北上到荷葉坪。
en: That's quite far from here! You'll have to
take a boat to Shilipu, then head north to
Heyeping.

zh: 小夥子，我家就只有我和三個女兒，
沒事可以來坐坐聊聊天啊！
en: Young man, it's only me and my three
daughters at home. Drop by for a chat
sometime!

zh: 你一定會喜歡我那幾個女兒的！
en: You're sure to like my daughters!

zh: ....你是誰？....怎麼可以到姑娘的
房間！出去！給別人看到會說話的！
en: ...Who are you?... How dare you come into a
girl's room! Get out! People will talk!

zh: 她娘叫我們坐，她卻趕我們走！唉！
做人真難！
en: Her mother invites us in, and she throws us
out! Sigh! Life is hard!

zh: 壯士救命啊！趕緊救救我那苦命的女
en: Help me, good sir! Please save my poor
daughters! Boo hoo...

zh: 出了什麼事了？
en: What happened?

zh: 剛剛有個妖僧突然擄走我那三個女兒
en: A demon monk just carried off my three
daughters! Boo hoo...
A demon monk?!... Could it be...

zh: 妳不要哭，告訴我他往那裡去了？
en: Don't cry. Tell me, where did he go?

zh: 我看到他好像跑進古堡裡去了‧‧‧
en: I think I saw him run into the old castle...

zh: 救救我那苦命的女兒啊！
en: Please save my poor daughters!

zh: 發現一道暗門，你需要鑰匙Ｄ
en: A hidden door. You need Key D.

zh: 宝箱上鎖，你需要鑰匙Ｈ
en: The chest is locked. You need Key H.

zh: 你需要鑰匙Ｇ
en: You need Key G.

zh: 你需要鑰匙Ｅ
en: You need Key E.

zh: 人生在世，往往想的跟做的不一樣，
要的跟擁有的也不一樣‧‧‧你想‧
‧‧這問題會出在那裡呢？
en: In life, what we think and what we do often
differ, and so do what we want and what we
have... Where do you think the problem lies?

zh: 有什麼事嗎？想知道什麼？
水城
古堡
客棧　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Can I help you? What do you want to know?
{>13}Water City
{>13}Old castle
{>13}The inn{>169}Leave

zh: 我不太清楚，對這個地方而言，我只
是個陌生人......其実到那裡不是呢
en: I'm not sure. I'm just a stranger here...
But then, where am I not?

zh: 我搜過Ｎ次啦！根本半個宝藏的影子
也沒見過！
en: I've searched it a hundred times! Never
seen a trace of treasure!

zh: 這間旅店倒還不錯，挺乾淨的。唯一
美中不足的就是老闆娘那張撲克臉！
en: This inn's not bad, nice and clean. The only
flaw is the landlady's poker face!

zh: 這城你有沒有覺得怪怪的？我始終覺
得似乎有著什麼秘密似的‧‧‧
en: Doesn't this city feel strange to you? I
always feel it hides some secret...

zh: 俗語說得好：「好奇心會殺死九命貓
」，所以我通常不去想太多。
en: As the saying goes, "Curiosity killed the
cat", so I try not to think too much.

zh: 喂！住店要３０銖錢。
要　　不要
en: Hey! A room is 30 gold.

zh: 喂！沒錢別想白住哦！
en: Hey! No money, no room!

zh: 天氣不錯吧！
en: Nice weather, huh?

zh: 你找我有什麼事呢？
水城
古堡
荷葉坪　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want with me?
{>13}Water City
{>13}Old castle
{>13}Heyeping{>169}Leave

zh: 這座城為何建造在海上，又是如何建
起來的，這個問題對所有的人而言，
都是個難解的謎。
en: Why this city was built on the sea, and how,
is a riddle no one can solve.

zh: 関於那城堡的傳說很多，但談論最多
的就是，大家都認為那古堡裡有著千
古難求的宝貝！
en: There are many legends about that castle,
but most agree it holds a treasure beyond
price!

zh: 每週都有一艘船從這裡出發，前往北
辺。前天船已經開了，你過幾天來這
兒等就可以了。
en: A boat leaves here for the north every
week. It sailed the day before yesterday, so
come back and wait in a few days.

zh: 我認為這城的來歷絕對相當不凡，不
是凡夫俗子所能理解的‧‧‧
en: I'm sure this city has a remarkable past,
beyond the grasp of ordinary folk...

zh: 我一直在想「人外有人，天外有天」
這句話....是不是老祖宗試圖在告訴
我們什麼？....難道說！這城真是天
上神仙所建嗎？！
en: I keep thinking of the saying "There's a
heaven beyond heaven"... Were our
ancestors telling us something? Could this
city really be the work of gods?!

zh: 謝謝你告訴我們！不過我們是自個兒
開船來的，現在只等風浪小些！
en: Thanks for telling us! But we sailed here
ourselves. We're just waiting for the waves
to calm down!

zh: 聽說你到達古堡頂了？想必找到不少
宝藏吧！
en: I hear you reached the top of the old
castle? You must have found lots of
treasure!

zh: 想不到宝藏被你們捷足先登拿走了，
現在民間生活困苦，可否佈施些來用
用？
en: So you beat everyone to the treasure!
Times are hard for us common folk. Could
you spare some?

zh: 金銀財宝是沒有，不過沈悶的妖怪倒
是不少；有空你也可以過去跟它們聊
聊天。
en: No gold or silver, but plenty of bored
monsters. Go have a chat with them
sometime.

zh: 嘿！我們見過！在白道口茶店裡啊！
en: Hey! We've met! In the teahouse at Baidao
Pass!

zh: 想知道什麼嗎？
你是‧‧‧
水城‧‧‧
前往荷葉坪　　　　　　　離開
en: Want to know something?
{>13}Who are you?
{>13}Water City...
{>13}To Heyeping{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道水城的‧‧‧
古堡
那辺不一樣？
其他
en: About Water City...
{>13}The old castle
{>13}What's different?
{>169}Other

zh: 我叫李大，排行老大嘛！專門跑單幫
的。你來這兒幹嘛？
en: I'm Li Da, "Da" because I'm the eldest! I'm a
traveling trader. What brings you here?

zh: 我要去荷葉坪找個人。你是這裡人嗎
en: I'm going to Heyeping to find someone. Are
you from here?

zh: 不是！我到處晃，走到那裡就算那兒
啦！多自由！
en: No! I wander around. Wherever I end up is
home! So free!

zh: 我來這兒好幾次了。但這次卻覺得怪
怪的。
en: I've been here many times, but this time it
feels odd.

zh: 每週都有一艘船往北方去。但不巧的
，前天渡船才剛走。你得等幾天了。
en: A boat goes north every week, but unluckily
it just left the day before yesterday.
You'll have to wait a few days.

zh: 你說那陰森森的地方啊！我從沒喜歡
過那裡！偏偏這兒的人好像很迷它似
的！
en: You mean that gloomy place? I never liked
it! But the people here seem crazy about it!

zh: 就像以前每次我來，藥房的酒糟張必
定會拉著我去大喝一場；這次見了我
，卻冷漠的很！
en: Every time I came before, Drunk Zhang at
the pharmacy would drag me off for a big
drinking bout. This time he barely looked at
me!

zh: 武器店的老闆更絕情！連個招呼都不
打！真是莫名奇妙，又沒有人惹他們
en: The weapon shop owner is even colder! Not
even a hello! I don't get it. Nobody did
anything to them!

zh: 喂！我前幾天弄到個新鮮的東西，叫
做“催眠術法“呢！怎麼樣？想不想
要啊？怎麼樣，就２５０銖錢？
要　　不要
en: Hey! A few days ago I got something new,
called "Hypnosis"! How about it? Want it?
Just 250 gold?

zh: 啊！你錢不夠！
en: Ah! You don't have enough money!

zh: 好吧！反正這東西好賣得很。
en: Fine! This thing sells easily anyway.

zh: 沒関係，等錢夠了再來買好了！我這
兒先幫你留著好了！
en: No problem, come buy it when you have the
money! I'll keep it for you!

zh: 我昨天發現城西南有戶人家有三個女
娃個個都長得挺標緻的呢！
en: Yesterday I found a family in the southwest
of the city with three daughters, each
prettier than the last!

zh: 要是我長得像你這付小白臉的樣子，
我今天就不必這樣孤家寡人的到處晃
了！
en: If I had a pretty face like yours, I
wouldn't be wandering around all alone
today!

zh: 怎麼？錢夠了嗎？現在要買了嗎？
要　　不要
en: Well? Got the money? Buying now?

zh: 好了！這東西是你的了！
en: There! It's yours!

zh: 小兄弟，對不起了，這東西你不買，
我只好賣給別人了。
en: Sorry, little brother. If you won't buy it,
I'll have to sell it to someone else.

zh: 怎麼？你去看過那幾個美姑娘了沒？
en: Well? Have you been to see those pretty
girls yet?

zh: 真沒想到！整座城竟然都給妖怪占據
了！怪不得我總覺得怪怪的！‧‧‧
但是我那好酒伴酒糟張，以及老王呢
？唉‧‧‧只怕也是凶多吉少了。
en: Who'd have thought! The whole city was
taken over by monsters! No wonder it felt
so odd!... But my drinking pal Drunk Zhang,
and old Wang? Sigh... I fear the worst.

zh: 你們還不走嗎？這個地方，我也要趕
緊離開了！
en: Aren't you leaving? I'm getting out of this
place fast too!

zh: 哦！那沒関係，我們自個兒開船來的
；只要風浪小些，去那兒都沒問題。
en: Oh, that's all right. We sailed here
ourselves. Once the waves calm down, we
can go anywhere.

zh: 得到催眠術法
en: Learned Hypnosis.

zh: 城西的三個俏妞，是妖魔變的？你誆
我的吧！我還想等我這趟買賣完成後
，備厚禮登門求親的呢！
en: The three beauties in the west of town were
demons? You're pulling my leg! I was going
to bring rich gifts and propose once this
deal was done!

zh: 老兄，不要被外貌迷住了，現今邪道
横行；像你這個樣子，可真是很危險
的哦！
en: Friend, don't be fooled by looks. Evil is
everywhere these days. Someone like you is
in real danger!

zh: 咦？你是誰？有什麼事嗎？
en: Huh? Who are you? What do you want?

zh: 想聊些什麼呢？
水城
古堡
荷葉坪　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to talk about?
{>13}Water City
{>13}Old castle
{>13}Heyeping{>169}Leave

zh: 我們這兒向來以特殊的地理環境而著
名。傳說中，這兒曾是天神與惡魔爭
戰的失樂園！
en: This place has always been famous for its
strange lie of the land. Legend says it was
the lost paradise where gods and demons
went to war!

zh: 真的？！那結果呢？！
en: Really?! And how did it end?!

zh: 傳說嗎？！當然是沒人知道，每個都
傳來傳去地，早就沒什麼好說的！
en: A legend?! Of course no one knows. It's
been passed around so much there's nothing
left to say!

zh: 你自己逛逛就會知道了嘛！一直問我
幹嘛呢？
en: Look around and you'll find out! Why keep
asking me?

zh: 傳說古堡裡有著價值連城的宝藏，但
是據說只有有緣人才能看得到！
en: They say the old castle holds priceless
treasure, but only those fated can see it!

zh: 那還在北辺呢！還有一段路呢！
en: That's still up north! It's quite a way yet!

zh: 還有什麼事嗎？
en: Anything else?

zh: 喂！請尊重一下隱私權好嗎？
en: Hey! Could you respect my privacy, please?

zh: 原來地道的出口在這兒！
en: So this is where the tunnel comes out!

zh: 你們是外地人嗎？我從未見過你們
en: Are you from out of town? I've never seen
you before.

zh: 你想知道什麼？
妳是‧‧‧
水城
古堡　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Who are you?
{>13}Water City
{>13}Old castle{>169}Leave

zh: 我叫紅姑，我們姐妹及娘親，住在那
城西南辺，門前有樹的那棟就是我家
了。
en: I'm Hong Gu. My sisters, mother and I live in
the southwest of the city, the house with a
tree out front.

zh: 我們這裡住的都是一些很淳樸的老百
姓，或許因為地理的関係，所以不太
跟外界來往。
en: Only simple, honest folk live here. Maybe
because of where we are, we don't have
much to do with outsiders.

zh: 人們都說那裡面的宝藏只給有緣人呢
en: People say the treasure inside is only for
those who are fated!

zh: 經過我家，歡迎進來坐坐。
en: If you pass my house, come in and sit a
while.

zh: 又有生人至此，太好了。
en: More strangers have come. How lovely.

zh: 風浪太大，無法出海‧‧‧
en: The waves are too high to sail...

zh: 這屋子似乎很久沒人住了
en: It seems no one has lived here for a long
time.

zh: 雜物間
en: Storeroom

zh: 沈皓是吧！你終於來了。我剛幫你父
親換好藥，過來看看你爹。
en: You're Shen Hao, right? You've come at
last. I just changed your father's
dressings. Come see him.

zh: 爹！爹！你怎麼了？
en: Father! Father! What happened?
...Ying... Ying...

zh: 爹？‧‧‧你怎麼在叫娘？‧‧‧醒
醒啊！
en: Father?... Why are you calling Mother's
name?... Wake up!

zh: 螢螢！‧‧‧不要！‧‧‧怎麼辦？
‧‧‧孩子是無辜的啊！‧‧‧螢螢
en: Ying!... No!... What do we do?... The child is
innocent!... Ying!...

zh: 爹！你在說什麼？！‧‧‧爹？！醒
醒啊！
en: Father! What are you saying?!... Father?!
Wake up!

zh: 你爹傷得很重，神智不是很清楚，先
讓他休息一下吧！
en: Your father is badly hurt and not in his
right mind. Let him rest for now!
...Father...

zh: ‧‧‧沈父依然沈睡未醒‧‧‧
en: ...Father Shen is still asleep...
...Hao'er...

zh: 爹！‧‧‧是誰把你傷成這樣？！
en: Father!... Who did this to you?!

zh: 唉，不要問了，你不是他的對手的！
‧‧‧時間不多了‧‧‧爹要告訴你
當年的事‧‧‧
en: Sigh, don't ask. You're no match for him!...
There's little time left... I must tell you
what happened back then...

zh: 你知道爹為何從來不說你娘的事嗎？
en: Do you know why I never spoke of your
mother?

zh: ‧‧‧我想或許爹傷心，所以不提‧
en: ...I thought maybe it hurt too much to talk
about...

zh: 自從見到你娘的那一剎那，我就愛上
她了‧‧‧你知道嗎？‧‧‧你娘是
千古幽蘭的花魄‧‧‧
en: I loved your mother from the moment I saw
her... Did you know?... Your mother was the
spirit of an ancient orchid...

zh: 啊？！娘不是人類？！
en: What?! Mother wasn't human?!

zh: 是的。或許如此，她才會有那般脫俗
的氣質吧！‧‧‧我們一見鍾情‧‧
en: Yes. Perhaps that's why she was so
otherworldly!... It was love at first sight...

zh: 但是那時有一個妖怪－山魅－也苦苦
相纏你母親。我們敵不過，就躲了起
來。‧‧‧後來你娘就懷了你‧‧‧
en: But a demon, the Hill Wraith, also pursued
your mother. We couldn't fight him, so we
hid... Then your mother became pregnant
with you...

zh: 但在你出生的那天，山魅不知從那兒
得知消息，找到了我們！他嫉恨地擄
走了你娘，並立下了非常惡毒的詛咒
en: But on the day you were born, the Hill
Wraith found us somehow! In his jealousy he
took your mother and laid a most vicious
curse:...

zh: 七顆摩尼宝珠？‧‧‧難道我現在身
上的那兩顆宝珠就是‧‧‧？
en: Seven Mani Jewels?... Could the two jewels I
carry be...?

zh: 對了‧‧‧娘呢？！‧‧‧娘後來呢
en: And... Mother?!... What happened to Mother?

zh: 你娘被擄走後，聽說不久就傷心憔悴
而死‧‧‧
en: After she was taken, I heard she soon died
of grief...

zh: ‧‧‧嗚‧‧‧可恨的山魅，我一定
要報仇！
en: ...Sob... Cursed Hill Wraith, I'll have my
revenge!

zh: 孩子‧‧‧爹娘對不起你‧‧‧你得
要靠自己了‧‧‧你得去荷葉坪找一
位丘道人他是爹的好友‧‧‧
en: Child... Your mother and I failed you... You
must rely on yourself now... Go to Heyeping
and find Taoist Qiu. He's my good friend...
...Father... Father!!... Sob...

zh: 節哀順變吧。至少你爹娘又在一起了
en: Try to bear your grief. At least your
parents are together again.

zh: 我才不相信沈哥是什麼”邪惡之子”
呢！說什麼我也不相信！
en: I don't believe Brother Shen is some "Son of
Evil"! No matter what anyone says!

zh: 不要傷心了，我們要儘快的去找到其
他宝珠，才是最重要的！
en: Don't grieve. Finding the other jewels as
soon as we can is what matters most!

zh: ‧‧‧爹！難道我就是傳說中的邪惡
en: ...Father! Am I really the Son of Evil from
the legend?...

zh: ‧‧‧我帶著你四處去流浪，企盼能
找到解除惡咒的方法。‧‧‧後來遇
到一位高僧，他說‧‧‧
en: ...I took you wandering far and wide, hoping
to find a way to lift the curse... Then I met
a holy monk, who said...

zh: 如果真的需要我加入幫忙，就說一聲
吧！
要　　不要
en: If you really need my help, just say the
word!

zh: 求求你，我渾身上下只剩下我父親留
給我的這幅画了，可憐可憐我，買下
這幅画吧！我已經好多天沒吃飯了。
買　　不買
en: Please, all I have left is this painting my
father gave me. Have pity, buy it! I
haven't eaten in days.

zh: 謝謝！謝謝！隨便你們出個價吧。
三十銖錢
五十銖錢
一百銖錢
en: Thank you! Thank you! Name any price.

zh: 謝謝！謝謝你們！
en: Thank you! Thank you so much!

zh: 啊？不買‧‧‧好吧‧‧‧也怪我平
時太過吝啬，結果弄得如此狼狽，活
該沒人理會‧‧‧你們也好自為之吧
en: What? You won't... Fine... I was always too
stingy, and now look at me. I deserve to be
ignored... Take care of yourselves!

zh: 看來你們也不夠錢買吧！唉，同是天
涯淪落人‧‧‧
en: Looks like you can't afford it either! Sigh,
we're both down on our luck...

zh: 得到一幅画
en: Received a Painting.

zh: 以前這裡很繁榮的，來往船隻非常多
。但自從河面出現妖怪後，就再也沒
人敢出海了！
en: This place used to thrive, with ships coming
and going. But since monsters appeared in
the river, no one dares set sail!

zh: 小夥子，可有什麼事？
風陵渡
妖怪
彩衣女　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Something I can do for you, lad?
{>13}Fengling Ferry
{>13}Monsters
{>13}Caiyi{>169}Leave

zh: 你要問有関風陵渡的‧‧‧
水城
名產
其他
en: About Fengling Ferry...
{>13}Water City
{>13}Specialties
{>169}Other

zh: 這裡是個漁村，同時也是前往北辺”
水城”的一條重要之路！
en: This is a fishing village, and also the main
route north to Water City!

zh: 那些妖怪潛伏在水中，不但興風作浪
，還會噴毒氣害人！
en: The monsters lurk in the water. They stir up
storms and spit poison gas!

zh: 你大概是指那個奇怪的女子吧，她是
在妖怪出現後才到這裡的。平日也不
跟人說話。如果你要找她，她就住在
渡口旁的那棟屋子裡。
en: You must mean that strange woman. She
came here after the monsters appeared and
never talks to anyone. If you want her,
she lives in the house by the ferry landing.

zh: ”水城”位於北方，非常奇特的地方
，整座城由許多小島所組成，可稱之
為”水上城市”呢！
en: Water City is in the north. It's a very
unusual place, made up of many small
islands. A "city on the water"!

zh: 我們這兒，沒什麼名產的，不過，倒
是有不少“沈悶的傢伙“，勉強可以
算是名產吧！
en: We don't have any specialties here, though
we do have plenty of "dull folks". I suppose
they count!

zh: 小子！你是沒法渡海的！沒人敢開船
的－－況且也沒有人可以開了！
en: Kid! You can't cross the water! No one
dares sail. And there's no one left to do it
anyway!

zh: 唉！一個人的，去那裡還不一樣嗎？
en: Sigh! Alone, what does it matter where I go?

zh: 為什麼所有倒霉事都給我碰上了！做
什麼垮什麼，現在竟然連個魚都捕不
到了！
en: Why does all the bad luck fall on me?
Everything I try fails, and now I can't
even catch a fish!

zh: 要知道什麼，我告訴你‧‧‧
風陵渡
妖怪
彩衣女　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know? I'll tell you...
{>13}Fengling Ferry
{>13}Monsters
{>13}Caiyi{>169}Leave

zh: 自從妖怪出現後，人都跑光了。這裏
只剩幾個半死不活的人了！奇怪的是
：有個不知道從那裡跑來的怪女人偏
偏在這時候來到我們這兒！
en: Since the monsters came, everyone has fled.
Only a few half-dead folks are left! And
strangely, some odd woman from who knows
where showed up right then!

zh: 你可要小心啊！尤其不要太靠近水辺
！那些妖怪會衝出來把你拖進水裡吃
掉呢！
en: Be careful! Especially near the water! The
monsters will burst out, drag you under and
eat you!

zh: 你說那女人啊？真夠怪的！她搬來一
個多月，連一句話也沒說過！
en: That woman? She's really strange! She
moved here over a month ago and hasn't
said a word!

zh: 你們快離開吧！這裏沒什麼好看的！
你也無法再往北走了。
en: Leave, quickly! There's nothing to see here!
And you can't go any further north.

zh: 我勸你們提防一下那個女人！怪里怪
氣的，一看就不是個好女人！
en: I'd watch out for that woman! She's weird.
Anyone can see she's no good!

zh: 你需要鑰匙Ｃ
en: You need Key C.

zh: 屋内有人應話
en: Someone answers from inside.

zh: 裏面正忙著，請等一下再來。
en: We're busy in here. Please come back later.

zh: 請問‧‧‧
妳知道我爹為何受傷嗎？
是妳救了我爹嗎？
妳怎麼會認識我爹的？
en: Excuse me...
{>13}Why was my father hurt?
{>13}Did you save my father?
{>13}How do you know him?

zh: 等你爹清醒的時候，你問他好了。
en: Ask your father when he wakes up.

zh: ‧‧‧我碰巧經過的‧‧‧
en: ...I just happened to pass by...

zh: 我想：你該去看看你爹了‧‧‧
en: I think you should go see your father...

zh: 你知道是誰傷了我父親嗎？
en: Do you know who hurt my father?

zh: ‧‧‧你父親不願意說，一定有他的
原因。我想，總有一天你會知道的。
en: ...Your father wouldn't say. He must have
his reasons. I think you'll find out someday.

zh: 你總有一天會知道的。
en: You'll find out someday.

zh: 你會駕駛船嗎？
en: Can you sail a boat?

zh: 我跟你們一塊兒走。
en: I'll come with you.

zh: 啊？！為什麼？
en: What?! Why?

zh: 這位姑娘，前面很危險呢，妳還是不
要去了。
en: Miss, it's dangerous ahead. You'd better not
come.

zh: 姑娘！妳不要開玩笑！我們不是出去
玩哪！
en: Miss! Don't joke! We're not going on a
pleasure trip!

zh: 你們若沒有我的話，是過不了前面的
。你讓不讓我加入呢？
好　　不好
en: Without me you'll never get past what lies
ahead. Will you let me join?

zh: 離開這傷心地吧！
en: Let's leave this sad place!

zh: 那我們走吧！
en: Then let's go!

zh: 好吧。船在那兒，你們自求多福吧。
en: Very well. The boat's over there. Good luck
to you.

zh: 姑娘！姑娘！妳在嗎？
en: Miss! Miss! Are you there?

zh: 有什麼事嗎？
en: What is it?

zh: 對不起，但我想請問妳，是否還願意
加入我的隊伍呢？
en: Sorry, but I wanted to ask whether you'd
still join my party.

zh: 不願意！
en: No!

zh: 你不是說不需要我嗎？
en: Didn't you say you didn't need me?

zh: 算了吧‧‧‧放棄吧！
en: Forget it... Let's give up!

zh: 好了，我們走吧！
en: All right, let's go!

zh: ‧‧‧唉‧‧‧女人心海底針‧‧‧
en: ...Sigh... A woman's heart is a needle in the
ocean...

zh: 而且，在“水城“裏有一座古堡；據
聞，古堡内藏有數不盡的宝藏呢！
en: And in Water City there's an old castle.
They say it holds countless treasures!

zh: 小子，你是沒法子渡海的！沒人敢開
船的－－況且，村子也已經沒啥人了
en: Kid, you can't cross the water! No one
dares sail. Besides, there's hardly anyone
left in the village.

zh: 你要節哀順變啊！想不到你竟有如此
哀淒的人生經歷！
en: My condolences! Who'd have thought your
life held such sorrow!

zh: 現在要出海，風浪可大著呢！要小心
喲！
en: The waves are rough if you're setting sail
now! Be careful!

zh: ‧‧‧咖！‧‧‧你終於來了嗎？‧
‧‧呵呵呵‧‧‧來了吧！‧‧‧
en: ...Heh!... So you've come at last?... Ho ho
ho... Come on!...

zh: 啊？！又是這邪像，整個人都不自覺
地發抖；真是邪氣的東西！
en: What?! That evil idol again. It makes me
shake all over. What an evil thing!

zh: 可惡，這麼邪氣的聲音，誰？是誰？
快出來，別再裝神弄鬼了。
en: Damn, such an evil voice. Who? Who's there?
Come out and stop playing tricks!

zh: 除了回音外，沒有任何回答
en: No answer but the echo.

zh: 這房間真是暗得陰森！‧‧‧
en: This room is so dark and eerie!...

zh: 點個火熠子吧！
en: Let's light a torch!

zh: 邪惡殿
en: Hall of Evil

zh: 啊！這裏是那裏？我怎麼被抓來這種
地方？
en: Ah! Where am I? Why was I brought to a
place like this?

zh: 謝謝壯士相救！
en: Thank you for saving me, brave sir!

zh: 居然有女孩子被綁架，這種簡直不是
人幹的事，絕對不可以原諒！
en: Kidnapping girls! Nobody human would do
such a thing. It's unforgivable!

zh: 忠孝1
仁愛2
信義3
和平4
en: Loyalty 1
Kindness 2
Faith 3
Peace 4

zh: 風浪太大，無法駛出外海
en: The waves are too high to reach the open
sea.

zh: ....我們終於勝利了....
en: ...We've finally won...

zh: 如果他是真的....那麼，我們到底在
對抗著什麼呢？
en: ...Have we?... I don't know...
If he was real... then what is it we've been
fighting?

zh: ....難道....是自己的一顆心嗎？..
en: ...Could it be... our own hearts?...

zh: ....答案到底是什麼呢？....
en: ...What is the answer?...

zh: 管他的！只要相信著自己，然後就努
力的去做吧！
en: Who cares! Just believe in yourself and do
your best!

zh: ‧‧‧老伯，這裏好像沒有路了，請
問我們要怎樣渡海？
en: ...Sir, the road seems to end here. How do we
cross the sea?

zh: 孩子，我等你們很久了‧‧‧
en: Children, I've been waiting for you a long
time...
...And you are?...

zh: 那不重要‧‧‧重要的是，我是來幫
助你們的‧‧‧
en: That's not important... What matters is that
I'm here to help you...

zh: 來吧！閉上眼睛，讓你們體會一下“
御風術法“的無窮奧妙‧‧‧
好　　不好
en: Come! Close your eyes and feel the
boundless wonder of the Wind Ride art...

zh: 咦！我們怎麼會在這裏‧‧‧
en: Huh! How did we get here...

zh: 啊！老伯不見了‧‧‧
en: Ah! The old man is gone...

zh: 或許是神仙的幫助吧！
en: Maybe an immortal helped us!

zh: 我不要！救命啊！
en: No! Help!

zh: 快去看是誰在喊救命。
en: Quick, let's see who's crying for help.

zh: 聲音是從前面的村子傳來的。
en: The voice came from the village ahead.

zh: 你們看！太陽和月亮同時出現在西方
en: Look! The sun and moon are both in the
western sky!

zh: 第二個徵兆：日月並明於西方
en: The second omen: sun and moon shine
together in the west.

zh: 這一切是真的嗎？‧‧‧為什麼一切
都變天了呢？
en: Is all this real?... Why is everything
changing?

zh: 對不起，我臨時想到還有事情沒辦完
，謝謝您的好意，我下次再來找您幫
忙！
en: Sorry, I just remembered something I
haven't finished. Thanks for your kindness.
I'll come for your help next time!

zh: 也罷，冥冥之中，自有命定，誰也強
求不來的，下次再說吧！
en: Very well. Fate decides all, and nothing can
be forced. Next time, then!

zh: 出現流星的那夜，古厝前的地面竟然
裂開了！露出一塊石碑，上面寫著関
於邪惡的事‧‧‧
發問　離開
en: The night the meteor fell, the ground split
before the old house! A stone tablet
appeared, inscribed with words about evil...
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

上官村

zh: 上官村出過許多探花、進士及秀才，
是有名的文人村！你可以去我們古厝
參觀看看！
再問　離開
en: Shangguan Village has bred many scholars
and laureates. It's famous for it! Go see
our ancestral house!
{>130}More{>169}Leave

zh: 那塊石碑看起來像是塊古物呢！‧‧
‧但出現在血流星之夜，実在是個不
祥之兆啊！
en: That tablet looks like an antique!... But
appearing on the night of the blood meteor,
it's surely an ill omen!

zh: 石碑上面好像寫什麼“天變“，“邪
惡“之類的字眼，我不太記得了。
en: The tablet seems to say things like "heaven
changes" and "evil". I don't remember
exactly.

zh: 我們的古厝已有好幾百年的歷史了！
它代表上官村輝煌的一頁。
en: Our ancestral house is hundreds of years
old! It stands for Shangguan Village's
glorious past.

zh: 你聽過那句話嗎？“天之將亡，其象
en: Have you heard the saying, "When heaven is
about to fall, its signs fade"?... Sigh!...

zh: 你找上官明？他就住在古厝的旁辺，
不過他好像作買賣去了，不知道什麼
時候才會回來。
en: Looking for Shangguan Ming? He lives next
to the old house, but he seems to be away
on business. No telling when he'll be back.

zh: 待會兒村長會和本村老學者一起來研
究石碑這件事。
en: The village elder and our old scholar will be
coming to study the tablet shortly.

zh: 你要問上官村的‧‧‧？
古厝
上官明
離開
en: About Shangguan Village...?
{>13}The old house
{>13}Shangguan Ming
{>169}Leave

zh: 我是羊，我不會說話，也不會回答問
題。
en: I'm a sheep. I can't talk, and I don't
answer questions.

zh: 請不要跟羊說話。
en: Please don't talk to the sheep.

zh: 太可怕了！我要趕緊辨理移民！‧‧
但我能去那裡呢？‧‧‧
en: How terrible! I must emigrate at once!... But
where could I go?...

zh: 你碰我幹嘛？
發問　離開
en: Why'd you poke me?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 上官村全是一些食古不化的老古板！
跟不上時代了‧‧‧
再問　離開
en: Shangguan Village is full of stuffy old
fogeys stuck in the past...
{>130}More{>169}Leave

zh: 那石碑看來好舊好髒，‧‧‧上面不
但有怪異的古文字，還刻有奇怪的圖
案！
en: That tablet looks so old and dirty... It has
strange ancient writing, and odd pictures
carved on it too!

zh: 那圖案看起來還挺邪門的！似人非人
，十分鬼怪；後辺還有隻怪模怪樣的
東西‧‧‧真邪門！
en: The picture looks evil! Human but not
human, utterly ghastly, with some weird
thing behind it... Creepy!

zh: 我們上官村唯一可以自傲的，就剩那
房子裏的東西了，但後代子孫不努力
，遲早還不是會完蛋。
en: All Shangguan Village has left to be proud
of is what's in that house. And if the young
ones don't work hard, we're done for sooner
or later.

zh: 你知道嗎？那夜血流星出現時，村裏
那位老學者臉色大變呢！我看這回大
事不好了！
en: You know what? When the blood meteor
appeared, the old scholar went pale! I think
big trouble is coming!

zh: 你說上官明啊，他好像出去做買賣了
。他三天兩頭不見人，很難找的‧‧
en: Shangguan Ming? I think he's away on
business. He's gone half the time. Hard to
catch...

zh: ‧‧‧你說，該移民那裡呢？嘻嘻嘻
！咖咖咖，沒有一個地方是安全的‧
‧‧嘻嘻嘻‧‧‧咖咖咖‧‧‧
en: ...Tell me, where should I emigrate? Hee hee
hee! Heh heh heh, nowhere is safe... Hee hee
hee... Heh heh heh...

zh: 你看！隔壁那個呆子，聽說快被嚇瘋
了‧‧‧唉！百無一用是書生‧‧‧
en: Look! They say that fool next door is half
mad with fright... Sigh! Scholars are good for
nothing...

zh: 對了！你也是來看石碑的嗎？聽說很
多人都被嚇坯了；不過，我懷疑這是
上官村發展觀光事業的噱頭！
發問　離開
en: Oh! Are you here to see the tablet too?
They say it's scared lots of people, but I
suspect it's a stunt to boost tourism!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你儘管問吧！
上官村
石碑
邪惡　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask away!
{>13}Shangguan Village
{>13}The tablet
{>13}Evil{>169}Leave

zh: 很抱歉，我跟你一樣是外地人，才剛
到這兒沒兩天，也不太了解。我就住
在村南的客棧裏！
再問　離開
en: Sorry, I'm a stranger here like you. I only
arrived two days ago. I'm staying at the inn
in the south of the village!
{>130}More{>169}Leave

zh: 聽說那石碑只露出一半，但沒人敢去
挖出另一半，看看到底另一半在寫些
什麼？
en: They say only half the tablet is showing,
but no one dares dig out the rest to see
what it says.

zh: 我也不太清楚。看過的人都說，那石
碑記载著関於邪惡力量的出世，‧‧
‧據說還泛出一股邪氣呢！
en: I'm not sure. Those who've seen it say it
tells of the birth of an evil power... and
that it gives off an evil aura!

zh: 就是廣場那端的那棟大房子。不過現
在有村丁守著，過不去，得等村長來
詳細看過再說。
en: It's the big house at the end of the square.
But villagers are guarding it now. You'll
have to wait until the elder has examined it.

zh: 那夜我睡著了！對不起。
en: I was asleep that night! Sorry.

zh: 對不起，你問的是誰呀！‧‧‧我不
認識呀！
en: Sorry, who are you asking about?... I don't
know them!

zh: 我還是認為這件事只是場惡作劇罷了
en: I still think it's all just a prank.

zh: 推什麼推？沒看過石頭啊！咱們村裏
的禍事，都被你們這群外地人當熱鬧
看啊！‧‧去去去，閃遠點！
en: Quit pushing! Never seen a rock before? Our
village's trouble is just a show for you
outsiders!... Shoo, shoo, get back!

zh: 擠擠擠！擠什麼擠啊？擠牛奶呀！！
en: Push, push! What're you pushing for? Milking
a cow?!

zh: 讓讓！讓讓！麻煩讓讓‧‧‧
en: Excuse me! Excuse me! Coming through...

zh: 天之變兮五禍現
邪惡之子西北昇
自天而降紅龍火
從此幽冥不歸路
en: When heaven turns, five woes appear;
The Son of Evil rises northwest;
Red dragon fire falls from the sky,
Then the road to hell has no return.

zh: 咦？‧‧‧這好像曾在我夢中出現過
en: Huh?... I think I've seen this in a dream...

zh: 你說什麼？你說你夢見過這個東西？
en: What did you say? You dreamed of this
thing?

zh: 嘘‧‧‧，摸摸看這石碑是什麼石頭
做的吧！
en: Shh... Let's feel what kind of stone this
tablet is made of!

zh: 啊！這石碑下面還有字‧‧‧
en: Ah! There's more writing at the bottom...

zh: 若要消彌此禍端
唯有摩尼日月心
en: To end this calamity there is but
the Mani Heart of Sun and Moon.

zh: “摩尼日月心“？！‧‧‧這是什麼
東西啊？
en: "Mani Heart of Sun and Moon"?!... What's
that?

zh: 我覺得這一切都不對勁！這事透著鬼
怪，不對勁！不對勁！‧‧‧
en: Something's wrong with all this! It's
uncanny. Wrong! Wrong!...

zh: 管他的！先記下來再說。
en: Who cares! Let's write it down first.

zh: 沈皓將石碑内容抄在紙上
en: Shen Hao copies the tablet onto paper.

zh: 村長來了！村長來了！
en: The elder is coming! The elder is coming!

zh: 我只是臨時演員，出來跑龍套而已。
對劇情發展，一點幫助都沒有。
en: I'm just an extra with a walk-on part. I'm
no help to the plot at all.

zh: 你也是出來湊熱鬧嗎？
en: Here to see the commotion too?

zh: 有了這塊石碑，這上官村很快就會變
成觀光聖地。
en: With this tablet, Shangguan Village will soon
be a tourist hot spot.

zh: 外地來的客人，我是本村村長，這石
碑很古怪吧！看看就好，千萬不要亂
摸，有空請來我家泡泡茶吧！
en: Welcome, travelers. I'm the village elder.
Strange tablet, isn't it? Look, but don't
touch! Come have tea at my house sometime!

zh: 年輕人，你很像我老公年輕的時候，
呵呵呵！唉‧‧‧好久以前的事了‧
‧‧‧想當年‧‧‧想我那老公‧‧
en: Young man, you look just like my husband
did when he was young, ho ho ho! Sigh... That
was long ago... In those days... my dear
husband... Sigh!...

zh: 據我觀察，這石碑出現的時機，真是
太不對勁了。難道‧‧‧莫非‧‧‧
總之我得回去查查看。
en: From what I can see, this tablet appeared
at a very bad time. Could it be... perhaps...
Anyway, I must go back and look into it.

zh: 各位村民，也請不要亂動這塊石碑，
等我跟學者研究完後，再把結果告訴
大家。各位等村民大會的時候再來吧
en: Villagers, please don't touch the tablet.
Once the scholar and I have studied it, we'll
tell everyone the results. Come back for the
village meeting!

zh: 李探花，我們走吧！
en: Scholar Li, let's go!

zh: 哇～哇～冒出什麼妖魔？
en: Waah~ What demon is that?

zh: 你們是外地人吧？有什麼事嗎？
發問　離開
en: You're not from here, are you? What do you
want?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道什麼呢？
石碑
古厝
村長　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}The tablet
{>13}The old house

zh: 我也搞不懂它寫些什麼，我想只有村
尾的學者才看得懂吧！
en: I can't make out what it says. I think only
the scholar at the end of the village can
read it!

zh: 通常古厝是逢年過節才開放的，如果
你想看看的話，必須去找村長，他才
有鑰匙。
en: The old house usually opens only on
holidays. If you want to see it, find the
elder. He has the key.

zh: 剛剛那個村長，你應該還記得吧！他
家就在防具店再過去一點。最近他們
可是為了石碑的事，傷透腦筋。
en: You remember the elder from earlier, right?
His house is just past the armor shop. The
tablet has been giving them all a headache.

zh: 孩子，這種日子不要在外面亂晃。你
的父母知道你在那裏嗎？趕快回家吧
en: Child, don't wander around outside in times
like these. Do your parents know where you
are? Hurry home!

zh: 村長叫你們不要碰石頭，你們還故意
去摸一下，真是太大膽了。那麼邪氣
的東西‧‧‧幸好妖魔不強，否則我
們村子也完了。　　　發問　離開
en: The elder said not to touch it, and you did
anyway! Such an evil thing... Luckily the
demon was weak, or we'd be done for.
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 看你們擊敗妖魔的份上，隨便問吧！
石碑
古厝
村長　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: You beat the demon, so ask what you like!
{>13}The tablet
{>13}The old house
{>13}The elder{>169}Leave

zh: 會藏著妖魔鬼怪的東西，當然一定有
問題，那石碑透出來的邪氣，想想還
真嚇人，難怪有人嚇瘋了。年輕人，
人生幾何，不必凡事強出頭。
en: Something that hides demons must be bad
news. Its evil aura is frightening. No wonder
someone went mad. Young man, life is short.
Don't always rush to the front.

zh: 古厝供奉著上官村歷代祖先的牌位與
文物，一般不對外開放。
en: The old house holds the ancestral tablets
and relics of Shangguan Village. It's
usually closed to the public.

zh: 村長是一個非常能幹的人，年輕時還
是皇上御前三品帶刀侍衛！曾經斬殺
紫禁城外的九頭妖蛟，江湖朋友都叫
他“上官斬蛟“，是一代用刀宗師。
en: The elder was once an imperial guard! He
slew a nine-headed dragon outside the
Forbidden City. They call him
"Dragonslayer", a master of the blade.

zh: 世道多險，人間多難；以後像那塊石
碑這樣邪氣的東西，還是少碰為妙。
en: The world is perilous and full of trouble.
Best not to touch evil things like that
tablet again.

zh: 也許你需要一把鑰匙
en: Maybe you need a key.

zh: 沒人在家，請回
en: No one home. Please leave.

zh: 喂！等等我啊‧‧‧
en: Hey! Wait for me...

zh: 好了，我們走吧！
en: All right, let's go!

zh: 他掉東西了‧‧‧
en: He dropped something...

zh: 這是我們上官村歷代祖先的祠堂，你
可以四處看看。
en: This is the ancestral hall of Shangguan
Village. Feel free to look around.

zh: 對不起，我臨時有事，你自己看看吧
！我不招呼了。不過，請不要亂動這
裏面的東西。
en: Sorry, something's come up. Look around on
your own. I can't show you around. But
please don't touch anything in here.

zh: 上官村歷代祖先牌位
en: Ancestral tablets of Shangguan Village.

zh: 榜眼　上官金虹　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Jinhong, Second
Laureate.

zh: 探花　上官十六　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Shiliu, Third Laureate.

zh: 探花　上官宇　　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Yu, Third Laureate.

zh: 進士　上官文　　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Wen, Graduate.

zh: 秀才　上官任　　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Ren, Scholar.

zh: 秀才　上官志　　牌位
en: Tablet of Shangguan Zhi, Scholar.

zh: 在書架上刻有一排小字
en: A line of tiny words is carved on the
bookshelf.

zh: 古之四書，宜先讀論語，次讀孟子，
續研大學，最後再讀中庸，方可就大
成之道。
en: Of the Four Books, read the Analects first,
then Mencius, then the Great Learning, and
the Doctrine of the Mean last. Only then
can you reach greatness.

zh: 書中自有顏如玉，書中自有黃金屋。
後世子孫，慎思！慎思！必有所得
en: In books you'll find a fair maiden and a
house of gold. Descendants, think hard!
Think hard! You will be rewarded.

zh: 一個人從小到大，食衣住行育樂，生
子撫養教育，那一樣不需要錢，父母
把你們養大不易，應該好好讀書，求
取功名，不可磋跎時光，沈迷電玩。
en: Food, clothes, home, school, children: all
cost money. Your parents raised you at
great cost. Study hard, earn rank, and
don't waste time on video games.

zh: 啊！水果已經腐坯了，不能吃了
en: Ah! The fruit has gone bad. It's not edible.

zh: 這水果看起來不太新鮮，你確定你要
吃嗎？
要　　不要
en: This fruit doesn't look very fresh. Are you
sure you want to eat it?

zh: 哇！拉肚子拉得好辛苦。
en: Ugh! What a terrible stomachache.

zh: ‧‧‧可是我肚子有點餓‧‧‧
en: ...But I'm a little hungry...

zh: 大學
en: The Great Learning

zh: 顏式家訓
en: Family Instructions of the Yan Clan

zh: 老子
en: Laozi

zh: 易經
en: The Book of Changes

zh: 孟子
en: Mencius

zh: 楚辭
en: The Songs of Chu

zh: 論語
en: The Analects

zh: 莊子
en: Zhuangzi

zh: 洛書
en: The Luo River Writing

zh: 中庸
en: The Doctrine of the Mean

zh: 詩經
en: The Book of Songs

zh: 墨子
en: Mozi

zh: 村長、村長‧‧‧那個‧‧‧那個‧
en: Elder, elder... That... that...

zh: 金瓶梅
en: The Plum in the Golden Vase

zh: 自從血流星那一夜後，所有星星都不
見了。
發問　離開
en: Since the night of the blood meteor, all the
stars have vanished.
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 有什麼我可以效勞的嗎？
血流星
石碑
上官村　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Is there anything I can do for you?
{>13}Blood meteor
{>13}The tablet
{>13}Shangguan Village{>169}Leave

zh: 你要問跟石碑有関的‧‧‧
邪惡之子
摩尼日月心
離開
en: About the tablet...
{>13}The Son of Evil
{>13}Mani Heart
{>169}Leave

zh: 據李探花說，血流星是大凶之兆，而
且在百日之内，將會連續出現五個凶
兆，之後則是人間地獄的開始！唉，
這可是世界末日到了嗎？
en: Scholar Li says the blood meteor is a
terrible omen. Within a hundred days five ill
omens will appear, and then hell on earth
begins! Sigh, is this the end of the world?

zh: 這石碑是在我們古厝前面破土而出的
。唉‧‧‧這是否代表上官一族將滅
亡的凶兆呢？
en: The tablet broke out of the ground in front
of our ancestral house. Sigh... Is it an omen
that the Shangguan clan will perish?

zh: 上官村如此的文采，也逐漸被靡爛的
浮華所侵蝕‧‧‧真是今不如古啊！
en: Even Shangguan Village's fine culture is
being eaten away by decadence... Things
aren't what they used to be!

zh: 據李探花說，他似乎在那兒聽過“邪
惡之子“，但他不記得到底是在那兒
聽過的。
en: Scholar Li says he's heard of the "Son of
Evil" somewhere, but he can't remember
where.

zh: 這我就不了解了，得問李探花。
en: I don't know about that. Ask Scholar Li.

zh: 我可以參觀一下你們的古厝嗎？
en: May I visit your ancestral house?

zh: 當然可以。走吧，我現在就帶你去看
看。
en: Of course. Come, I'll show you right now.

zh: 剛剛看您神色匆匆的，是否發生了什
麼事？
en: You looked flustered just now. Has
something happened?

zh: ‧‧‧不瞞你說，我有個女兒十六歲
了，卻成天舞刀弄槍的，比男的還野
！剛剛她又在酒館裡鬧事，我趕去賠
罪，她卻怪我偏坦別人‧‧‧‧‧‧
en: ...My daughter is sixteen, yet she's always
swinging swords, wilder than any boy! She
made trouble at the tavern again. I went to
apologize and she said I took their side...

zh: 現在又不知道跑到那兒去了，唉！養
兒到底是防老，還是自我虐待啊！
en: Now who knows where she's run off to. Sigh!
Are children for comfort in old age, or for
torture?

zh: 真是取錯名字了！早聽她娘的話，叫
她“芙蓉“，而不是“芙戎“；她現
在也不會這樣成天舞刀弄槍的‧‧‧
en: I gave her the wrong name! Her mother
wanted "Furong" as in lotus, but I chose
the "rong" of war. Now she does nothing but
fight...

zh: 你見過我那野丫頭嗎？
en: Have you seen that wild girl of mine?

zh: 走開！你們這些言語乏味的無聊鬼！
en: Go away! You boring, tedious bunch!

zh: 她可真野，不是嗎？不知道現在改名
字還來不來得及？‧‧‧
en: She's really wild, isn't she? I wonder if it's
too late to change her name?...

zh: 不過你也別放在心上，她最近把她娘
死前留給她的金釵弄丟了，所以心情
特別的不好，別介意。等找著了，大
概心情會好一點吧！
en: Don't take it to heart. She recently lost
the gold hairpin her mother left her before
she died, so she's in a foul mood. Once it's
found, she'll probably cheer up!

zh: 芙蓉姑娘，聽妳爹說妳丟了一支金釵
妳出來看看是不是這一支？
en: Miss Furong, your father says you lost a
gold hairpin. Come see if this is it.

zh: 哇！太好了，我找好久了，你在那辺
找到的？
en: Wow! Great! I've looked everywhere for it.
Where did you find it?

zh: 我在火爐旁辺發現的。
en: I found it by the stove.

zh: 哦！那大概是阿花把它咬去玩的吧！
en: Oh! Ahua must have carried it off to play
with!

zh: 阿花？‧‧‧阿花是誰啊？
en: Ahua?... Who's Ahua?

zh: 哦！阿花是我爹養的一隻老貓，老是
喜歡東咬西咬的，現在也不知道窩在
那辺睡覺。不管怎樣，謝謝啦。
en: Oh! Ahua is my dad's old cat. She's always
chewing things. Who knows where she's
napping now. Anyway, thanks.

zh: 舉手之勞，何足掛齒。
en: It was nothing, really.

zh: 看不出你倒挺會說話的嘛！自從娘死
後，整天窩在村子裏也不是滋味，這
樣吧！不如跟你一同出去散散心。
en: You're quite a smooth talker! Since Mother
died, I've been stuck in this village. Tell you
what, I'll come with you and see the world.

zh: 也好，不過也得妳爹答應才行。
en: All right, but your father has to agree.

zh: 沒問題，我爹最疼我了；只要不要惹
是生非，我爹一定會答應的。
en: No problem, Dad dotes on me. As long as I
don't make trouble, he'll say yes.

zh: 咖！咖！咖！原來妳也知道自已愛惹
事。
en: Ha! Ha! Ha! So you know you love making
trouble.

zh: 你‧‧‧算了，看在找到金釵的面子
上，不跟你計較。走‧‧‧跟我去見
我爹。
en: You... Never mind. Since you found my
hairpin, I'll let it go. Come... let's go see my
dad.

zh: 爹，我想出去見見世面，好不好？
en: Dad, I want to go out and see the world. Is
that all right?

zh: 唉！妳也老大不小了，出去遊歷遊歷
也好。只是，出門不比在家，可得少
惹點事。
en: Sigh! You're old enough now. A journey might
do you good. But being away isn't like home,
so stay out of trouble.

zh: 爹！你放心，一定沒問題。
en: Dad! Don't worry, I'll be fine.

zh: 以後就麻煩你照顧我這丫頭了。
en: Please take care of my girl from now on.

zh: 伯父，你放心好了。
en: Don't worry, sir.

zh: 爹，那我們走了。
en: Dad, we're off.

zh: 出門在外，一切要當心啊！
en: Be careful out there!

zh: 唉！記得常回來看爹。
en: Sigh! Remember to come home and see your
dad often.

zh: 沈皓！需要我加入幫忙嗎？
要　　不要
en: Shen Hao! Need me to join you?

zh: 碑文上所提的“天變五禍“，古書亦
提到：“當天地出現五種不祥徵兆，
即是天下滅亡之兆。
發問　離開
en: The tablet speaks of "five woes". Old books
also say, "When five ill omens appear in
heaven and earth, the world will perish."
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道什麼呢？
血流星
石碑
天變五禍　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Blood meteor
{>13}The tablet
{>13}The five woes{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道石碑上寫的‧‧‧
邪惡之子
紅龍火
其他
en: About what's written on the tablet...
{>13}The Son of Evil
{>13}Red dragon fire
{>169}Other

zh: 関於邪惡之子，你要知道‧‧‧
摩尼日月星
我的看法
其他
en: About the Son of Evil, you want to know...
{>13}The Mani Heart
{>13}Your opinion
{>169}Other

zh: 從古自今，都認為見到流星不吉利，
再加上其色如血，更可断定其禍更凶
en: Since ancient times, meteors have been ill
omens. And one the color of blood surely
means even worse disaster.

zh: 我看那石碑雕刻的精緻及字體，不是
一般人所能製造得出來的！
en: From the fine carving and script, that
tablet is not the work of an ordinary man!

zh: 所謂的“天變五禍“就是指五種異常
的徵兆，分別是：流星、日月並出於
西方、月變色、狂風沙及月蝕！
en: The "five woes" are five strange omens: a
meteor, sun and moon together in the west,
the moon changing color, a sandstorm, and
an eclipse of the moon!

zh: 若天地現此惡兆，則必是無法挽回的
惡運。
en: If heaven and earth show these signs, the
doom cannot be undone.

zh: 哇～這麼多怎麼記得起來。
en: Whoa~ How can I remember all that?

zh: 即然你如此有心，我再說一遍好了“
天變五禍“包括：流星、狂風沙、日
月並出於西方、月變色及月蝕！唉‧
‧‧一場浩劫。
en: Since you're keen, again: the five woes are
a meteor, a sandstorm, sun and moon
together in the west, the moon changing
color, and an eclipse! Sigh... catastrophe.

zh: 你還有什麼想問的嗎？
其他　離開
en: Anything else you'd like to ask?
{>130}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 我好像在那裡聽過‧‧‧唉‧‧‧老
啦！腦筋不管用了‧‧‧到底是誰說
過呢？
en: I think I've heard it somewhere... Sigh... I'm
getting old! My memory's going... Who was it
that said it?

zh: 這句話我也參不透‧‧‧它是指碑中
那隻獸不獸、妖不妖的怪物嗎？
en: I can't make sense of that line either...
Does it mean that beast on the tablet,
neither animal nor demon?

zh: 我也正為此苦思不解‧‧‧“摩尼“
是指“宝珠“的意思；但是“日月心
“我就不了解了！
en: I've been puzzling over that too... "Mani"
means "jewel", but "heart of sun and moon"
I don't understand!

zh: 你問我的看法？‧‧‧我‧‧‧我‧
‧‧我不知道‧‧‧這‧這‧這件事
超出我的知識了。
en: My opinion?... I... I... I don't know... This...
this is beyond my knowledge.

zh: 難道‧‧‧真要大禍臨頭了？
en: Could it be... disaster really is upon us?

zh: 我想起在那裡聽過“邪惡之子“了！
上個月，我在清江城拜見明尊寺的住
持時，聽他提起過。
en: I remember where I heard "Son of Evil"! Last
month in Qingjiang City, the abbot of
Mingzun Temple mentioned it.

zh: 嗯！那天要去請教一下住持。‧‧‧
en: Hmm! I must go ask the abbot someday...

zh: 你好像不是咱們村裏的人吧！來來來
，別客氣，請坐！
發問　離開
en: You're not from our village, are you? Come,
come, don't be shy, have a seat!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你儘管問吧！
清江城
上官村
石碑　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask away!
{>13}Qingjiang City
{>13}Shangguan Village
{>13}The tablet{>169}Leave

zh: 你要問清江城的‧‧‧
怪病
住持
離開
en: About Qingjiang City...
{>13}The strange illness
{>13}The abbot
{>169}Leave

zh: 我剛從那兒過來，可真慘哪！死了不
少人呢！不過，幸虧有住持及時挽救
現在已經沒事了。
en: I just came from there. It's terrible! Many
people died! Luckily the abbot saved the
day. It's all right now.

zh: 我們這兒啊，沒啥搞頭了，跟不上時
代了嘛！現在一切都變得太快了，上
官村都跟外辺兒脫節了。
en: Nothing much happens here. We can't keep
up! Everything changes so fast now,
Shangguan Village has fallen out of touch.

zh: 這事我倒沒啥看法，反正操太多心也
沒用！誰知道明天我是否還活著呢？
‧‧‧不過我倒是對那石碑頗有興趣
，它應該能賣個好價錢。
en: I don't have an opinion. Worrying won't
help! Who knows if I'll be alive tomorrow?...
But I am quite interested in that tablet. It
should fetch a good price.

zh: 那也不是什麼病，是蛇精作祟！它噴
出的毒氣，人給那麼一碰，莫名其妙
就沒氣了！
en: It's no illness. It's a snake demon's doing!
Brush against its poison breath and you
just drop dead!

zh: 這次可多虧他了，否則清江城全城，
必毀無疑。
en: We owe him a lot this time. Without him, all of
Qingjiang would have been lost.

zh: 你要去清江城嗎？小心點，那兒還很
亂。
en: Going to Qingjiang City? Be careful, it's still
chaotic there.

zh: 房子不錯吧？我自己設計的哦！你四
處看看，沒関係！
en: Nice house, eh? I designed it myself! Look
around, it's fine!

zh: 五行拳譜
en: Five Fists manual

zh: 怎樣？小兄弟，有沒有興趣啊？我是
生意人，不懂這個；倒是對你應該很
有用哦。
買　　不買
en: Well, little brother? Interested? I'm a
merchant, I don't understand these things,
but it should be useful to you.

zh: 算你便宜點，１００銖銅錢就可以。
en: I'll give you a deal: just 100 gold.

zh: 老價錢，還是１００銖銅錢。
en: Same old price, 100 gold.

zh: 太貴了！不想買。
我是阿木的好朋友，可否算便宜點
好，買了。
en: {>13}Too expensive! No thanks.
{>13}I'm Amu's friend. Any discount?
{>13}All right, I'll take it.

zh: 對不起，親兄弟也要明算帳哪！況且
阿木那混小子，還欠我三十銖錢哩。
en: Sorry, even brothers keep accounts!
Besides, that rascal Amu still owes me 30
gold.

zh: 好，這是你的了。
en: Good, it's yours.

zh: 沒関係，不買就算了
en: No matter, forget it.

zh: 啊！你錢不夠，下次再來吧！
en: Ah! You don't have enough money. Come
again next time!

zh: 喂！小夥子！我看你應該是個識貨的
人，我這兒有個特殊的東西，你們要
不要看看？
要　　離開
en: Hey, lad! You look like a man who knows
quality. I have something special here. Want
a look?
{>130}Yes{>169}Leave

zh: 我這兒有個很好的術法叫“迷眼術法
“，據說遇到坯人的時候施展它，可
以讓敵人看不見，分不清東南西北‧
‧‧‧怎麼樣，要不要啊？‧‧‧
en: I have a fine art here called "Dazzle". They
say if you use it on bad guys, they can't
see and lose all sense of direction... Well?
Want it?...

zh: 這東西好是好，就是貴了點兒，要三
百銖銅錢，你們要嗎？
要　　不要
en: It's good, just a bit pricey: 300 gold. Want
it?

zh: 太好了，這東西屬於你們的了。
en: Wonderful, it's yours now.

zh: 沒関係，等你們湊足了錢，再來買吧
en: No matter. Come buy it when you've scraped
the money together!

zh: 你們可以到處看看。
en: Feel free to look around.

zh: 小夥子，不要惹她，她剛給老爹削了
一頓，現在心情不好。
en: Lad, don't provoke her. Her dad just gave
her an earful, she's in a bad mood.

zh: 她就是芙戎？
en: So she's Furong?

zh: 你知道我的名字？
en: You know my name?

zh: 剛剛在酒店他們談起了你，還一直誇
你呢！
en: They were talking about you in the tavern
just now. They kept praising you!

zh: 我覺得妳剛剛做的很對。
不要生氣，其実妳爹也是為你好！
其実妳可以用說的，不必動手啊！
en: {>13}I think you did the right thing.
{>13}Don't be mad, he means well!
{>13}You could have just talked!

zh: 可是我爹不分青紅皂白就罵我！
en: But my dad scolded me without even asking
what happened!

zh: 他是擔心妳吧，所以才會生氣！
en: He was worried about you. That's why he
got angry!

zh: 是啊！我老讓他擔心。
en: Yes! I'm always making him worry.

zh: 對了，你是誰？怎麼會來上官村的？
en: By the way, who are you? What brings you
to Shangguan Village?

zh: 我姓沈名皓，我要去清江城找個人。
en: My name is Shen Hao. I'm going to Qingjiang
City to find someone.

zh: 我叫方天弓，我們是從小一齊長大的
啦。我們是出來闖闖世面，開開眼界
en: I'm Fang Tiangong. We grew up together.
We're off to see the world and broaden our
horizons!

zh: 我可以跟你們一起去嗎？我也想看看
上官村以外的地方！
en: Can I come with you? I want to see what's
outside Shangguan Village too!

zh: 可是....妳是女生....
en: But... you're a girl...

zh: 女生有什麼差別？打起架來我不一定
輸你的！拜託啦！我絕對不會拖累你
們的，好嗎？
好　　不好
en: What difference does that make? In a fight I
could beat you! Please! I won't hold you
back, I promise. OK?

zh: 太好了！待會兒我們村口見！
en: Great! See you at the village gate!

zh: 算了！大不了我自個兒去！
en: Fine! I'll just go on my own!

zh: 我知道啊！但是他總不聽我說！
en: I know! But he never listens to me!

zh: 他也是擔心你啊！
en: He's worried about you too!

zh: 他到底是你父親，說幾句也是應該的
en: He is your father. It's only right for him to
scold you a bit.

zh: 是啊！再怎麼樣，他也是很疼我的。
en: Yes! Whatever happens, he really loves me.

zh: 我才不信你真的那麼乖！說的比做的
好聽！
en: I don't believe you're really that
well-behaved! Easier said than done!

zh: 我看那天別人欺負到你頭上的時候，
你再跟我說用講的吧！
en: Tell me to talk it out the day someone
bullies you!

zh: 啊！你錢不夠，下次再來吧！
en: Ah! You don't have enough money. Come
again next time!

zh: 客官您是要‧‧‧？
買賣
交談
離開
en: What can I do for you?
{>13}Trade
{>13}Talk
{>169}Leave

zh: 觀迎光臨，休息只要１０銖錢，很便
宜的啦‧‧‧
要　　不要
en: Welcome! A rest is only 10 gold, very
cheap...

zh: 那你好好休息吧！但請不要打擾到其
他的客人。
en: Then have a good rest! But please don't
disturb the other guests.

zh: 好吧！那也不打緊。不過，看客官您
大概是從外地來的吧！還是充分地休
息一下比較好。
en: All right, no matter. But you look like
you've come from far away. You'd better
get a good rest!

zh: 整間旅館空洞洞的，我猜我是唯一被
騙來的旅客。
en: The whole inn is empty. I bet I'm the only
guest who got suckered in.

zh: 啊！你錢不夠吧？！下次再來吧！
en: Ah! Not enough money?! Come again next
time!

zh: 小兄弟！你幾歲了？未滿十八歲是不
能喝酒的！
en: Little brother! How old are you? No drinking
under eighteen!

zh: 搞不懂你，酒館有什麼好看的，不過
是一群醉鬼罷了。
en: I don't get you. What's there to see in a
tavern? Just a bunch of drunks.

zh: 喂！出去！出去！我最討厭別人說謊
了！
en: Hey! Out! Out! I hate liars!

zh: 我已經十八歲了。
我不喝酒，只是進來看看。
我進來找人的。
en: {>13}I'm already eighteen.
{>13}I don't drink. Just looking.
{>13}I'm looking for someone.

zh: 那麻煩給我看一下你的証件。
en: Then show me your ID, please.

zh: 這個時代還有「証件」這回事啊？
en: They have "ID" in this day and age?

zh: 每個朝代都有！去去去！年紀輕輕的
就想喝酒！
en: Every dynasty has it! Shoo, shoo! So young
and already wanting to drink!

zh: 好吧，那你隨意看看吧。
en: All right, look around as you like.

zh: 好吧，不准逗留太久。
en: All right, but don't stay long.

zh: ‧‧我好像見過你‧‧‧剛剛‧‧‧
咦！‧‧你是誰？‧‧哦！我叫清柏
揚！唉‧‧‧傷心橋下春波綠　曾是
驚鴻照影來‧‧‧唉！‧‧‧
en: ...Seen you... somewhere... Who are you?...
Oh! I'm Qing Boyang! Sigh... "Green waves
beneath the Bridge of Sorrow, where once
her lovely image shone..." Sigh!...

zh: 你知道我為何要喝酒嗎？‧‧‧因為
我總覺得人生好像那裡不對勁‧‧‧
老覺得人生無力‧‧‧
en: You know why I drink?... Because I always
feel something's wrong with life... I always
feel so powerless...

zh: 無力感，你懂嗎？‧‧‧無力啊‧‧
en: Powerlessness, you know?... So powerless...

zh: 小子！你撞我幹嘛？想死啊？滾開！
en: Kid! Why'd you bump into me? Want to die?
Get lost!

zh: 走開！惹火了我，小心挨揍！
en: Go away! Make me mad and you'll get a
beating!

zh: 小兄弟，外地來的吧？
en: Little brother, from out of town?

zh: 小子！一表人材哦！
en: Kid! You're a handsome one!

zh: 哇！剛剛真精彩！可惜你沒看到！剛
才芙戎把一個醉漢給打得落荒而逃！
發問　離開
en: Wow! That was something! Too bad you
missed it! Furong just beat a drunk so
badly he ran for his life!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 芙戎是村長的掌上明珠，偏偏個性像
男的，喜歡打抱不平。她老爹為她可
傷透腦筋了！
en: Furong is the elder's darling daughter, but
she acts like a boy and loves to stand up
for the weak. Her old man is at his wits'
end!

zh: 那人不是我們村上的，是個無賴！
en: He's not from our village. He's a hoodlum!

zh: 剛才那醉漢想對李大嫂毛手毛腳，結
果被芙戎修理了一頓，趕出村去了！
en: That drunk tried to grope Mrs. Li, so Furong
gave him a thrashing and ran him out of the
village!

zh: 剛剛村長趕來，氣芙戎又打架，把她
罵了一頓，現在不知跑那兒去了。
en: The elder rushed over, furious that Furong
was fighting again, and scolded her. Now who
knows where she's gone.

zh: 其実我蠻喜歡芙戎的，可惜生錯女兒
身了，不然她真能做出大事業來！
en: I really like Furong. Too bad she was born a
girl, or she could do great things!

zh: 如果你見到她，你一定會喜歡這娃兒
的！
en: If you meet her, you'll like her for sure!

zh: ‧‧‧我想，如果我能像芙戎一樣有
武功，我就不會這麼無力了‧‧‧你
認為呢？
en: ...I think if I knew kung fu like Furong, I
wouldn't feel so powerless... What do you
think?

zh: 剛剛看芙戎修理那傢伙，真替我們女
性同胞狠狠的出了口氣！真痛快！
發問　離開
en: Watching Furong thrash that guy was a real
blow for us women! So satisfying!
