zh: 她是村長的獨生女，個性直爽，看不
順眼的事就會出面主持正義。村裡每
個都喜歡她；偏偏唯一死對頭是她老
爹。
en: She's the elder's only daughter, frank, and
always stands up for what's right.
Everyone loves her, except her one sworn
enemy: her old man.

zh: 芙戎從小就喜歡舞刀弄劍的，還曾拜
過師呢！她是我們村裡武功最好的。
en: Furong has loved swordplay since she was
little. She even trained under a master!
She's the best fighter in our village.

zh: 小夥子，你真該見見芙戎。
en: Lad, you really should meet Furong.

zh: 我不是沒角的羊！
en: I'm not a hornless sheep!

zh: 沒吃過馬肉，也看馬跑路吧！
en: I may not have eaten horse, but I've seen
one run!

zh: 對了，還得等張伯父回來。
en: Right, we still have to wait for Uncle Zhang
to come back.

zh: 最近常在半夜聽見樹林中，傳來女子
哭聲；其中必有古怪。
en: Lately a woman's crying has been heard in
the woods at midnight. Something strange is
going on.

zh: ‧‧‧咦！人怎麼不見了，其中必有
蹊蹺！
en: ...Huh! Where did she go? Something fishy is
going on!

zh: 他們又在幹什麼坯事了？偷偷跟過去
看看吧！
en: What dirty work are they up to now? Let's
sneak after them and see!

zh: 咦！怎麼門後有聲音？
en: Huh! Is that a noise behind the door?

zh: 趕快找個地方躲起來！
en: Quick, let's find somewhere to hide!

zh: ‧‧邪惡‧‧邪惡的力量！‧‧啊‧‧
你是‧‧
en: ...Evil... an evil power!... Ah... you are...

zh: 老婆婆，你在說什麼啊？！‧‧‧
en: Granny, what are you saying?!...

zh: ‧‧‧惡魔之子！！‧‧‧邪惡啊！‧
en: ...Child of the devil!!... Evil!...

zh: ‧‧‧這到底是怎麼一回事啊？！
en: ...What on earth is going on?!

zh: 林中傳來“‧嗚‧‧嗚“怪聲
en: An eerie "...ooh... ooh..." comes from the
woods.

zh: 怎麼會有如此淒厲的哀嚎聲？‧‧‧
en: Why such a ghastly wailing?...

zh: 原來他們兩個都是妖怪所變！
en: So both of them were monsters in disguise!

zh: 有什麼想問的呢？
清江城
明尊寺
邪惡之子　　　　　　　　離開
en: What would you like to ask?
{>13}Qingjiang City
{>13}Mingzun Temple
{>13}The Son of Evil{>169}Leave

zh: 沒聽過這種東西，那可以吃嗎？
en: Never heard of it. Can you eat it?

zh: 清江城
en: Qingjiang City

zh: 咦！爹怎麼還沒來，還是回伯父家等
等看‧‧‧順便看看這城還有啥新鮮
事。
en: Huh! Father still isn't here. I'll wait at
Uncle's house... and see what else is new in
town.

zh: 對了，還得等伯父回來；還是先在城
裏，到處看看‧‧‧
en: Right, I still have to wait for Uncle to come
back. I'll look around town first...

zh: 哦！差點忘了要將信交給張伯父－張
看。
en: Oh! I almost forgot to give the letter to
Uncle Zhang, Zhang Kan.

zh: 救命啊！我不要！我不要！‧‧‧
en: Help! No! I won't go! I won't!...

zh: 少囉嗦！你爹已經把你賣給李員外了
en: Shut up! Your father sold you to Squire Li!

zh: 不是的！你們騙人！
en: That's not true! You're lying!

zh: 還跟她囉嗦什麼？！拖走啦！
en: Why argue with her?! Drag her off!

zh: 救命啊！我不要！我不要！
en: Help! No! I won't go!

zh: 臭小子！你找死啊！還不給我滾開！
en: Brat! You want to die? Get out of the way!

zh: 你們眼中難道沒有王法嗎？
有話好說嘛！
‧‧‧對不起！對不起！
en: {>13}Have you no respect for the law?
{>13}Let's talk this over!
{>13}...Sorry! Sorry!

zh: 老詞了！換一句好嗎？
en: Same old line! Got anything new?

zh: 你吃了熊心豹子膽啦！敢管我們李府
的閒事。
en: You've got some nerve, poking your nose
into the Li household's business.

zh: 壯士救命啊！是他們誆人！
en: Help me, sir! They're lying!

zh: 小兄弟！少管閒事！快讓開！
en: Little brother! Mind your own business! Out
of the way!

zh: 管不管這檔事呢？
管　　不管
en: Should we get involved?
{>130}Help{>169}Ignore

zh: 放過她！
en: Let her go!

zh: 喲！想英雄救美啊！哼！
en: Oho! Playing the hero for a pretty girl!
Hmph!

zh: 古有明訓，多一事不如少一事。
en: As the ancients taught, the less trouble the
better.

zh: 救命啊！
en: Help!

zh: 臭小子！你竟敢管李府的事！走著瞧
en: Brat! You dare meddle with the Li household!
You'll pay for this!

zh: 謝謝你們救我！若是給他們抓進李員
外那裏，那我寧可死了算了！
發問　離開
en: Thank you for saving me! If they'd taken
me to Squire Li, I'd rather have died!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼，儘管問吧！
李員外
被抓的原因
清江城　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask whatever you want to know!
{>13}Squire Li
{>13}Why they took you
{>13}Qingjiang City{>169}Leave

zh: 你要知道清江城的‧‧‧
住持
張看
其他
en: About Qingjiang City...
{>13}The abbot
{>13}Zhang Kan
{>169}Other

zh: 他就住在城西，我們城裏最最豪華的
住宅！他是我們這兒的首富－－－也
是本城的首惡。
en: He lives in the west of the city, in the
grandest house in town! He's our richest
man, and our worst villain.

zh: 前陣子因為急用，我爹向他借了三百
銖錢，沒想到後來，他卻說我們向他
借的是一千多銖錢！－－我們那裏來
那麼多錢還呢？‧‧‧
en: A while ago my father urgently needed 300
gold and borrowed it from him. Later he
claimed we owed over 1000! Where would we
get that much money?...

zh: 所以他就逼我父親，強擄我來抵債。
en: So he pressured my father and seized me to
pay the debt.

zh: 太過份了！簡直是目無法紀嘛！
en: That's outrageous! He has no respect for
the law!

zh: 有什麼辦法，他手下一批惡徒！打不
過他們，而且其中還有不少江湖人物
，只好忍氣吞聲的過。
en: What can we do? He has a gang of thugs,
too many to fight, including some hardened
fighters. We just have to swallow it.

zh: 或許你也聽說前陣子妖怪的事情，唉
‧‧‧其実活下來的也未必幸福啊！
en: You may have heard about the monster
recently. Sigh... surviving isn't always a
blessing!

zh: 清江城還好有住持在，是我們僅存的
希望呢！你一定要去明尊寺拜見他！
en: Luckily Qingjiang has the abbot. He's our
last hope! You must go pay your respects
at Mingzun Temple!

zh: ‧‧‧張看‧‧‧對不起，我沒聽過
這個人。
en: ...Zhang Kan... Sorry, I've never heard of
him.

zh: 李員外一定會找你們麻煩的，我勸你
們快離開這裡吧。大恩大德，小女子
必定牢記於心！
en: Squire Li will surely come after you. You'd
better leave quickly. I'll never forget your
kindness!

zh: ‧‧‧你？‧‧‧你要幹嘛？我沒有
惹你啊！‧‧‧
en: ...You?... What do you want? I didn't do
anything to you!...

zh: 奇怪？他怎麼啦？我們又沒怎樣？
怎麼一副我們要吃了他的樣子。
en: Weird. What's with him? We didn't do
anything. He looks like we're going to eat
him.

zh: 你是外地人吧？這時節出門在外的
，最好到城北的明尊寺去上上香，
祈禱菩薩保佑吧！
發問　離開
en: You're not from here, are you? In times like
these, go burn incense at Mingzun Temple in
the north and pray!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼？
清江城
明尊寺
張看　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Qingjiang City
{>13}Mingzun Temple
{>13}Zhang Kan{>169}Leave

zh: 這裡最近不太平靜，一切還是小心點
吧！
en: Things aren't too peaceful here lately. Be
careful!

zh: 明尊寺的住持是活菩薩轉世，法力無
辺，不但替人消災祈福，且還能知過
去断未來呢！
en: The abbot of Mingzun Temple is a living
bodhisattva with boundless power. He wards
off disaster, and he can see the past and
future!

zh: ‧‧‧不知道這個人呢‧‧‧
en: ...Don't know him...

zh: 多一事不如少一事，記住啊！
en: The less trouble the better. Remember that!

zh: 小兄弟，給點過路費吧。
給　　不給
en: Little brother, pay the toll.
{>130}Pay{>169}Refuse

zh: 損失十銖銅錢
en: Lost 10 gold.

zh: 嗯，蠻識時務的。小兄弟，給你個忠
告：這城裡最近蠻亂的，所以還是小
心點啊！咖咖！
en: Mm, you know what's good for you. A word
of advice, kid: this town's been pretty rough
lately, so watch yourself! Heh heh!

zh: 啊？！那我只好自己拿啦！
en: What?! Then I'll just help myself!

zh: 這城到底怎麼回事啊？
en: What's wrong with this city?

zh: 走開！走開！你活得不耐煩啦！
en: Go away! Go away! Tired of living?

zh: 年輕人，你不是這裏人吧。碰到那李
李員外的打手，還是躲著點吧，否則
小心惹禍上身。
發問　離開
en: Young man, you're not from here. If you
meet Squire Li's thugs, stay out of their
way, or you'll be asking for trouble.
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼？
李員外
打手
張看　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Squire Li
{>13}His thugs
{>13}Zhang Kan{>169}Leave

zh: 唉....這就別提了。
en: Sigh... Don't ask.

zh: 反正避著點兒就對了！
en: Just keep out of their way!

zh: ‧‧‧啊‧‧我‧我不知道‧‧‧
en: ...Ah... I... I don't know...

zh: 不對勁！我覺得這個地方很不對勁。
en: Something's off! Something about this place
is very wrong.

zh: 我也是這樣認為！尤其是這裏的人，
都皺著眉頭，表情好怪哦‧‧‧
en: I think so too! Especially the people here,
all frowning. Their faces are so strange...

zh: 真是一個很奇怪的城市。
en: What a strange city.

zh: 什麼也沒聽到，‧‧‧沒聽到‧‧‧
給我滾開‧‧‧沒聽到，沒聽到‧‧
en: ...Nobody's... home... I didn't hear anything...
didn't hear... Go away... didn't hear, didn't
hear...

zh: 太感謝你們了！幫我們趕走大坯蛋！
我在想，難道那些失蹤的人不是李員
外捉去的嗎？
en: Thank you so much for driving out the
scoundrel! I wonder... weren't the missing
people taken by Squire Li?

zh: 你認為那些失蹤的人去那裡了呢？
en: Where do you think the missing people went?

zh: 住在這房子的男子有點怪怪的，他
老說聽見女鬼的哭聲！
en: The man who lives in this house is a bit odd.
He keeps saying he hears a ghost woman
crying!

zh: 趕緊去廟裡求個平安符吧！最近常有
人夜裡聽到鬼哭的聲音呢！
en: Hurry and get a charm at the temple!
People often hear ghosts crying at night
lately!

zh: 你相信世界上有鬼嗎？
en: Do you believe in ghosts?

zh: 我媽說明尊寺的住持是活菩薩！
en: My mom says the abbot of Mingzun Temple is
a living bodhisattva!

zh: 請問你有沒有看到我家小妹？她已經
失蹤二個月了！
en: Have you seen my little sister? She's been
missing for two months!

zh: 怎麼會呢？住持竟然是妖怪所變？！
en: How can it be? The abbot was a monster in
disguise?!

zh: 為什麼到處都是仿冒品啊？現在竟然
到了連和尚都有人要假冒的地步了！
en: Why is everything counterfeit these days?
Now people even fake being monks!

zh: 原來我們一直被妖怪給朦在鼓裡
en: So the monster had us fooled all along.

zh: 太感謝你了！要不是你，我們還不知
要被騙到何時呢！
en: Thank you so much! If not for you, who
knows how long we'd have been fooled!

zh: ‧‧‧你亂說話，住持是大好人呢！
en: ...Don't talk nonsense, the abbot is a good
man!...

zh: 聽說你是打妖怪的英雄，真的嗎？！
en: They say you're a hero who fights monsters.
Is it true?!

zh: 你是什ㄇㄚ東西，這地方是你能來逛
的嗎？
en: What the heck are you? This is no place for
you to wander!

zh: 你要做什麼！閒雜人等不准逗留！
en: What do you want! No loitering!

zh: 叫姓李的滾出來！
我想求見李員外。
對不起，我馬上離開。
en: {>13}Tell Li to get out here!
{>13}I'd like to see Squire Li.
{>13}Sorry, I'll leave at once.

zh: 小子！找死！
en: Brat! You asked for it!

zh: 不見！不見！李員外那有空見你們這
些傢伙！走開！
en: No! No! Squire Li has no time for the likes of
you! Go away!

zh: 就是他們，在城門口管閒事的就是他
們。
en: That's them! They're the ones who meddled
at the city gate.

zh: 小子！活得不耐煩啦！
en: Brat! Tired of living?

zh: 對不起，我帶個朋友來見李員外。
en: Excuse me, I've brought a friend to see
Squire Li.

zh: 好吧。進去吧。
en: All right. Go in.

zh: 咦？
en: Huh?

zh: 人怎麼不見了？
en: Where did he go?

zh: 哼！不給這些仗勢欺人的鼠輩一點顏
色看不行，順便看看那個姓李的是什
麼三頭六臂的人。
en: Hmph! These bullying rats need a lesson.
And let's see what kind of superman this Li
is.

zh: 算你厲害！有種就別進來。
en: Big talker! Don't come in if you dare.

zh: 沒人在家
en: No one is home.

zh: 哼！又是你們來搗亂！
en: Hmph! You again, making trouble!

zh: 看來人口失蹤的案件，全是你們這些
人面獸心的畜生所為；只是沒想到人
人敬仰的住持，也是一丘之貉，看來
饒不得你們‧‧‧
en: So all these disappearances were the work
of you beasts in human skin. Who'd have
thought the revered abbot was one of you
too. You won't be spared...

zh: 上次的事還沒算清，三番兩次坯我的
生意，這次就把你們的人頭留下，算
是還上次的債吧！把命留下‧‧‧
en: We haven't settled last time, and you keep
ruining my business! This time leave your
heads here to pay off the debt! Your lives
are mine...

zh: 臭小子給我記住！
en: Brats, you'll remember this!

zh: 多謝各位公子相救！
en: Thank you for saving us, sirs!

zh: 啊！員外，有人從密道追來了。
en: Ah! Squire, someone's followed us through
the secret passage.

zh: 給我殺！
en: Kill them!

zh: 現在沒事了，諸位趕緊從秘道回家吧
en: It's all right now. Everyone hurry home
through the secret passage!

zh: 唉！沒想到住持竟是與李員外狼狽為
en: Sigh! Who'd have thought the abbot was in
league with Squire Li...

zh: 嚇我一跳，我還不想那麼早結婚。
en: That gave me a fright. I'm not ready to get
married yet.

zh: 這年頭，到處都是仿冒品，現在竟到
了連和尚都有人要仿冒；難怪３０１
的陰影一直揮之不去‧‧‧
en: Everything's counterfeit these days. Now
people even fake being monks. No wonder
trade sanctions keep looming over us...

zh: 小妹啊！妳在那裡啊？！
en: Little sister! Where are you?!

zh: 咦！住持怎麼不在寺裏？請問住持
大師在那兒？
en: Huh! The abbot isn't in the temple? Where
might the abbot be?

zh: 住持大師剛剛外出了！
en: The abbot has just gone out!

zh: 這尊菩薩非常靈驗呢！你要虔誠的膜
拜！
發問　離開
en: This bodhisattva answers prayers! You must
worship devoutly!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼？
住持
怪病
張看　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}The abbot
{>13}The illness
{>13}Zhang Kan{>169}Leave

zh: 你想問什麼？
住持
怪病
邪惡之子　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to ask?
{>13}The abbot
{>13}The illness
{>13}The Son of Evil{>169}Leave

zh: 說起住持真是個大菩薩！這次多虧他
了，他可說是我們的再世父母呢！
en: The abbot is a true bodhisattva! We owe him
everything this time. He's like a second
parent to us!

zh: ‧‧‧說起來可傷心呢！‧‧‧我的
丈夫就被那妖怪給害死了‧‧‧嗚‧
en: ...It's such a sad story!... My husband was
killed by that monster... Sob...

zh: 對不起，沒聽說過這個人。
en: Sorry, never heard of him.

zh: 你說什麼？！我從來沒聽過這東西！
en: What did you say?! I've never heard of such
a thing!

zh: 你知道嗎？我孩子生病，怎麼治都治
不好，後來還是住持加持，我孩子的
病才好了！
en: You know, my child was sick and nothing
could cure him. Then the abbot blessed him,
and he got well!

zh: 南無阿彌陀佛‧‧‧
en: Namo Amitabha...

zh: 你拜見過這寺的住持了嗎？
發問　離開
en: Have you paid your respects to the abbot
of this temple?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 有什麼要問的嗎？
住持
怪病
張看　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Anything you want to ask?
{>13}The abbot
{>13}The illness
{>13}Zhang Kan{>169}Leave

zh: 想知道什麼？
住持
怪病
邪惡之子　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}The abbot
{>13}The illness
{>13}The Son of Evil{>169}Leave

zh: 住持以前就警告我們要多積福德，否
則必有大禍降臨！但我們偏偏執迷不
悟，所以才招致大禍啊！
en: The abbot always warned us to do good
deeds, or disaster would come! But we
wouldn't listen, and so disaster struck!

zh: 住持說這次雖然沒事了，但如果不虔
誠禮佛積福德，那麼還是會有下次的
en: The abbot says it's over for now, but if we
don't worship and do good deeds, it will
happen again!
...Ah... N-no... n-never heard of it...

zh: 又是這麼奇怪的表情‧‧‧
en: That strange look again...

zh: 邪‧惡‧之‧子‧‧‧好像聽過住持
提過！好像是說如果不趕緊積福德的
話，天下要完蛋了！
en: Son... of... Evil... I think the abbot mentioned
it! He said that if we don't do good deeds
quickly, the world is doomed!

zh: 記得一定要去拜見住持啊！
en: Be sure to pay your respects to the abbot!

zh: 今天我把心愛的娃娃供養給菩薩了！
因為我沒有錢，所以只有把娃娃送給
菩薩！你呢？
en: Today I offered my favorite doll to the
bodhisattva! I have no money, so I gave my
doll! What about you?

zh: 媽媽說供養菩薩，菩薩會保佑我們！
你們要不要供養一點呢？
en: Mom says if we make offerings, the
bodhisattva will protect us! Want to make
an offering?

zh: 阿彌陀佛！施主，來上香嗎？
en: Amitabha! Have you come to burn incense,
sir?

zh: 聽人提起住持的高僧風範，所以特來
參拜！
en: I heard of the abbot's holy virtue, so I
came to pay my respects!

zh: 不敢！不敢！請問貧僧能為您效勞什
麼嗎？
發問　離開
en: You flatter me! How may this humble monk
serve you?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 可有貧僧為你解惑之處？
怪病
石碑
邪惡之子　　　　　　　　離開
en: How may this humble monk help you?
{>13}The illness
{>13}The tablet
{>13}The Son of Evil{>169}Leave

zh: 您想知道関於怪病的‧‧‧
妖蛇
法力
其他
en: About the illness...
{>13}The snake demon
{>13}Your powers
{>169}Other

zh: 您想了解関於邪惡之子？
邪惡之子的出世
阻止的方法
其他
en: About the Son of Evil?
{>13}His coming
{>13}How to stop it
{>169}Other

zh: 說來慚愧！貧僧德淺，所以讓那妖蛇
作祟，殘害眾生！幸菩薩保佑，所以
終於能將那妖蛇斬除！
en: I'm ashamed! My virtue is shallow, so the
snake demon ran wild and harmed the people!
By the Buddha's grace, I finally slew it!

zh: 那蛇妖事実上已經潛伏很久了！但苦
無時機作怪！但因人間的善惡顛倒，
正義不彰，以致妖氣增長，使得它得
以出世害人！
en: The snake demon had lurked a long time,
waiting for its chance! But with good and
evil reversed and justice failing, demonic
power grew and let it loose!

zh: 施主笑話了！貧僧那來的法力呢？只
不過是會唸幾句經、拜幾下佛罷了！
en: You jest, sir! What powers would I have? I
just recite a few sutras and bow to the
Buddha!

zh: 我也聽聞上官村的石碑之事！唉！！
看來這世間的一場浩劫終究是避免不
了啦！
en: I've heard about the tablet in Shangguan
Village too! Sigh!! It seems this world's
great catastrophe cannot be avoided!

zh: 傳說中有一個黑暗的兒子“邪惡之子
“，它擁有能夠集結人、獸、鬼、妖
、魔五界的力量，若是它一旦出世，
則天地哭泣，惡長善消！
en: Legend tells of a son of darkness, the "Son
of Evil", who can gather the power of men,
beasts, ghosts, fiends and demons. If he is
born, heaven will weep, and evil will rise!

zh: 整個世界也都將淪落於妖魔的控制，
人類與正義都將變得微不足道了‧‧
en: The whole world will fall under the demons'
control, and humanity and justice will count
for nothing...

zh: 當人們開始互相殘殺，仇恨的怨力將
越滾越大！天地的運行開始顛倒，天
災人禍不断不断！....當時機成熟時
，天地將出現五個噩兆！‧‧‧
en: As people kill each other, their hatred grows
and grows! Heaven and earth turn upside
down, disaster follows disaster!... When the
time is ripe, five dread omens appear!...

zh: 此時即為邪惡之子出世之時機，同時
，也就註定了人界毀滅的命運了！
en: That is when the Son of Evil will be born,
and the human world's doom will be sealed!

zh: ‧‧‧唉‧‧‧現今只能盡人事了‧
‧‧孤力難回天啊！
en: ...Sigh... All we can do now is our best... One
man alone can't turn back heaven!

zh: 施主氣宇不凡，必非池中之物，假以
時日，必定轟風雲而動天地。但施主
須注意：近日内諸事莫理，閒事少管
，否則將惹禍上身！
en: You have a rare air, sir. In time you will
shake heaven and earth. But beware: for
now, stay out of others' affairs, or you'll
bring disaster on yourself!

zh: 記住啊！閒事少管，否則會惹上殺身
之禍啊！
en: Remember! Mind your own business, or it may
cost you your life!

zh: 對不起，施主，請止步。此為内殿僧
人清修之所，不接受探訪。請見諒。
en: Sorry, sir, please stop. This is the inner hall
where the monks meditate. No visitors.
Please forgive us.

zh: 施主，請止步。内院不開放參觀。
en: Please stop, sir. The inner court is closed to
visitors.

zh: 媽媽說，騙人的只是妖怪住持，菩薩
是會保佑好孩子的。
en: Mom says only the monster abbot was a liar.
The bodhisattva still protects good children.

zh: 沒想到，這個怪物竟冒充高僧騙了咱
們這麼久，活該遭天譴，一定是老天
爺可憐咱們，要各位大俠來剷除妖魔
的。
en: Who'd have thought that monster posed as a
holy monk and fooled us so long! Heaven will
punish it. Surely heaven took pity on us and
sent you heroes to wipe out the demons.

zh: 真謝謝你們，幫清江城除了大患。
en: Thank you so much for ridding Qingjiang City
of this scourge.

zh: 你知道嗎？我常常聽到女鬼的哭聲呢
！忽近忽遠的，也不知道聲音是從那
兒來的，挻嚇人的呢！‧‧‧
en: You know what? I often hear a ghost woman
crying! Near, then far. I can't tell where it
comes from. It's terrifying!...

zh: 你們說！我是不是瘋了？！他們都說
我瘋了。
en: Tell me! Am I crazy?! They all say I'm
crazy.

zh: 我早就知道後面這片樹林不對勁了！
哼！早聽我的就沒錯了！
en: I always knew the woods out back weren't
right! Hmph! If only they'd listened to me!

zh: 嘿！嘿！小子！還挺有種的嘛！敢闖
我李家大宅！
en: Heh! Heh! Brat! You've got guts, barging
into my mansion!

zh: 多行不義必自斃！今天我就替天行道
來教訓教訓你這魚肉鄉民的害蟲。
en: Evil brings its own ruin! Today I'll carry
out heaven's justice and teach you a
lesson, you leech who preys on the people!

zh: 嘿嘿嘿‧‧‧年輕人，嚣張的人注定
活不長久的。來人啊！統統給我上‧
en: Heh heh heh... Young man, the arrogant
never live long. Men! Get them, all of you...

zh: 武器店老闆說，要特別的貨，叫我來
見見您。
en: The weapon shop owner said to come see you
for special goods.

zh: 小夥子，你對我的貨很感興趣，是嗎
en: Lad, you're very interested in my goods,
aren't you?

zh: 是啊，希望員外能讓我們開開眼界
哼！我們對修理你更有興趣
en: {>13}Yes, please show us something new.
{>13}Hmph! We'd rather show you a beating.

zh: 好！開眼界！好！我就讓你們開眼界
！來人啊！給我包圍起來！
en: Good! Something new! Fine! I'll show you
something new! Men! Surround them!

zh: 啊！？這就是你們的待客之道？
en: What?! Is this how you treat guests?

zh: 咖咖咖！別以為我不知道你們心底在
打什麼鬼主意，我早就注意你們很久
給我上‧‧‧
en: Ha ha ha! Don't think I don't know what
you're scheming. I've had my eye on you a
long time. Get them...

zh: 我早知道你們不懷好意了！給我上，
一個也別留下‧‧‧
en: I knew you were up to no good! Get them!
Leave no one alive...

zh: 一群沒用的東西‧‧‧咦？！這姓李
的居然趁亂逃跑了。
en: Useless bunch... Huh?! That Li slipped away
in the confusion.

zh: 員外，我們老闆叫我帶人來見您。那
人帶到了，我先回去了。免得咱老闆
又唸唸唸‧‧‧要趁機扣錢‧‧‧告
辭了。
en: Squire, my boss told me to bring this man to
you. Here he is. I'll be off, or the boss will
nag and nag... and dock my pay... Goodbye.

zh: 我們四處搜搜看吧！
en: Let's search around!

zh: 滾開！你們死心吧！我永遠不會說的
en: Get away! Give up! I'll never tell!

zh: 你是誰？怎麼會在這裏？
en: Who are you? Why are you here?

zh: ‧‧‧那姓李的人呢？！‧‧‧
en: ...Where's that Li?!...

zh: 我們不是李員外的人，事実上他剛剛
被我們打跑了。請問您是‧‧‧
en: We're not Squire Li's men. In fact, we just
drove him off. May I ask who you are...

zh: 張看‧‧‧我叫張看。
en: Zhang Kan... My name is Zhang Kan.

zh: 啊！原來是張世伯，我找您找得好久
了，沒想到竟在這裏見面。
en: Ah! Uncle Zhang! I've been looking for you
so long. Who'd have thought we'd meet here!

zh: ‧‧‧你叫我世伯？！你是‧‧‧
en: ...You call me Uncle?! You are...

zh: 我叫沈皓，家父沈君平，交代小姪來
找您的‧‧‧
en: I'm Shen Hao. My father, Shen Junping,
sent me to find you...
...Ah!... At last...

zh: 啊！淨顧著說話‧‧‧，我先把您救
出來吧！
en: Oh! Here I am chatting... Let me get you out
first!

zh: 咦！這門鎖撞不開。
en: Huh! This lock won't break.

zh: 這鎖聽他們說是千年寒鉄打造，沒那
麼容易撞開，這鎖匙一定是在大廳，
去找找吧。
en: I hear this lock is made of thousand-year
cold iron. It won't break easily. The key
must be in the main hall. Go look for it.

zh: 我們先離開這裏再說吧！
en: Let's get out of here first!

zh: 此門上鎖
en: This door is locked.

zh: 發現一個按鈕，你要按下嗎？
要　　不要
en: You find a button. Press it?

zh: 整個按鈕開始往下沉
en: The whole button begins to sink.

zh: 嚇一跳，這佛殿一定有什麼秘密，到
處看看吧！
en: That startled me. This shrine must hold some
secret. Let's look around!

zh: 啊！竟然會來到這種地方‧‧‧
en: What! So this is where it leads...

zh: 這是那個笨蛋，走前也不會把爐火熄
掉，真是浪費人家的柴火‧‧‧
en: What fool left without putting out the fire?
What a waste of firewood...

zh: 有人闖進來‧‧‧
en: Intruders...

zh: 我說這廟一定有問題。
en: I said there was something wrong with this
temple.

zh: 你說出家人綁架女人，太誇張了吧！
en: Monks kidnapping women? That's going too
far!

zh: 我們去查查看就知道了。
en: We'll find out if we look into it.

zh: 你有沒有看到我的女兒？她已經失蹤
三天了！請幫幫忙‧‧‧
en: Have you seen my daughter? She's been
missing three days! Please help...

zh: 啊！太感謝了！我女兒一直在說著沒
機會謝謝恩公，感到很遺憾！小珠！
快出來謝謝大恩人哪！
en: Ah! Thank you so much! My daughter kept
saying how sorry she was not to thank you!
Xiaozhu! Come out and thank our savior!

zh: 謝謝你！沒有你，小女子這輩子就毀
了！
en: Thank you! Without you, my life would have
been ruined!

zh: 恩公如你不嫌棄，老朽想將小女高攀
，但不知恩公意下如何？
en: If you don't object, sir, this old man would
be honored to give you my daughter's hand.
What do you say?

zh: 啊？！‧‧‧對不起，我還有許多事
‧‧‧所以‧‧對不起啦！！
en: What?!... Sorry, I have a lot to do... so...
sorry!!

zh: 這裏有封信是家父交代，一定得交到
您手上。我爹說，他事情辦完後，就
會來這兒與您見面。
en: Here's a letter my father said I must put in
your hands. He said once his business is
done, he'll come meet you here.

zh: 太好了！‧‧‧讓我看看你爹信中寫
些什麼‧‧‧
en: Wonderful!... Let me see what your father
wrote...

zh: 把信交給張看閱讀
en: Gave the letter to Zhang Kan.

zh: 好‧‧‧我知道了，不如現在你們休
息一下吧！還是要去逛逛也可以，不
過待會兒一定要再過來；我先出去處
理一點事‧‧‧
en: Good... I understand. Why don't you rest a
bit now? Or go look around, but be sure to
come back later. I have something to take
care of first...

zh: 休息一下吧！
好　　離開
en: Take a rest!
{>130}Yes{>169}Leave

zh: 沈皓，這把劍以及宝珠給你了。
en: Shen Hao, this sword and this jewel are
yours.

zh: 得到古劍及紫色宝珠
en: Received the Old Sword and Purple Orb.

zh: 哇！這劍真重，還銹得一蹋糊塗！咦
？這宝珠倒跟我身上的這顆蠻像的，
就是顏色不一樣‧‧‧
en: Whoa! This sword is heavy, and rusted all
over! Huh? This jewel looks like the one I
have, just a different color...

zh: 世伯，你匆匆出門，便是為了拿這些
東西？
en: Uncle, you rushed out just to get these
things?

zh: 是的。這是當年你父親寄存在我這兒
。而李員外不知怎麼的，知道它們在
我手中，一直逼我把它們給交出來！
en: Yes. Your father left them with me long ago.
Somehow Squire Li found out I had them, and
kept pressing me to hand them over!

zh: 賢姪，你還想知道什麼？
父親
李員外
被捉的原因　　　　　　　離開
en: What else would you like to know, nephew?
{>13}Father
{>13}Squire Li
{>13}Why he held you{>169}Leave

十七年前‧‧‧
古劍與宝珠
其他
en: About your father...
{>13}Seventeen years ago...
{>13}The sword and jewel
{>169}Other

zh: 你想知道十七年前‧‧‧
父親的倉惶
到底發生什麼事
其他
en: About seventeen years ago...
{>13}Father's panic
{>13}What happened?
{>169}Other

zh: 你想知道‧‧‧
捉人的目的
主使者
其他
en: You want to know...
{>13}Why he held me
{>13}Who's behind it
{>169}Other

zh: 我與你父親是非常好的朋友，但我們
已經十七年沒見了。唉‧‧‧轉眼間
已經十七年了‧‧‧
en: Your father and I were very good friends,
but we haven't seen each other in
seventeen years. Sigh... Seventeen years,
gone in a blink...

zh: 李員外在兩年前才來清江城的。真是
一個坯事做盡的大坯蛋！卻偏偏假作
一付斯文相！
en: Squire Li only came to Qingjiang two years
ago. A villain through and through, yet he
puts on such refined airs!

zh: 去年夜裡，他把我捉去，逼問我東西
在那裡！聽他的語氣，似乎有人急著
要這兩樣東西！
en: One night last year he seized me and
demanded to know where the things were!
From his tone, someone was eager to get
them!

zh: 十七年前的夜晚，他抱著襁褓中的你
，神色倉惶的來到我這兒，要我幫他
將這兩樣東西藏好，不能給人知道。
en: One night seventeen years ago, he came to
me in a panic with you, a babe in arms, and
asked me to hide these two things where no
one would know.

zh: 我也不知道，只是你父親似乎非常看
重這兩件東西！
en: I don't know. But your father seemed to
value these two things greatly!

zh: 看你父親神色，似乎正被人追趕著似
，他的神情好憔悴啊！
en: From his look, your father seemed to be on
the run. He looked so haggard!

zh: 你父親並未跟我解釋，當時我還問起
你娘怎麼沒跟他一起時，你爹只是黯
然地搖頭‧‧‧
en: Your father didn't explain. When I asked
why your mother wasn't with him, he just
shook his head sadly...

zh: 我娘？！我爹從來沒跟我說過我娘的
事！他只說娘生我的時候就死了！
en: My mother?! Father never told me about my
mother! He only said she died giving birth to
me!

zh: 我想‧‧‧只有等你爹來的時候再問
個明白吧。
en: I think... we'll have to wait and ask your
father when he comes.

zh: 我並不知道他要這東西幹嘛。
en: I don't know what he wanted them for.

zh: 除了李員外，我從來都沒見過其他人
，也不知道到底是誰在主使這件事。
en: Apart from Squire Li I never saw anyone
else. I don't know who's really behind it.

zh: 現在就只有等你父親來的時候，再問
個明白吧！現在就好好等你爹來再說
吧！
en: All we can do now is ask your father when
he comes. For now, just wait for him!

zh: 得到父親的信
en: Received Father's letter.

zh: 好吧！‧‧‧我們就等你爹親來再說
吧！不過，千萬不要走遠了。
en: Very well!... We'll wait for your father and
see! But don't wander far.

zh: ‧‧‧你爹現在是什麼模樣了呢？唉
！十七年了‧‧‧
en: ...I wonder what your father looks like now?
Sigh! Seventeen years...

zh: 奇怪，你爹怎麼還沒到‧‧‧？
en: Strange, why isn't your father here yet...?

zh: 不得了了，剛才有人捎來口信，說你
爹受了重傷，要你趕緊到風陵渡看看
，說人在一個叫彩衣女的女人那兒‧
en: Terrible news! Someone just brought word
that your father is badly hurt! Hurry to
Fengling Ferry. He's with a woman called
Caiyi...

zh: 啊！怎麼會發生這種事‧‧‧伯父，
風陵渡是在那裏呢？
en: What! How could this happen... Uncle, where
is Fengling Ferry?

zh: 出城往西北方一直走的一個小渡口便
是風陵渡；不過，捎口信的人說了便
走，也不知真正的情況。
en: Leave town and keep heading northwest to a
small ferry landing. That's Fengling Ferry.
But the messenger left right away. I don't
know how bad it is.

zh: 不論如何，也得去看看！況且我爹也
太久沒消息了！伯父，小姪告辭了。
en: Whatever it is, I have to go! Besides, I
haven't heard from Father in so long.
Uncle, I'll be going.

zh: 出門在外，一切小心為要。
en: Be careful out there above all.

zh: 有什麼事我可以為你效勞的嗎？
發問　離開
en: Is there anything I can do for you?
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 聽說你有一些“特別貨“的門路？
聽說你認識李員外？
我要買賣物品
en: {>13}I hear you can get "special goods"?
{>13}I hear you know Squire Li?
{>13}I want to trade.

zh: 哦～看來你也是内行人，不過一般人
很少有“特別的“需要吧？！兄弟是
那條道上的？
en: Oh~ So you're in the know. But most people
rarely have "special" needs, do they?! Who
are you with, friend?

zh: 啊！‧‧‧這個‧‧‧江湖人有江湖
人的忌諱，掌櫃在做“這種“生意，
應該不會不懂吧！何況我還不知道你
到底能給我什麼“方便“‧‧‧
en: Ah!... Well... Our trade has its taboos. A man
in "this" line of business should know that!
Besides, I don't yet know what "favors" you
can do me...

zh: 果然後浪推前浪，年紀輕輕便應答如
流。你就跟夥計去看看到底要什麼吧
en: The new wave overtakes the old, eh? So
young, yet so quick with answers. Go with
my man and see what you need! Please...

zh: 您是外地來的吧！怎麼會問這種蠢‧
‧‧啊‧‧‧問這種問題‧‧‧在清
江城，連三歲小孩都知道李員外‧‧
en: You're from out of town! Why ask such a
stup... er... such a question... In Qingjiang,
even a three-year-old knows Squire Li...

zh: 客官，請隨我來。
en: This way, sir.

zh: 我是來這辺打工的。
en: I just work here part-time.

zh: 有什麼事我可以為你效勞的嗎？
聽說你有一些“特別貨“
我要買賣物品
離開
en: Is there anything I can do for you?
{>13}I hear you have "special goods".
{>13}I want to trade.
{>169}Leave

zh: ‧‧‧不‧‧‧不‧‧‧這種暗門道
的生意，我已經很久不做了；你要“
特別貨“，就到別處找吧！
en: ...No... no... I haven't done that kind of
back-door business in a long time. If you
want "special goods", look elsewhere!

zh: 客官，有什麼事嗎？
買賣
交談
離開
en: What can I do for you?
{>13}Trade
{>13}Talk
{>169}Leave

{>13}Your daughter
{>13}The missing
{>13}Zhang Kan{>169}Leave

zh: ‧‧‧唉‧‧‧她說要幫我去打個酒
，卻再也沒回來了！也再沒人見過她
了！
en: ...Sigh... She went to fetch me some wine and
never came back! No one has seen her since!

zh: 你叫我怎麼說呢？這一年來，這附近
至少有三十個少女失蹤了！我們心裡
都懷疑啊！以前有人去查過！但是後
來連查的人也失蹤了‧‧‧
en: What can I say? This past year at least
thirty girls have gone missing around here!
We all have our suspicions! Someone looked
into it once, but then he vanished too...

zh: ‧‧‧你們會幫我找女兒嗎？‧‧‧
en: ...Will you help me find my daughter?...

zh: 對不起，我現在只想等女兒回來，実
在無心買賣。
en: Sorry, I only want my daughter back. I've
no heart for business.

zh: 啊！謝謝你們在渡口打跑了妖怪，也
救回我女兒，這樣吧！送你們一副皮
甲、皮盾及皮帽以為感謝。
en: Ah! Thank you for chasing off the monster
at the ferry and bringing back my daughter!
Please, take this hide armor, shield and cap
as thanks.

zh: 你說張看啊！他以前就住在客棧隔壁
啊！不過，一年前他突然離開了。老
王一口咬定，他是失蹤了。我是不知
道，但是後來也有人恐嚇，不准再提
en: Zhang Kan? He lived next to the inn, but a
year ago he suddenly left. Old Wang swears
he vanished. I don't know, but later
someone threatened us not to speak of

zh: 這件事，所以也沒人敢說！
en: it, so no one dares!

zh: 有什麼問題，請說吧！
女兒
人口失蹤
邪惡之子　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask your question!
{>13}Your daughter
{>13}The missing
{>13}The Son of Evil{>169}Leave

zh: ‧‧我沒有印象，那是一種防具嗎？
有很多武器，的確是需要邪惡的力量
，才能發揮驚人的殺傷力。
en: Son... of... Evil... Hmm!... Doesn't ring a bell.
Is it armor? Lots of weapons do need an evil
power to unleash their full killing force.

zh: ‧‧‧你們這次又要幹什麼了‧‧‧
en: ...What are you here for this time...

zh: ‧‧‧你誤會了，我們只是有些問題
想請教您而已！
en: ...You've got it wrong. We just have some
questions for you!

zh: 哦‧‧‧嚇我一跳‧‧‧
en: Oh... You startled me...

zh: 有什麼事嗎？問吧！
張看
住持
害怕什麼　　　　　　　　離開
en: What is it? Ask away!

{>13}The abbot

zh: 我沒聽過這個人‧‧‧
en: ...Er... um... well... I've never heard of him...

zh: 住持是在十年前的一個風雪夜來到清
江城的！那夜風雪很大，卻都沾不上
他的身！他四周似乎有光在保護他！
後來一些信眾就建明尊寺來供養他！
en: The abbot came here on a snowy night ten
years ago! The storm was fierce, but not a
flake touched him, as if light shielded him! His
followers built Mingzun Temple for him!

zh: 唉！這說來就話長了‧‧‧這全都是
那惡霸李財主搞的！
en: Sigh! It's a long story... It's all the doing
of that tyrant, rich man Li!

zh: 你們應該去參見參見住持。
en: You should go pay your respects to the
abbot.

zh: 這些年來我們成天提心弔膽的，生怕
惹禍上身！多虧你們了！真是感激不
盡！
en: For years we lived in fear of trouble every
day! We owe it all to you! We can't thank
you enough!

zh: 四處看看吧，就當自己家一樣。
en: Look around. Make yourself at home.

zh: 我是個讀書人，這家傳箭譜在我身上
也沒用，久而久之只怕會失傳，不如
送給你們吧！算是謝謝你們為地方除
惡。
en: I'm a scholar. This family archery manual is
no use to me, and in time it'll be lost.
Better I give it to you! Thanks for ridding
us of evil.

zh: 我不相信！我不相信住持是妖怪！一
定是你們騙人！滾出去！這兒不歡迎
你們！
en: I don't believe it! I don't believe the abbot
was a monster! You must be lying! Get out!
You're not welcome here!

zh: 客官，有什麼事嗎？
休息
交談
離開
en: What can I do for you?
{>13}Rest
{>13}Talk
{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼，知無不言，言無不盡
張看
李員外
住持　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask me anything, I'll tell you all I know.
{>13}Zhang Kan
{>13}Squire Li
{>13}The abbot{>169}Leave

zh: ‧‧‧是有這個人沒錯，但他好像離
開了。‧‧‧我不知道‧‧‧
en: ...Ah... him... ah... um... Yes, there is such a
man, but he seems to have left... I don't
know...

zh: ‧‧‧小兄弟啊！出門在外的，凡事
少開口，閒事莫管，這才是明哲保身
之道啊！
en: ...Little brother! Away from home, say little
and mind your own business. That's how you
stay safe!

zh: 李員外就住在城西一棟大宅院子裏。
門口有一對石獅子，很好認。‧‧‧
你找李員外有事嗎？一般人很少去拜
訪李員外的。
en: Squire Li lives in a big mansion in the west
of the city, with two stone lions at the
gate. You can't miss it... Have business with
him? Few people visit him.

zh: 嗯，來清江城一定得去拜見住持，往
北走，過小橋，看到間大廟，就是那
兒了。
en: Mm, anyone who comes to Qingjiang must see
the abbot. Head north, cross the little
bridge, and you'll see a big temple. That's
it.

zh: 你們這種時節外出，凡事要小心啊！
發問　離開
en: Traveling in times like these, be careful!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 想知道什麼，說吧‧‧‧
張看
清江城
李員外　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know? Go ahead...
{>13}Zhang Kan
{>13}Qingjiang City
{>13}Squire Li{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道清江城的什麼？‧‧‧
人口失蹤
李員外家
離開
en: What about Qingjiang City?...
{>13}The missing
{>13}Squire Li's house
{>169}Leave
...Shh... Keep your voice down...

zh: 小兄弟，張看已經失蹤一年了‧‧‧
沒有人知道他到那裡去了；你也不要
再提了。這一年來，我們城裡常有人
無緣無故失蹤。
en: Little brother, Zhang Kan has been missing
for a year... No one knows where he went.
Don't bring it up again. People here often
vanish for no reason.

zh: 這幾年來我們這兒很不平靜！人常常
無故失蹤不說，又有妖怪作祟，再加
上魚肉鄉民的惡霸！唉‧‧‧前途一
片黑暗啊！‧‧‧
en: These past years have been anything but
peaceful! People vanish for no reason,
monsters run wild, and a tyrant preys on
us! Sigh... The future looks dark!...

zh: 哼！我想不出還有什麼坯事，他沒幹
過的‧‧‧整個清江城被他弄得烏煙
瘴氣的！可憐老百姓恨在心裡，但對
這樣大的惡勢力，又能如何呢？
en: Hmph! I can't think of any evil he hasn't
done... He's turned all of Qingjiang into a
cesspit! The poor folk hate him, but what
can they do against such power?

zh: 老王，你就閉上嘴吧！否則那天輪到
你失蹤，看你的老婆孩子該怎麼辦？
en: Old Wang, shut your mouth! Or one day it'll
be your turn to vanish. What will your wife
and kids do then?

zh: 怕什麼！大不了跟他拼了！
en: What's to fear! At worst I'll fight him to
the death!

zh: 唉！拼拼拼，你拿什麼跟人家拼？你
有權嗎？你有勢嗎？二杯黃湯下肚，
就會胡說八道‧‧‧
en: Sigh! Fight, fight, fight. Fight him with what?
Have you got power? Influence? Two cups of
wine and you're talking nonsense...

zh: 唉，吐口怨氣也好‧‧‧這真不是人
住的地方，真想有一個可以安靜過日
子的地方。
en: Sigh, at least it lets off steam... This is no
place for people to live. I wish I had
somewhere to live in peace.

zh: 老実說，這件事情八九不離十，一定
跟李員外有関，但誰敢去查啊！不過
，也別跟人說是我說的，我還不想死
，而且防具店老板的女兒也不見了。
en: Honestly, I'm almost certain Squire Li's
behind it, but who dares look into it? Don't
say I told you, I don't want to die. And the
armor shop owner's daughter is missing too.

zh: 那宅子一般人是進不去的，不過‧‧
‧聽說武器店的老板，好像幫李員外
買賣一些外地的兵器、火器，且數量
不少，連官府都覺得相當棘手。
en: No ordinary folk get into that mansion.
But... I hear the weapon shop owner deals
foreign arms and guns for Squire Li, so
many that even the magistrate is worried.

zh: 吐吐苦水，舒服多了！
en: I feel much better for getting that off my
chest!

zh: 我猜，防具店的老板一定很傷心！這
麼辛苦拉拔大的孩子，就這樣失蹤了
en: I bet the armor shop owner is heartbroken!
He worked so hard raising that child, and
now she's gone.

zh: 我告訴你，要不是我得做生意的話，
我才不來這個鬼地方。
en: I tell you, if I didn't have business here,
I'd never come to this godforsaken place.

zh: 住宿要３０銖銅錢，你要嗎？
要　　不要
en: A room is 30 gold. Want one?

zh: 啊！日子太平，生意也好多了
en: Ah! With peace back, business is much
better.

zh: 沒想到你們竟能打走那李惡霸，真是
英雄出少年。
en: Who'd have thought you'd drive out that
tyrant Li! Heroes really do come young.

zh: 嘿！看不出你們挺行的嘛！有空到北
辺來，就到我家玩玩吧。我在十里鋪
開藥鋪，經過時記得來坐坐吧！
en: Hey! You're better than you look! If you're
ever up north, come visit. I run a pharmacy
in Shilipu. Drop by when you pass!

zh: 小兄弟，你們真的確定住持是坯人嗎
？‧‧‧唉！‧‧‧我到現在還無法
相信‧‧‧
en: Little brother, are you really sure the
abbot was evil?... Sigh!... I still can't believe
it...

zh: 我爸爸是這兒的老闆，他說自從你們
幫城裏的人把坯蛋打走後，我們的生
意也好多了。媽媽說太感謝你們了！
en: My dad runs this place. He says since you
drove out the bad guys, business is much
better. Mom says thank you so much!

zh: 你們能不能留在這兒？我沒有朋友，
好寂寞啊！
en: Can you stay here? I don't have any
friends. I'm so lonely!

zh: 客官，您的錢恐怕不夠休息。
en: I'm afraid you don't have enough for a
room, sir.
Huh... What a strange dream...

zh: 爹。
en: Father.

zh: 皓兒，現在有件事非常緊急。
你趕緊動身前往清江城，把這封信交
給一位名叫張看的人！
en: Hao'er, something very urgent has come up.
Hurry to Qingjiang City and give this
letter to a man named Zhang Kan!

zh: 得到一封信。
en: Received a letter.

zh: 這顆吉祥宝珠，帶在身上可以辟邪。
它非常重要，你可千萬別賣了它！
en: Carry this Lucky Jewel with you. It
wards off evil. It's very important,
so whatever you do, don't sell it!

zh: 得到橙色摩尼宝珠。
en: Received the Orange Orb.

zh: 孩子，你頭一次出遠門，一切要小心
啊！
en: Son, this is your first long journey.
Be careful out there!

zh: 皓兒，你要問什麼呢？
清江城
張看
父親的行蹤　　　　　　　　離開
en: Hao'er, what would you like to ask?
{>12}Qingjiang City
{>12}Zhang Kan
{>12}Your whereabouts{>181}Leave

zh: 清江城是座繁榮的大城。出了村往北
，越過白道口、上官村就是了。
en: Qingjiang is a great, thriving city. Leave
the village and head north, past Baidao
Pass and Shangguan Village.

zh: 他是爹的好友，可是多年沒聯絡了。
en: He's an old friend of mine, but we
haven't been in touch for many years.

zh: 我還有事要辦。到時就在張看家會合
吧！
en: I still have business to attend to.
We'll meet up at Zhang Kan's house.

zh: 一切要小心啊。
en: Be careful.

zh: 好了，你趕緊動身吧。
en: Now, hurry and be on your way.

zh: 話還沒說完呢！你等等吧。
en: I haven't finished talking! Wait a
moment.

zh: 難道你什麼也不想問問我嗎？
en: Isn't there anything you want to ask me?

zh: 嗯，睡不著呢。
en: Hmm... I can't sleep.

zh: 你看到那血色的流星嗎？真恐怖啊
en: Did you see that blood-red meteor? How
frightening!

zh: 流星俗稱掃把星，見者必衰！這回的
顏色還如鮮血一般！這下子一定有事
要發生了！
en: They call meteors broom stars, bad luck for
all who see them! And this one was red as
blood! Something terrible is bound to happen!

zh: 一定大煞星下凡了！你等著瞧吧！
en: Some great evil star has come down to
earth! Mark my words!

zh: 幾年前我還去過那兒一趟，挺熱鬧的
。姑娘個個標緻的很呢！哎....可惜
我老了....
en: I went there a few years ago. A lively
place, and every girl a beauty! Sigh... too
bad I'm old now...

zh: ....唉....最近不知怎麼了，老覺得
心慌慌的，好像要發生什麼事的。
en: ...Sigh... I don't know why, lately I always
feel uneasy, as if something's about to
happen.

zh: 唉....人老了，不一定悲哀；悲哀的
是....連心也老了。
en: Sigh... Growing old isn't so sad. What's sad
is... when the heart grows old too.

zh: 你知道嗎？凡事最怕貪多嚼不爛！東
學西學的，結果卻一事無成！
en: You know what? The worst thing is biting off
more than you can chew! Dabble in
everything and you master nothing!

zh: 就像練武，最重要的是不断努力的練
習，這樣功力才會越來越強！
en: Just like martial arts. What matters most is
constant practice. That's how your skill
keeps growing!

zh: 小皓，我兒子就交給你啦！
en: Little Hao, I'm leaving my son in your
hands!

？....我怕這太平歲月要結束了....
en: Doesn't this meteor seem a bit... wrong to
you?... I'm afraid our peaceful days are
ending...

zh: 城裡人比我們要複雜多了，你們凡事
機靈點兒，知道嗎？
en: City folk are a lot more cunning than us.
Keep your wits about you, understand?

zh: 天弓練得一手好箭法，可以幫你不少
忙！
en: Tiangong is a fine archer. He can help you a
lot!

zh: 人，多一點兒磨練總是好的。
en: A little hardship is always good for a
person.

zh: 我只有這個兒子，請多照顧他啊！
en: He's my only son. Please look after him!

zh: 想問什麼嗎？

清江城
方天弓                    離開
en: Something to ask?

{>12}Qingjiang City

zh: 那真是個不好的兆頭。....你們非得
這時節出門嗎？
en: It's a bad omen... Must you leave at a time
like this?

zh: 我不太清楚呢。但出門在外的，小心
點兒總是對的！
en: I'm not sure. But when you're away from
home, it's always right to be careful!

zh: 那孩子老是長不大，成天幻想自己是
個俠客！凡事可請你多擔待點兒啊。
en: That boy never grows up. He's always
dreaming he's a knight-errant! Please bear
with him.

zh: 請你一定要多照顧我這宝貝兒子啊！
en: Please take good care of my precious son!

zh: 你等等，我馬上就好了。
en: Wait, I'll be ready in a second.

zh: 爸媽，我走了，請您們好好保重！
en: Mom, Dad, I'm off. Please take care of
yourselves!

zh: 我們走吧。
en: Let's go.

zh: 小皓，來找天弓玩嗎？
en: Little Hao, here to play with Tiangong?

zh: 聽說那裡最近出了事，但詳情我也不
清楚。
en: I hear something happened there lately, but
I don't know the details.

zh: 天弓是個善良的孩子，但就是太愛玩
了。
en: Tiangong is a kind boy, he just loves to play
too much.

zh: 俗語說的好：「天有不測風雲，人有
旦夕禍福。」凡事小心，準沒錯的。
en: As the saying goes, "Storms come
unforeseen, and fortune turns overnight."
Being careful is never wrong.

zh: 小皓啊！晚上在我家吃個飯吧！
en: Little Hao! Stay for dinner tonight!

zh: 我正在害怕呢！天曉得這恐怖的流星
到底是代表什麼呢。
en: I'm scared! Heaven knows what that
frightening meteor means.

zh: 聽說那城挺熱鬧呢！
en: I hear that city's very lively!

zh: 那孩子總是長不大，天天嚷著要做俠
客！你有空就多勸勸他吧！
en: That boy never grows up, always shouting
that he'll be a knight-errant! Talk some
sense into him when you can!

zh: 天弓在房裡，你可以去找他玩啊。
en: Tiangong's in his room. Go play with him.

zh: 你是不是回來找我的？你願意讓我加
了嗎？
願意  不願意
en: Did you come back for me? Will you let me
join?

zh: 太棒了！我就知道你一定會回來找我
的！你等等，我跟我父母說去！
en: Great! I knew you'd come back for me! Wait,
I'll go tell my parents!
Oh... all right.

zh: 如果你改變主意，一定要來找我呦！
en: If you change your mind, come find me!

zh: 我爸媽答應了，我們走吧！
en: My parents said yes. Let's go!

zh: 爸媽，我走了，請您們好好保重！
en: Mom, Dad, I'm off. Please take care of
yourselves!

zh: 我們走吧。
en: Let's go.

zh: 出門在外，一切要小心啊！
en: Be careful out there!

zh: 如果外辺過得不好，就隨時回來啊！
en: If things go badly out there, come home
anytime!

zh: 哦，我都忘了！這是我們祖傳的「八
卦刀譜」。加以修練，也可防身！
en: Oh, I almost forgot! This is our family's
"Bagua Cut" manual. Practice it, and it'll
protect you!

zh: 咦？....好像少了什麼東西？....
en: Huh?... Is something missing?...

zh: 哦？小皓啊，來找天弓玩嗎？
en: Oh? Little Hao, here to play with Tiangong?

zh: 小皓啊，要去旅行嗎？也好，多點兒
見識也不錯。
en: Little Hao, going on a journey? Good, it'll
broaden your horizons.

zh: 要出遠門，東西準備齊全了，再出發
比較好。
en: For a long trip, get everything ready before
you set off.

zh: 你會武功嗎？爸爸說，出門在外的，
最好有一技防身！
en: Do you know kung fu? Dad says when you
travel, it's best to have a skill to defend
yourself!

zh: 出外一定要小心啊！聽說前幾天有人
被搶，連命都給丟了！唉....人心越
en: Be careful out there! I hear someone was
robbed a few days ago and lost his life!
Sigh... People are getting worse and worse...

zh: 錢丟事小，命丟了可划不來！
en: Losing money is nothing. Losing your life is a
bad deal!

zh: 皓哥！你要去那裡？
en: Brother Hao! Where are you going?

zh: 我要去清江城。
en: I'm going to Qingjiang City.

zh: 哇！我能跟你一起去嗎？
我真想出去遊歷，見見世面！
en: Wow! Can I come with you?
I really want to travel and see the world!

zh: 你的父母不會答應你跟我走吧！
我頭一次出門，恐怕無法照顧你！
好啊，我正愁一個人寂寞呢！離開
en: {>13}Your parents won't let you come!
{>13}It's my first trip, I can't mind you!
{>13}Sure, I was getting lonely!

的。你願意讓我跟你一起走嗎？
願意　不願意
en: My parents are very open-minded. They'll
say yes. Will you let me come with you?

zh: 我會照顧自己的！你願意讓我跟你走
嗎？
願意　不願意
en: I can look after myself! Will you let me come
with you?

zh: 太棒了！我去收拾行李。待會兒見！
en: Great! I'll go pack. See you soon!
Oh... all right.

zh: 如果你改變主意，一定要來找我呦！
en: If you change your mind, come find me!

zh: 方天弓那麼想出去遊歷，還是別讓他
失望好了‧‧‧現在去找他。
en: Fang Tiangong wants so badly to see the
world. I shouldn't let him down... I'll go find
him now.

zh: 差點忘了跟方天弓約好要一起出去遊
歷的事，現在去找他。
en: I almost forgot I promised Fang Tiangong
we'd travel together. I'll go find him now.

en: Things aren't peaceful around here lately.
Bandits are about! Mind your own business,
sir, or you could lose your life!

had it terrible. Hundreds died in just one

裡真的安全呢？！
en: That one really scares me! Red as blood,
you say?! Oh my! I want to find somewhere
to hide! But heaven knows, where's really
safe these days?!

en: They say a demon is behind it! Frightening!

zh: 幸好那位高僧法力高強！他手那麼一

多強啊！
en: Luckily that holy monk is so powerful! One
wave of his hand and the snake was cut
into eight pieces! Wow! So strong!

zh: 據說是隻千年的蛇怪！前幾天有位客

呢！
en: They say it was a thousand-year-old snake!
A guest said he saw it with his own eyes! It
was over seventy feet long and so thick ten
men couldn't reach around it!

菩薩下凡救苦呢！

says he's a bodhisattva come down to save
us!

mighty power! Once I sell these goods, I'll go
pay my respects too!

says with a grain of salt. He tends to
exaggerate!

弟！沒事還是不要亂跑吧，小心惹禍

en: Sigh! These past years have been chaos,
and the harvests poor. People can't make a
living, so they turn bandit! Little brother,
don't wander around, or you'll find trouble!

go mad!

thousand times worse than demons!

zh: 不知道！你少來煩我！
en: Don't know! Stop bothering me!

給我趕走！

this pest for me!

the damage. If you don't go now, they'll be
back with more men!

you're finished!

途無聊，你願不願意把它賣給我呢？

road gets boring. Would you sell it to me?

zh: ....嗯....好吧！便宜賣給你吧！客
官，你可真會殺價啊！

know how to haggle, sir!

zh: 嗯....是還合算，好吧！賣給你了！

yours!

..難道那本書有什麼特別的？....我

much?... Is there something special about
it?... I won't sell! Not selling!

It's worth far more than you paid!

人了！

嗎？宰了小肥羊！
en: Lad, didn't I tell you "don't go anywhere"?
Let's slaughter the little lamb!

zh: 小子！我們走著瞧！

zh: 啊！你錢不夠吧？！下次再來吧！

time!

zh: 客官，你錢不夠，下次再來吧！
en: You don't have enough money, sir. Come
again next time!

願與老納談談呢？
en: You seem in a hurry, sir, as if something
weighs on you. Would you care to talk with
this old monk?

zh: ....我也不知道....只是感覺到好像
有什麼事要發生似的....
en: ...I don't know... I just feel like something is
about to happen...

zh: 看施主的面相，隱隱之中似乎有兩股
正邪之氣交戰著....施主啊！世事多
凶險！凡事小心為上啊！
en: Your face shows two forces, good and evil,
warring within... Sir, the world is perilous! Be
careful in all you do!

zh: ....你....你不要嚇人啊！
en: ...D-don't scare me like that!

zh: 老衲研究易理五十年，絕不亂說！..
看施主之骨格，施主為「遇水則變」
格，換句話就是說：每當施主遇到水
多的地方，你的命運將會轉變....
en: I've studied the Book of Changes for fifty
years. I don't speak idly!... Your bones say
"changed by water": wherever there is much
water, your fate will turn...

zh: 但是變好變坯，但看施主的抉擇了！
en: But whether for good or ill depends on your
choices!

zh: ....水多的地方？....遇水則變....
en: ...A place with much water?... Changed by
water...

zh: 施主，一定要記得，是好是坯，全在
你的一念之間啊！
en: Sir, always remember: good or ill, it all rests
on a single thought!

zh: 施主，捐點兒香油錢吧！
要　　不要
en: Sir, would you donate to the temple?

zh: 捐香火錢 5銖銅錢
en: Donated 5 gold to the temple.

zh: 謝謝！謝謝！
en: Thank you! Thank you!

zh: 我肚子餓啊！
en: I'm hungry!

zh: 施主想抽個籤，測測運勢嗎？
要　　不要
en: Would you like to draw a fortune slip, sir?

zh: (參見籤詩内容)
en: {>30}(Read the fortune slip)

zh: 從籤詩看來，施主為人中之龍，此去
前途不可限量！是為蒼生之所託啊！
en: By this slip, you are a dragon among men,
sir. Your future is boundless! The people's
hopes rest on you!

zh: 施主若問前途的話，請勿憂心，將來
必有貴人相助！
en: If you ask about your future, don't worry.
Someone great will surely come to your aid!

zh: 此籤吉凶參半，施主前去凡事小心，
或能逢凶化吉！
en: This slip is half good, half bad. Be careful
on your way, sir, and ill may turn to good!

zh: 似乎將有妖孽出世，一切需小心啊！
en: It seems some evil is about to be born. Be
careful!
Sigh...

zh: 不吉！不吉啊！
en: Bad! Very bad!

zh: 施主，求籤是很慎重之事，怎能當做
兒戲，不合意就要再求呢？
en: Sir, drawing a slip is a solemn act. You
can't treat it as a game and draw again
when you dislike it!

zh: 施主，虔心禮佛，將會獲得不可思議
加持啊！
en: Sir, worship the Buddha devoutly and you'll
receive wondrous blessings!

zh: 「春雷震　賈風巽　臥龍起　猛虎驚
風雲會合　救濟蒼生」
en: "Spring thunder rolls, the wind blows,
the dragon wakes, the tiger starts;
wind and cloud unite to save the people."

zh: 「蟄龍已出世　斗角首生成
雲興雨降　得濟蒼生」
en: "The sleeping dragon is born,
its horns now grown; clouds rise,
rain falls, and the people are saved."

zh: 「急起行　急起行　前途去　結同盟
雙手擎天柱　史冊好留名」
en: "Rise up, rise up, go forth, make allies;
two hands to hold up the pillar of heaven,
your name will live on in history."

zh: 「遇險不須憂　風波何足懼
若遇同路人　咫尺青雲路」
en: "In danger, fret not; why fear the waves?
If you meet one who shares your road,
the path to the clouds is near."

zh: 「難難難　忽然平地起波瀾
易易易　談笑尋常終有望」
en: "Hard, hard, hard: waves rise on flat land.
Easy, easy, easy: with a laugh,
hope will come in the end."

zh: 「勞心勞力　勞心有成
清風借力　歡笑前程」
en: "Toil of heart and hand, toil brings
success; borrow strength from the breeze,
and laughter lies ahead."

zh: 「一念到天堂　一念入地獄
地獄天堂　便分榮辱
自立念頭要真　不可隨人碌碌」
en: "One thought to heaven, one to hell;
hell or heaven decides honor or shame.
Make your own resolve true;
do not drift along with others."

zh: 「往來行僻處　淬然著一驚
豺狼若當道　斬滅方稱心」
en: "Walking lonely ways, you suddenly
take fright; if wolves block the road,
only slaying them will satisfy."

zh: 「風起西北　紅燄當天
凶中有吉　吉中有凶」
en: "Wind rises in the northwest,
red flames fill the sky; in ill there is
good, and in good there is ill."

zh: 「行路難　行路難
今日方知行路難
前程廣大何足慮
勉力今朝度此難」
en: "Hard is the road, hard is the road;
today you know how hard the road is.
Why fear? The way ahead is wide;
strive today to pass this trial."

zh: 「淺水起風波　平地生荊棘
言語慮參商　猶恐無端始」
en: "Shallow water stirs up waves, thorns
grow on flat ground; weigh your words,
lest strife begin for no reason."

zh: 「時運多艱　戰戰兢兢
戒謹恐懼　如履薄冰
須知前程危必險
一陣風裡一支燈」
en: "Hard times: tremble with care,
as if treading on thin ice.
Know the road ahead is perilous:
a single lamp in the wind."

zh: 你是誰？怎麼進來我家呢？
en: Who are you? How did you get into my house?

zh: 回答:
想參觀一下美麗的房子。
對不起！走錯了！
想聊聊天。
en: Answer:
{>13}I wanted to see your lovely home.
{>12}Sorry! Wrong house!
{>12}I'd like to chat.

en: Oh, then look around as you like.

zh: 對不起！我沒空！請出去！
en: Sorry! I'm busy! Please leave!

zh: 難道RPG的方式改寫了嗎？
en: Did they rewrite how RPGs work?

其他　離開
en: Baidao Pass used to be quiet, but lately all
sorts pass through! Sigh, the world's going
downhill and people get worse every day!

zh: 如果你對這有興趣，你可以去找我的
親戚。因為聽說前些日子他們村裡發
現了件怪東西！
en: If you're interested, go see my relative. I
hear they found something strange in their
village recently!

zh: 往北走十幾里就是上官村了。
en: Shangguan Village is a few miles north of
here.

zh: 我親戚叫上官明，你說你是阿木的朋
友就是了。
en: My relative's name is Shangguan Ming. Just
say you're Amu's friend.

zh: 我不喜歡他，話太多了！..聽說前天
他撿到了客人留下來的一本書。但他
大字不識幾個，正在問人那書是寫些
什麼呢！
en: I don't like him, he talks too much!... I hear
the day before yesterday he found a book a
guest left behind. He can barely read, so
he's asking around what it says!

zh: 這幾年收成差，許多人活不下去，就
出來搶了！但話說回來，也不能自己
活不下去，就要別人也活不了啊！
en: The harvests have been poor these years,
and many who can't make a living turn to
robbery! Still, being unable to live doesn't
mean you can stop others living!

zh: 很高興能認識你，但是我還有事，請
你下次再來吧。我有事要出門了。
en: Nice to meet you, but I have things to do.
Please come again another time. I have to go
out.

zh: 喂！喂！喂！不要亂動啊！
en: Hey! Hey! Hey! Don't touch that!

zh: ....抓賊啊！抓賊啊！
en: ...Thief! Stop, thief!

zh: 小夥子，你去那兒啊？
en: Lad, where are you headed?

zh: 我要去清江城。
en: I'm going to Qingjiang City.

zh: 啊？千萬不可！那裡太危險了！
發問　離開
en: What? You mustn't! It's too dangerous
there!
{>130}Ask{>169}Leave

zh: 清江城前陣子流行種怪病，死了好多
人呢！現在根本沒有人敢去那兒了！
en: A strange illness broke out in Qingjiang not
long ago, and many died! Now no one dares
go there!

zh: 這裡是白道口，一個小小的驛站，供
客休息。
en: This is Baidao Pass, a little way station
where travelers rest.

zh: 那夜我喝醉了沒看見，不過聽起來，
是覺得有點不對勁。
en: I was drunk that night and didn't see it.
But from what I hear, something's not right.

zh: 這病一開始會直嚷著頭痛，後來就逐
漸昏死過去！沒幾天就嗚呼哀哉了。
en: First they complain of a headache, then
they slowly fall unconscious! In a few days
they're dead.

zh: 這就不太清楚了；不過這病挺怪的！
你說不是嗎？
en: I don't really know. But it's a strange
illness! Don't you think?

zh: 小夥子！我說你是甭去了！
en: Lad! I say don't go!

zh: 可憐可憐我吧，我肚子餓啊....
en: Have pity on me. I'm so hungry...

zh: 要不要給他點錢？
要　不要
en: Give him some money?

zh: 給老乞丐１銖銅錢
en: Gave the old beggar 1 gold.

zh: 孩子，謝謝你！你太好了！這樣吧！
你去摸摸我身後的樹，樹後有個包袱
，它對我已沒用了，就給你吧。
en: Thank you, child! You're so kind! Tell you
what: feel behind the tree behind me. There's
a bundle there. It's no use to me now, so
it's yours.

zh: 得到包袱
en: Received a bundle.

zh: 孩子啊！要常存慈悲之心啊！
en: Child! Always keep a compassionate heart!

zh: 人生在世，禍福不定。小兄弟，多做
好事，總沒錯的。
en: In this life, fortune is uncertain. Little
brother, doing good deeds is never wrong.

zh: 私人產業，請勿進入！
en: Private property. Keep out!

zh: 這水有毒快退....！
en: This water is poisonous! Back off...!

zh: 那我們怎麼找宝珠...........
en: Then how will we find the jewel...

zh: 拿下耳塞。
en: Took out the Earplugs.
...Ah! What's... happening...

zh: ....這到底怎麼一回事？！....
en: ...What on earth is going on?!...

zh: 咖！咖！我的孩子！不要再做無謂的
抵抗了！時候一到，你就會來到我身
en: Heh! Heh! My child! Stop this useless
struggle! When the time comes, you will come
to my side...
You...! Who are you?!

zh: 咖！咖！你竟然不認得我？！我的孩
子！我將是你生命中最摯愛的父親！
闇冥之王啊！
en: Heh! Heh! You don't know me?! My child! I
shall be the most beloved father of your
life! The King of Darkness!

zh: 呸！你別夢想了！我才不會聽你的呢
en: Pah! Dream on! I'll never listen to you!

zh: 咖！咖！何苦呢？在我的手中，你們
是多麼的不堪一擊啊！....你是逃躲
不了命運的安排！你將是我最寵愛的
兒子！我將引領你體會到最甜美的邪
en: Heh! Heh! Why bother? In my hands you are
so very weak!... You can't escape your
fate! You will be my favorite son! I'll lead
you to taste the sweetest flavor of

zh: 惡的滋味啊！....咖！咖！你怎麼逃
得了呢？這是千年前就已決定的事啊
！....命中註定，你是我的！....咖
en: evil!... Heh! Heh! How can you escape? It
was decided a thousand years ago!... It is
destiny, you are mine!... Heh! Heh!...
Destiny!...
Huh... strange...!

zh: 要不要看看那銅盒裏面是甚麼？
en: Shall we see what's inside the copper box?

zh: 不要啦！無妄老人不是交代我們千萬
不要看嗎？
en: No! Didn't Old Man Wuwang tell us never to
look?

zh: 沈皓！你說要不要看？
不要  要
en: Shen Hao! Should we look?
Aaah...

zh: 完蛋了！我們毀了！！
en: It's over! We're ruined!!

zh: 出了甚麼事？出了甚麼事？
en: What happened? What happened?

zh: 我不知道怎麼了！但我知道我們很難
向無妄老人交代了！！
en: I don't know! But I know we'll have a hard
time explaining this to Old Man Wuwang!!

zh: 裡面好像還有東西，但鎖住了...
en: There seems to be something else inside, but
it's locked...

zh: 哇！這鈴鐺還真詭異......！
en: Whoa! This bell is really creepy...!

zh: 好像那摧魂的鈴聲也停了...！

too...!

zh: 你剛剛說什麼？
en: What did you just say?

zh: 是誰打擾我？......
en: Who disturbs me?...

zh: 你們不想活了！竟然到我這鬧事！準
備受死吧！
en: You must want to die! Making trouble in my
lair! Prepare to perish!

zh: 哇！真是臭妖怪！你看一除掉它！整
個世界變的清爽多了.......
en: Whew! What a stinking monster! With it gone,
the whole world feels fresher...

zh: 前面有個鑰匙孔......
en: There's a keyhole ahead...

zh: 打開鎖定了！！
en: It's unlocked!!

zh: 你需要鑰匙Ｋ
en: You need Key K.

心的人，他就會認為他做的事都很有
意義。」
發問   離開

self-confidence finds meaning in everything
he does."
{>129}Ask{>173}Leave

動的學習吧！

Maybe because there's no school, we all
teach ourselves!

zh: 嗯，這個標誌....有點熟悉呢！我確

zh: 很抱歉，我真的記不得那裡見過了。

it.

zh: 你那裡都可以去，就是不要去客棧！
那裡的人実在太頹廢了！看得我老太
婆好生氣！你可不要年紀輕輕的，跟
別人去喝酒啊！
en: Go anywhere you like, just not the inn! The
people there are so decadent! It makes this
old woman furious! Don't you go drinking
with them at your age!

zh: 老太婆不知道！
en: This old woman doesn't know!

zh: 沒聽過！你去問別人吧！老婆子怎麼
會知道呢！
en: Never heard of it! Go ask someone else! How
would an old woman know?

zh: 去！去！問別人去！
en: Go! Go! Ask someone else!

zh: 我常跟我兒子說：「與其悶著頭煩惱
，不如想辦法去解決它吧。」
en: I always tell my son, "Rather than brood
over a problem, find a way to solve it."

zh: 如果有什麼讓你困擾的問題，就去面
對它吧！其実一切負面的情緒，都是
來自於"恐懼"啊！」
en: If something troubles you, face it! In
truth, all dark feelings come from fear!

zh: 記住啊！「心無罣礙，無罣礙故無恐
怖，遠離顛倒夢想！」
en: Remember! "With no hindrance in the mind,
there is no fear, and you leave delusion far
behind!"

zh: 啊？今天天黑得那麼早啊？！
en: Huh? It's getting dark so early today?!

zh: 不對！我看這下子糟糕了！
en: No! I think this is bad!

zh: 到底怎麼回事？
en: What's going on?

zh: 你看！
en: Look!
...The moon has changed color...

zh: ....是的，我們必須趕緊動身了！現
在癥兆出現的時間是越來越短了！
en: ...Yes, we must hurry! The omens are coming
closer and closer together!

zh: ....時間越來越少了....
en: ...Time is running out...

zh: 門上鎖，進不去......
en: The door is locked. You can't get in...

zh: 又要換季了，我們搞時裝的可累了！
老闆逼我們天天加班！唉，苦命啊！
en: The seasons are changing again. We fashion
folks are worn out! The boss makes us work
overtime every day! Sigh, what a life!

逍遙鎮
山魅標誌

en: What is it?

明村」的殊榮了！
en: Our town is full of talent! Five years
running we've won "Village of Invention"!

zh: ....對不起，我沒見過這個圖案....
en: ...Sorry, I've never seen this mark...

zh: 你在說那一部小說的名字嗎？我太久
沒看小說了，落伍了....
en: Is that the title of some novel? I haven't
read a novel in ages. I'm out of touch...

zh: 要不要買些這兒的特產「天香衣」？
穿起來又薄又軟，很舒服呦！
