好　　不好
en: What?... Then... it breaks my heart, but 250
gold!

zh: 啊？....不行了！這是最低價了！你
別趁火打劫窮人啊！你到底買不買？
好　　不好
en: What?... No way! That's my lowest price!
Don't rob a poor man in his hour of need!
Are you buying or not?

zh: 好了，這「轉化術法」今天起就屬於
你的了。它可以在你危急的時候，緊
急轉化銅錢成為生命的能量，雖然貴
是貴了一點，但是臨到救命時，還是
en: There. From today the Transmute art is
yours. In a crisis it turns your gold into
life energy. It's a bit costly, but when your
life is on the line, it's

zh: 挺管用的。
en: quite handy.

zh: 啊？....好吧，我只好去找其他買主
了。
en: What?... Fine, I'll just have to find another
buyer.

zh: 啊？....看來你比我還窮嘛！算了，
我找其他買主去了。
en: What?... Looks like you're even poorer than
me! Forget it, I'll find another buyer.

zh: 你聽過這個笑話嗎？『如果魔鬼要訪
問人，而一時抽不出空的話，他就會
派遣酒做代表』！
en: Heard this joke? "When the devil wants to
visit a man but has no time, he sends wine in
his place!"

zh: 歡迎光臨，休息一次６０銖錢
要　　不要
en: Welcome! A rest is 60 gold.

zh: 抱歉！小店本錢微薄，不能賒帳！
en: Sorry! We're a small shop. No credit!

zh: 得到『轉化術法』
en: Learned Transmute.

zh: 這些人到底是誰？幹嘛一付非要殺掉
我們的樣子！
en: Who are these people? Why are they so set
on killing us?

zh: 我猜我們快到敵人的巢穴附近了！否
則怎麼這麼多人來找麻煩？！
en: I bet we're close to the enemy's lair! Why
else would so many come after us?!

zh: 這地方真不友善！
en: This place sure isn't friendly!

zh: 沈皓！
en: Shen Hao!

zh: 咦？你知道我的名字？
en: Huh? You know my name?

zh: 是的。我找你好久了。
en: Yes. I've been looking for you a long time.

zh: 你說吧。
為何找我？
你是..
攻擊　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Speak.
{>13}Why look for me?
{>13}Who are you?
{>13}Attack{>169}Leave

zh: 你說吧。
月刀
聖城
其它　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask.
{>12}The Moon Blade
{>12}The holy city
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 你說吧。
山魅
巢穴
其它　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Ask.
{>13}The Hill Wraith
{>13}His lair
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 我是受某人所託，要來幫助你的。
en: Someone asked me to come and help you.

zh: 誰？誰要你來幫助我？
en: Who? Who sent you to help me?

zh: 你將來就會知道了。
en: You'll find out one day.

zh: 我沒有名字。你就叫我「無名」吧。
我來告訴你：「月刀在聖城裡面。」
en: I have no name. Just call me "Wuming", the
nameless one. I'm here to tell you: "The
Moon Blade lies in the holy city."

zh: 你的仇人山魅已經知道你來了！所以
他派出很多妖魔來對付你！
en: Your enemy the Hill Wraith knows you've
come! He's sent many demons after you!

zh: 你需要月刀，才能打敗魔王。我們一
定要盡快找到月刀。
en: You need the Moon Blade to defeat the
Demon King. We must find it as soon as we
can.

zh: 我也不知道「聖城」在那裡。這句話
是位白髮老者告訴我的，他說你會知
道的。
en: I don't know where the holy city is either. A
white-haired old man told me those words. He
said you'd know.

zh: 自從山魅獻祭之後，他的力量越來越
大！有時，甚至都對魔王的命令陽奉
陰違！
en: Ever since the Hill Wraith made his sacrifice,
his power keeps growing! Sometimes he even
defies the Demon King's orders behind his
back!

zh: 山魅的巢穴就在往這兒南下三十里的
城堡裡。但是一切都得要小心，因為
那裡到處滿佈機関！
en: The Hill Wraith's lair is in a castle thirty
miles south of here. Be very careful: it's
full of traps!

zh: 對付山魅絕對不能輕敵！那必定是場
苦戰！你願意讓我參加隊伍嗎？
好　　不好
en: Never underestimate the Hill Wraith! It will
be a hard fight! Will you let me join your
party?

zh: 我們走吧。
en: Let's go.

zh: 或許....真是命中註定也不一定。
en: Perhaps... it really is fate.

zh: 你要小心，一定要小心，尤其是你很
親近的人也一樣。
en: Be careful, very careful, even with those
closest to you.

zh: 私人產業，請勿擅入
en: Private property. Keep out.

zh: 你知道嗎？會失敗的只有兩種人：一
種是什麼話都不聽的人，另一種則是
什麼都聽的人！
en: You know what? Only two kinds of people
fail: those who listen to nothing, and those
who listen to everything!

zh: 要聽什麼呢？喜歡聽的，還是実話？
——"実話"的意思，通常就是指「你
不喜歡聽的話」。
en: What do you want to hear? What you like, or
the truth? "The truth" usually means "what
you don't want to hear".

zh: 所有的禍福成敗，都在你的一念之間
——聽進這句話，你就受用一輩子。
en: All fortune and ruin rest on a single
thought. Take that to heart and it will
serve you all your life.

zh: 記得有位住持曾告訴你「遇水則變」
嗎？切記啊！
en: Remember the abbot who told you "changed
by water"? Never forget it!

zh: 你怎麼知道？
en: How do you know that?

zh: 你慢慢想吧！.....
en: Think it over!...

zh: 他到底是誰？....
en: Who is he?...

zh: 不准動這裡的任何一項東西
en: Don't touch anything here.

zh: 私人產業，請勿擅入
en: Private property. Keep out.

zh: 不拿非己之物
en: Don't take what isn't yours.

zh: 請勿偷竊，違者送官府查辦
en: No stealing. Offenders will be handed to the
magistrate.

zh: 我的一條命是恩公救的！如果有什麼
恩公不嫌棄的話，請盡管拿去！
en: You saved my life, sir! If there's anything
here you'd like, please take it!

zh: 最近牆壁裂得越來越厲害了，看來得
要找人來修理一下了。
en: The cracks in the wall keep getting worse.
I'd better get someone to fix it.

zh: 什麼都沒有
en: Nothing here.

zh: 發現一個油布包
en: Found an oilcloth bundle.

zh: 咦？怎麼在牆壁裡竟然有個東西？
en: {>6}Huh? Something's inside the wall?

zh: 我不懂武功，這當然就給恩公了。
en: {>6}I don't know kung fu. It's yours, sir.

zh: 得到風火棍譜
en: Received the Blaze Rod manual.

zh: 恩公，此番前往將遇山魅，多做準備
是必要的！
en: Sir, you'll face the Hill Wraith on this
journey. Be well prepared!

zh: 打開油布包，發現風火棍譜
en: In the oilcloth bundle: the Blaze Rod manual.

zh: 天堂有路你不走！地獄無門你自闖來
！只好怪你自己命苦了！
en: You shun the road to heaven and force
your way through hell's gate! Blame your
own bad luck!

zh: 你看！是山魅的標誌！
en: Look! It's the Hill Wraith's mark!

zh: 哼！恨不得現在就跟他拼死一搏！
en: Hmph! I wish I could fight him to the death
right now!

zh: 恩公！沒想到會在這兒遇見你們！
en: My savior! I never thought I'd meet you
here!

zh: 對不起，您認錯人了吧！
en: Sorry, you must have the wrong person!

zh: 我叫劉三。那天我在十里鋪附近被妖
魔所追，幸虧恩公的幫助，否則我早
就命喪黃泉了！
en: My name is Liu San. That day near Shilipu
demons were chasing me. If you hadn't
helped me, I'd be dead and gone!

zh: 原來你就是那個逃之夭夭的傢伙！
en: So you're the guy who ran off!

zh: 對不起！那時実在太驚慌了。但是我
事後一直很愧疚，沒能當面謝謝諸位
的救命之恩！
en: Sorry! I was just too panicked. But
afterward I felt so guilty for not thanking
you in person for saving my life!

zh: 對了。諸位恩公遠來是客，到我家裡
去坐坐吧。
去　　不去
en: Oh, you've come a long way. Come to my
house and sit a while.

zh: 請跟我來。
en: Please follow me.

zh: 啊？....好吧。改天等恩公有空的時
候再說吧。
en: Oh?... All right. Another day, when you have
time.

zh: 願意去我那兒坐坐嗎？
去　　不去
en: Would you like to come sit at my place?

zh: 前些日子我在十里舖附近遭到攻擊，
竟然喊救命都沒人來救！唉！真是世
風日下，人情淡薄啊！
en: A while ago I was attacked near Shilipu, and
nobody came when I cried for help! Sigh! The
world's going downhill, people have no heart!

zh: 人真的會越變越無情嗎？
en: Are people really getting colder and colder?

zh: 你聽過「蠶蝕鯨吞」這個成語嗎？這
是用來形容我手上這個宝貝法術的，
它能消耗敵人的能量於無形，怎麼樣
，有興趣嗎？我只要價500 銖銅錢就
en: "Silkworm nibbles, whale gulps": that's my
treasure art. It drains the enemy's energy
unseen. Interested? I'm only asking 500
gold,

zh: 好了。
要　　不要
en: that's all.

zh: 好了，剩下來的就靠你自己了。
en: There. The rest is up to you.

zh: 等錢夠了再來好了。
en: Come back when you have the money.

zh: 好吧，那就算了。
en: All right, forget it.

zh: 得到蠶食術法
en: Learned Erode.

zh: 我先回去整理一下...
en: I'll go home first and tidy up...

zh: 沈皓！你怎麼了？
en: Shen Hao! What's wrong?
...Did you have a nightmare?...

zh: ....我夢到....即使我的手再怎麼伸
，也沒有人願意理我....一直喊著，
也沒人理會....他們都鄙夷的罵我，
說我是邪惡之子....
en: ...I dreamed... however far I reached out, no
one would take my hand... I kept calling, but
no one answered... They all sneered at me
and called me the Son of Evil...

zh: ....不過是個夢啊！....
en: ...It was just a dream!...

zh: ....如果有一天，我真的變成了泯滅
人性的邪惡之子....你們還會把我當
成朋友嗎？
en: ...If one day I really become an inhuman Son
of Evil... will you still be my friends?

zh: 為什麼！為什麼這些事會發生在我身
上！為什麼是我？難道我生下來真是
一個錯誤嗎？！....
en: Why! Why is this happening to me! Why me?
Was I a mistake from the day I was born?!...

zh: 我討厭軟弱、自怨自艾的人！那只會
一事無成而已！
en: I hate weak, self-pitying people! They never
get anything done!

zh: ....豁出去吧！都不要再想了！想只
會產生苦惱！不如站起來去對抗吧！
en: ...Just go for it! Stop thinking! Thinking
only brings misery! Stand up and fight it!

zh: ....我希望建立一個和平的世界....
不再流血或彼此傷害......或許我的
想法太天真了吧。......
en: ...I want to build a peaceful world... where
no one bleeds or hurts each other
anymore... Maybe I'm too naive...

zh: 沈皓！納命來！
en: Shen Hao! Prepare to die!

zh: 太過份了吧！連這兒都追過來！
en: This is too much! They chased us all the way
here!

zh: 休息一次100銖錢
要　　不要
en: A rest is 100 gold.

zh: 小店本錢微薄，恕不賒帳...
en: We're a small shop. No credit, sorry...

zh: 山魅！你給我出來！
en: Hill Wraith! Come out!

zh: 咖咖！無知小輩！你的生命就如螻蟻
一般的輕賤！也不想想，當初若不是
我手下留情，你那能活到今日！
en: Heh heh! Ignorant whelp! Your life is as
cheap as an ant's! Remember, if I hadn't
spared you back then, you'd never have
lived to this day!

zh: 今日我一定要殺了你，為我父母報仇
en: Today I'll kill you and avenge my parents!

zh: 猖狂小子！那麼想死就進來吧！
en: Insolent brat! If you want to die so badly,
come in!
...Hmm, not bad!

zh: 孩子，你比我想像的要強得多了。很
好。但不要再做無謂的掙扎了吧！在
我的眼裡，你再怎麼練，也敵不過我
的一根小指頭的！咖咖咖....
en: Child, you're much stronger than I thought.
Very good. But stop this useless struggle!
In my eyes, however much you train, you're
no match for my little finger! Heh heh heh...

zh: ....牠是誰？....怎麼那麼恐怖？
en: ...Who is that?... Why is he so terrifying?

zh: 小子！死亡遊戲開始啦！咖咖咖！
en: Kid! Let the game of death begin! Heh heh
heh!

zh: 你需要鑰匙來開門
en: You need a key to open the door.

zh: 你看到一個鑰匙孔
en: You see a keyhole.

zh: 門上鎖了！打不開......
en: The door is locked! It won't open...

zh: ....椅子下好像有東西....
en: ...There seems to be something under the
chair...

zh: 你看到一個鑰匙孔...
en: You see a keyhole...

zh: 你需要鑰匙Ｍ
en: You need Key M.

zh: 不錯嘛！小子！看來我當初沒一掌劈
死你，還真是失算！
en: Not bad, kid! I see it was a mistake not to
kill you with one blow back then!

zh: 你現在後悔已經來不及了！
en: It's too late for regrets now!

zh: 哼！小賊！你當我真的怕你嗎？！
en: Hmph! Little thief! You think I'm really
afraid of you?!

zh: 我今天要殺了你，血祭我的父母！你
把我們全家害得多慘哪！為什麼？！
沈家與你有什麼深仇大恨嗎？！
en: Today I'll kill you and offer your blood to
my parents! Look what you did to my family!
Why?! What did the Shens ever do to you?!

zh: 為什麼？哼！誰叫你母親不愛我？..
....我是那麼的愛她啊！....
en: Why? Hmph! Because your mother wouldn't
love me!... I loved her so much!...

zh: 我父母非常相愛啊！
en: My parents loved each other deeply!

zh: 閉嘴！....她怎麼可以不愛我？....
不可以....你知道我愛她多深嗎？！
....可是....她竟然連死都不看我一
眼....我恨！我真恨啊！....
en: Shut up!... How could she not love me?... She
couldn't... Do you know how deeply I loved
her?!... Yet... she wouldn't look at me even
as she died... I hate it! I hate it so!...

zh: 而且你父親並不是我害死的，是你！
他是為了幫你拿摩尼宝珠，才會死的
！是你害死他的！是你！
en: And I didn't kill your father. You did! He
died getting the Mani Jewel for you! You
killed him! You!

zh: ....你胡說！胡說！
en: ...Liar! Liar!

zh: 你心裡清楚的很！如果不是為你，你
父親就不會死....如果你沒有來到這
世上就好了！....因為你，他們才會
死的！....將來你也會變成邪惡的魔
en: You know it well! If not for you, your
father wouldn't have died... If only you'd
never been born!... They died because of
you!... Someday you'll become an evil

zh: 鬼，會害死更多更多的人！....
en: demon and kill many, many more!...
...Lies!

zh: ....咖咖！隨你便吧！....我快死了
！真可惜，不能看你登基，咖..咖..
en: ...Heh heh! Believe what you like!... I'm
dying! What a pity I won't see your
coronation, heh... heh...
...He croaked!

zh: 沈皓！你千萬不能聽信他的話啊！不
是你的錯啊！
en: Shen Hao! Don't believe a word he said! It's
not your fault!

zh: 這種惡徒真是死不足惜、死有餘辜！
死對他們而言都還是便宜他了呢！
en: Scum like that deserve to die a thousand
times! Death is too good for them!

zh: 唉....太濃烈的愛，有時反而會變成
殺人的利器啊....
en: Sigh... Love that burns too fiercely can
sometimes become a deadly weapon...

zh: 沈皓！沈皓！....
en: Shen Hao! Shen Hao!...

zh: ....難道....我真是受詛咒的人嗎？
en: ...Am I... really cursed?

zh: ....我來唱歌給你聽......
春日才看楊柳綠，秋風又見菊花黃
榮華終是三更夢，富貴還同九月霜
老病生死誰替得，酸甜苦辣自承當
en: ...Let me sing you a song...
Spring's willows green, autumn's mums gold;
glory is a midnight dream, wealth is frost;
age and death, none can bear them for you.

zh: 從來硬弦弩先断，每見鋼刀口易傷
惹禍只因閒口舌，招愆多為狠心腸
en: The tightest bow breaks first, the sharpest
blade is soonest dulled; trouble comes from
idle tongues, and sin from a cruel heart.

zh: 生前枉費心千萬，死後空持手一雙
悲歡離合朝朝鬧，百年渾是戲一場
en: Scheme all your life; in death your hands
are empty. Joy, grief, meeting, parting:
a hundred years are but one play.

zh: 小子！你很有耐性聽老乞丐胡唱嘛！
很好，老丐多年沒唱那麼爽過了！這
裡有個胡疆怪人的『盜魂術法』，據
說可以"偷天換日"，將敵人之力轉到
en: Kid! You've got patience for an old beggar's
songs! I haven't sung so happily in years!
Here's "Soul Theft", from some odd
foreigner. It moves the enemy's strength

zh: 自己身上！這老丐也沒什麼用了，就
給了你吧！
en: into yourself! It's no use to this old beggar
anymore. It's yours!

zh: 以前這兒有個内陸鹽海，我們也都以
曬鹽維生。但近年來天候反常，鹽海
也漸漸乾涸了，害得大家只好離開，
去別的地方討生活了。
en: There used to be a salt lake here, and we
all lived by drying salt. But the weather's
gone strange, the lake has dried up, and
everyone's leaving to find work elsewhere.

zh: 有什麼我可以幫助你的嗎？
老鹽池
週遭環境
聖城　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Is there anything I can help you with?
{>13}Old Salt Lake
{>13}The area
{>13}The holy city{>169}Leave

zh: 這裡只剩下幾個工人，與一對祖孫而
已，但這兒遲早人都會走光的，活不
下去又能怎樣呢？
en: Only a few workers and a grandfather and
grandchild are left. Sooner or later
everyone will leave. What can you do if you
can't make a living?

zh: 出了村往南走沒多久，就是月牙湖了
。那兒真漂亮，你是該去看看！
en: Not far south of the village is Crescent
Lake. It's beautiful there. You should go
see it!

zh: 什麼？！...."聖城"？！我待在這十
幾年了，從沒看過或聽過這啥玩意！
這裡除了一片黃土外，啥都沒有！我
想你是弄錯了地方吧！
en: What?!... "Holy city"?! I've been here over
ten years and never seen or heard of any
such thing! There's nothing here but yellow
dirt! I think you've got the wrong place!

zh: 這地方遲早會荒廢了....
en: This place will be abandoned sooner or
later...

zh: 待了十幾年了，也不能說沒有感情..
....沒辦法....肚皮要緊啊！
en: After over ten years, you can't say I
don't care for it... But what can I do... I
need to eat!

zh: 老丐沒東西可以送你啦！難道這身破
鋪蓋你也要不成！
en: This old beggar has nothing to give you!
Don't tell me you want my ragged bedroll
too!

zh: 得到盜魂術法
en: Learned Soul Theft.

zh: 小心！不要太靠近那口井！那次我差
點摔下去呢！雖說已經乾枯了，但還
是要小心！
en: Careful! Don't get too close to that well! I
nearly fell in once! It's dry, but be careful
anyway!

zh: 那口井很深的，掉下去就完了，不要
太靠近哪！
en: That well is very deep. Fall in and you're
finished. Don't get too close!

zh: 小心哪，這井周圍的石頭已經鬆了，
如果一不小心就會倒塌，所以千萬不
要靠在井辺啊！
en: Careful, the stones around the well are
loose. One slip and it could collapse, so
never lean on the edge!

zh: 喂！喂！快離開！這兒很危險的！那
麼深的井，掉下去會完蛋的啊！
en: Hey! Hey! Get away from there! It's
dangerous! A well that deep, fall in and
you're done for!
...Help... sob...

zh: 有人喊救命？！
en: Someone's calling for help?!

zh: 會不會聽錯了？
en: Maybe we heard wrong?

zh: 我們該怎麼辦？
en: What should we do?

zh: 剛剛不是有人說這井的四辺牆已經鬆
了，要我們小心不要太靠近嗎？
en: Didn't someone just say the walls of this
well are loose, and told us not to get too
close?

zh: 用繩子下去吧！
en: Let's climb down with a rope!

zh: 太謝謝你們了！老頭正傷心著他的孫
女不見了呢！
en: Thank you so much! The old man's been
heartbroken that his granddaughter went
missing!
Grandpa... Grandpa...

zh: 你有工作給我做嗎？....不要薪水，
只要提供我吃住就可以了！
en: Got any work for me?... No pay needed, just
food and a roof!

zh: 有什麼我可以幫助你的嗎？
老鹽池
月牙湖
聖域　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Is there anything I can help you with?
{>13}Old Salt Lake
{>13}Crescent Lake
{>13}The holy land{>169}Leave

zh: 這個地方我是一定要離開了，在這個
鳥不拉屎的地方，遲早會餓死的！
en: I'm definitely leaving this place. In this
godforsaken spot I'll starve sooner or
later!

zh: 就是南方那個大湖嘛！它被高山包圍
著。而湖的對岸從來也沒人去過，不
知道是什麼樣子！
en: It's that big lake to the south! It's ringed
by high mountains. No one has ever been to
the far shore. Nobody knows what's there!

zh: 聖城？！我看你老兄幻想小說看太多
了吧！
en: A holy city?! I think you've read too many
fantasy novels, pal!

zh: 為什麼所有的事物都無法久存呢？..
不断的得到、失去、得到、失去....
en: Why can't anything last?... Always gaining,
losing, gaining, losing...

zh: 這不知是誰丟在這裡的，既然你喜歡
，就送你吧。
en: I don't know who left this here. Since you
like it, take it.

zh: 又沒事幹，不睡覺幹嘛？
en: Nothing to do, so why not sleep?

zh: 好累啊....休息一下吧！
en: So tired... Let's rest a bit!

zh: 你有沒有看到我的小孫女？....
真奇怪！她說要去救她的娃娃，然後
從此就不見這娃兒了。
en: Have you seen my little granddaughter?...
So strange! She said she was going to
rescue her doll, and then she just vanished.
A doll?...

zh: 是啊，她最喜歡的一個布娃娃。
en: Yes, a rag doll. Her favorite.

zh: 你有看到我孫女嗎？
en: Have you seen my granddaughter?

zh: 謝謝！要不是你們，我這宝貝孫女可
就一命嗚呼了！
en: Thank you! If not for you, my precious
granddaughter would be dead!

zh: 謝謝你們！救了我跟我的娃娃！
en: Thank you! You saved me and my doll!

zh: 有什麼我可以幫助你的嗎？
老鹽池
月牙湖
聖城　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: Is there anything I can help you with?
{>13}Old Salt Lake
{>13}Crescent Lake
{>13}The holy city{>169}Leave

zh: 唉....我眼看著這鹽池興旺與衰敗，
....可惜啊！就像人老了，終會被淘
汰一般，這鹽場終也面臨了荒廢的下
場！
en: Sigh... I watched this salt lake boom and
fade... A pity! Just as people grow old and
are cast aside, the salt works too will end
up abandoned!

zh: 関於這湖有個很美的傳說。據說有日
天上的神仙不小心摔落了手中的鏡子
，那鏡子掉下凡間，就變成今日的
月牙湖了。
en: There's a lovely legend about the lake. One
day an immortal in heaven dropped her
mirror by accident. It fell to earth and
became Crescent Lake.

zh: ....好像在我小時候吧，曾聽人說起
這個傳說，但也只是說說有趣吧！大
家都說，在聖城裡有著青春之泉，能
治百病，回人青春呢！但說歸說，從
en: ...As a child I heard that legend, just as a
story! They said the holy city had a
fountain of youth that cured all ills and
made you young! But no one

zh: 來也沒人見過它！更甭說去過了！
en: ever saw it, let alone went there!

zh: 小朋友，你們也該回家去了吧，再往
前已經沒有路了！
en: Kids, you should head home. There's no road
further on!

zh: 趁年輕時快努力吧，不要像我一樣，
老了才覺得惶恐！
en: Work hard while you're young, or you'll end
up like me, scared only once you're old!

zh: 要離開井底嗎？
要　　不要
en: Leave the bottom of the well?

zh: 奇怪，剛剛明明聽見有人喊救命，為
何不見蹤影？
en: Strange. I clearly heard someone call for
help. Why isn't anyone here?

zh: 是啊！....而且現在又沒聽見喊救聲
en: Yes!... And now there's no more shouting?...

zh: 會不會剛剛聽錯了？我看我們還是上
去吧。
要　　不要
en: Maybe we heard wrong? I think we should go
back up.

zh: 應該不會吧！何況剛才那位老伯還焦
急的要找他孫女呢！
en: I don't think so! Besides, that old man was
desperate to find his granddaughter!

zh: 或許這井底另有蹊蹺，咱們查查看吧
en: Maybe there's more to this well. Let's check
it out!

zh: 可是我們又怎麼上去呢？....
en: But how will we get back up?...

zh: 有人在喊救命嗎？
en: Is someone calling for help?

zh: 是啊！我們在井底.....
en: Yes! We're at the bottom of the well...
What?... Wait...

zh: 你們抓著繩子上來吧!
en: Grab the rope and climb up!

zh: 只有用最原始的方法了....
en: We'll have to do it the old-fashioned way...

zh: 爺爺....爺爺....我要爺爺....我要
回家找爺爺....
en: Grandpa... Grandpa... I want Grandpa... I
want to go home to Grandpa...

zh: 救命啊！救命啊！
en: Help! Help!

zh: 少主，你為何尚在此處逗留呢？還請
少主儘速前往魔域聖城，相信大王已
在那兒等候你了呢！
en: Young Master, why do you linger here?
Please hurry to the holy city of the demon
realm. Surely His Majesty awaits you there!

zh: 我不是你們的少主；識相的就快快將
那少女放了，否則我手上這把兵刃絕
不饒你！
en: I'm not your Young Master. If you know
what's good for you, let the girl go, or this
blade won't spare you!

zh: 何必與他多費口舌，殺將過去就是了
en: Why waste words on him? Let's just cut our
way through!

zh: 少主，勿聽信他人讒言....
en: Young Master, don't listen to their
slander...

zh: 少主，歡迎你的到來！奴婢在此恭候
已久。
en: Welcome, Young Master! Your servant has
long awaited you here.

zh: 妳是誰？誰又是妳的少主？
en: Who are you? And who's your Young Master?

zh: 奴婢乃殿前侍舞，前些時日還蒙少主
拯救於甕内，尚不知該如何為報！今
特於此恭候少主聖駕。
en: I am the Hall Dancer. Not long ago you
freed me from the urn, Young Master, and I
know not how to repay you! I have awaited
your arrival here.

zh: 妳原來是被囚於丘道人甕内之人？
en: So you're the one trapped in Taoist Qiu's
urn?

zh: 奴婢乃殿前侍舞，奉命在此恭候少主
聖駕。
en: I am the Hall Dancer, ordered to await your
arrival here, Young Master.

zh: 殿前侍舞？！
en: Hall Dancer?!

zh: 少主，咱奉旨在此煉丹，以期在登基
之日能呈獻與少主做為至高無上之賀
禮！
en: Young Master, by decree I brew an elixir
here, to present to you on your coronation
day as the supreme gift!

zh: 煉丹？
en: An elixir?

zh: 此丹乃採處女之純陰，配合此地窟至
陰至冷之天成條件，經九九八十一天
才能有成；此丹能讓少主永生不滅，
乃魔界眾妖夢寐難得之宝物呢！
en: It takes the pure yin of maidens and the
deathly cold of this cave, and eighty-one
days to complete. It grants eternal life!
Every demon dreams of such a treasure!

zh: 一路上所遇少女失蹤之離奇事件，原
來就是妳們派出嘍囉到處犯案呀！
en: So all the missing girls along the way were
the work of your henchmen!

zh: 少主，奴婢看你這一路上，似乎受到
許多障礙你成就大業之阻力。否則此
時你應泛閃青碧之霞光，此霞光目前
似乎若有若無呢！
en: Young Master, it seems many obstacles have
hindered your great destiny on your
journey. Or by now you'd shine with an
emerald glow, yet it seems barely there!

zh: 少主，可否聽奴婢一言，速速前往魔
域聖城，奴婢趕工完成後，隨後即往
好　　不好
en: Young Master, heed your servant: hurry to
the holy city of the demon realm. I'll follow
once my work is done.

zh: 你後悔了嗎？
是　　不是
en: Do you regret it?

zh: 大膽妖魔，妳竟敢做出如此傷天害理
之事情！
en: Brazen demon, how dare you commit such an
outrage!

zh: 孽畜，快交出少女，或可饒妳不死，
從輕發落！
en: Fiend, hand over the girls and we may spare
your life!

zh: 咖咖！沒想到就是你們這些損友一直
在妨礙少主之修行
en: Heh heh! So it's you bad friends who keep
getting in the way of the Young Master's
training!

zh: 少女都在丹魔那兒，不過，我看你們
是見不到了。
en: The girls are all with the Elixir Demon. But I
don't think you'll ever see them.

zh: 得到慢影術法
en: Learned Slow.

zh: 得到藥王咒法
en: Learned the Heal Song.

zh: 這裡似乎有個通道！！
en: There seems to be a passage here!!

zh: 不知會通往何處？？
en: I wonder where it leads??

zh: 我們還是先幫老伯找回他的小孫女再
說吧！。
en: Let's help the old man find his
granddaughter first!

zh: 女娃兒，趕快回家去吧！妳爺爺正等
著妳呢。
en: Little girl, hurry home! Your grandpa is
waiting for you.

zh: 這個圖案看起來有點眼熟，好像和壁
讓我來試試看....
en: This design looks familiar. It looks like the
mural shard... Maybe... Let me try...

zh: 鑲上壁飾碎片
en: Set the mural shard in place.

zh: 太棒了！這應該就是所謂的月刀了！
en: Great! This must be the Moon Blade!

zh: 可是....我拔不出來呢！
en: But... I can't pull it out!

zh: 怎麼辦？拔不出來呢？！
en: What do we do? It won't come out?!

zh: 這兒有一個凹槽，不知是幹嘛用的！
en: There's a hollow here. I wonder what it's
for!

zh: 咦？....它會不會是....
en: Huh?... Could it be...

zh: ....你終於辦到了.....
en: ...You've finally done it...

zh: 你是誰？
en: Who are you?

zh: 我是天劍與月刀的魂魄，當兩械合一
時，我才存在，換句話說，這兩把器
械是一體的。
en: I am the spirit of the Sky Sword and Moon
Blade. I exist only when the two are united.
In other words, the two weapons are one.

zh: 你想知道什麼？
天劍與月刀
魔王
登基大典　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Sword and Blade
{>13}The Demon King
{>13}The coronation{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼？
從地底生起
預言
其它　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}Rising from below
{>13}The prophecy
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 你想知道什麼？
火龍
正邪未卜
其它　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What do you want to know?
{>13}The fire dragon
{>13}Good or evil?
{>13}Other{>169}Leave

zh: 天劍與月刀是同體的，缺一不可的；
如同有陰必有陽，若能正反兩面合一
，才是一個整體。
en: The Sky Sword and Moon Blade are one body.
Neither can do without the other. As yin
needs yang, only when both sides unite is it
whole.

zh: 不管多麼強的人，總有他害怕的東西
與事物；相反的，雖然非常弱小，但
只要具備某種條件，還是可以戰勝的
en: However strong a man is, there's always
something he fears. And however weak, with
the right conditions he can still win!... Do
you understand?...

zh: 魔典預言，登基大典將發生在月蝕之
際。當黑暗從地底升起，即是邪惡之
子繼承魔界無辺的力量之時！等到那
一刻，這世間的一切都將面臨毀滅的
en: The scriptures say the coronation comes at
the eclipse. When darkness rises from below,
the Son of Evil inherits the demons' power!
Then the whole world faces

zh: 命運！
en: destruction!

zh: 據說魔城是在地底深八萬四千公里的
地方，那裡的一切均由意志扭曲幻化
而成。行走其中常會迷失，而不知身
在何處。
en: They say the demon castle lies 84,000 miles
underground, where all is twisted and
shaped by will. Those who walk there often
get lost, not knowing where they are.

zh: 那是千年前記载在魔典中的一段話：
「千年之後，五象隕落，結合三界之
邪惡之子將乘火龍而降，正邪未卜。
此子登基之際，即為魔輪世紀之開始
en: The demon scriptures say: "After a
thousand years, five omens fall, and the
Son of Evil, uniting three realms, descends
on a fire dragon.

zh: 。燒盡世間一切，無人能阻。」
en: Good or evil, none can tell. At his
coronation the demon wheel turns, burning
all the world. None can stop it."

zh: 傳說中，它是邪惡之子的座騎。你會
遇見它的，因為那是命運的牽引。
en: Legend says it is the Son of Evil's steed.
You will meet it, for fate draws you
together.

zh: 面對不可知的未來，讓你的心引領著
你吧....你要知道：所有的因子都是
潛伏在你的心中啊..
en: Facing the unknown future, let your heart
guide you... Know this: every seed lies hidden
in your own heart...

zh: 你可以改變你的命運。在西北極地高
峰上有座小島，島上有處千年不凍的
泉水，據說那泉水具有可以洗淨靈魂
的神奇功效....
en: You can change your fate. In the far
northwest is an island with a spring that
hasn't frozen in a thousand years. They
say its water can cleanse the soul...

zh: 哇！天劍變得好鋒利！而且不再像以
前那般沉重了！
en: Whoa! The Sky Sword is so sharp now! And
it's not as heavy as before!

zh: 再往前去，就是闇冥之王的地方了，
青銅峽是天煞地煞的盤踞之所，非常
凶險，記得....你必須要儘快的將塔
頂的邪火給除去，否則，你將會被它
en: Beyond lies the King of Darkness. Bronze
Gorge, lair of Tiansha and Disha, is deadly.
Remember... quickly destroy the evil fire
atop the tower, or it will

zh: 們吞噬進地底深處.....
去吧，孩子，一切要小心啊.....
en: swallow you into the depths of the earth...
Go, child, and be careful...

zh: 試試把天劍插進去......
en: Try inserting the Sky Sword...

zh: 得到天劍
en: Received the Sky Sword.

zh: 啊！狂風沙！
en: Ah! A sandstorm!

zh: ....我們該怎麼辦呢？
en: ...What do we do?

zh: 我們現在只差一顆摩尼宝珠了，大家
趕緊努力吧！
en: We're only one Mani Jewel short now. Let's
hurry, everyone!

zh: 可是最後一顆摩尼宝珠到底在那裡呢
en: But where is the last Mani Jewel?

zh: ....我有時不禁會懷疑，我真能改變
en: ...Sometimes I can't help wondering, can I
really change my fate?...

zh: 哼！你們是何方神聖，竟敢打擾我！
en: Hmph! Who do you think you are, disturbing
me!

zh: 咖！咖！你們終究還是來了！
en: Heh! Heh! So you've come at last!

zh: 沈皓，你好啊！
en: Hello, Shen Hao!

zh: 你認識我？..我幾時變得如此有名？
en: You know me?... Since when am I so famous?

zh: 咖咖！不止我認得你，全村的人都知
道你呢！
en: Heh heh! Not just me, the whole village
knows you!

zh: ....真是好事不出門，坯事傳千里..
en: ...Good news stays home, bad news travels
far...

zh: 你別瞎猜了，待會兒你就知道了。
en: Stop guessing. You'll find out soon.

zh: 小皓，你終於來啦！有人等你等到頭
髮都白啦！
en: Little Hao, you've come at last! Someone's
been waiting for you till his hair turned
white!
...Who... is waiting for me??

zh: 嘻！你待會兒就知道了。
en: Hee! You'll find out soon.

zh: 這白崖風景還不錯，你就到處看看吧
en: White Cliff has nice scenery. Have a look
around!

zh: ‧‧‧應該是這兒吧！‧‧‧
en: ...This should be the place!...

zh: 沈皓，你什麼時候變得這麼有名啦？
en: Shen Hao, since when are you so famous?

zh: 不過，他們好像沒什麼惡意的樣子。
en: Still, they don't seem to mean any harm.

zh: 管他的！什麼陣仗沒碰過，走吧！
en: Who cares! We've seen it all. Let's go!

zh: 孩子，你來了！好！好！
en: Child, you've come! Good! Good!

zh: 啊！你不就是在神池附近幫助我們渡
海的人嗎？‧‧‧請問您是？‧‧‧
en: Ah! Aren't you the one who helped us cross
the sea near the Sacred Pool?... May I ask
who you are?...

zh: 我是你外公啊！孩子！
en: I'm your grandfather, child!

zh: 我等你好久了，孩子！來吧‧‧‧你
娘也等你好久‧‧‧
en: I've waited for you so long, child! Come...
Your mother has waited a long time too...
My mother?! But......

zh: 跟我來吧！待會兒你就會明白了。
en: Come with me! You'll understand soon.

zh: 白員外家
en: Squire Bai's House
...Mother?... Is it Mother?...

zh: 當年你娘送回來時，已經奄奄一息了
十幾年來，我們不断以聖露水澆注，
才讓她延活至今‧‧‧
en: When your mother was brought back, she
was at death's door. For over ten years
we've kept her alive with holy dew...

zh: ‧‧‧孩子，你來了嗎？‧‧‧
en: ...Child, have you come?...

zh: 這‧‧‧這到底怎麼一回事？
en: What... what's going on?

zh: 孩子，當年娘在臨死之際‧‧‧
en: Child, back when I was dying...

zh: 是的，我是你娘的心珠所化‧‧‧
en: Yes, I was born from your mother's heart
pearl...

zh: 你娘拚著最後一口氣，將自己的元神
化為明珠，只為了這樣可以去幫助她
的孩子‧‧‧
en: With her last breath, your mother turned
her spirit into a bright pearl, all so it could
help her child...

zh: 可憐的孩子，一出世就得面對這樣的
命運‧‧‧
en: Poor child, facing such a fate from the
moment you were born...

zh: ‧‧‧命運並非一切天註定！只要心
念一轉，命運之輪也會隨之而轉動的
‧‧要記得啊！孩子‧‧‧
en: ...Fate is not all decided by heaven! Change
your heart, and the wheel of fate turns
with it... Remember that, child...

zh: 這是我們族人幫你尋到的‧‧‧
en: Our people found this for you...

zh: 太棒了！七顆全蒐集齊了！
en: Wonderful! We've got all seven!

zh: 現在你必須趕緊去西北方的鎖龍洞去
，救出火龍。只有牠才能帶你去海上
的不凍泉。也只有到了不凍泉之後，
你才能運用這七顆摩尼宝珠，暫時鎮
en: Now hurry northwest to Suolong Cave and
free the fire dragon. Only it can take you
to the Ice-Free Spring at sea. Only there
can you use the seven jewels to suppress

zh: 住你體内的邪氣。如果，你常存正氣
，則體内邪氣，自然消弭於無形；如
果你心中之氣，正邪難分，那你應用
此七顆宝珠，配合天劍月刀，化作九
en: the evil within you. Keep your heart upright
and the evil will fade on its own. If good and
evil are mixed in you, the jewels with the
Sword and Blade make nine

zh: 道彩光，逼退邪惡因子；如果你體内
盡是邪氣，那麼，這九道光芒，將會
‧‧‧毀掉你。
en: rays of light to drive out the evil. But if
you're filled with evil, those nine rays will...
destroy you.

zh: 你所缺的宝珠，分別在‧‧‧
en: The jewels you lacked were...

zh: 紫色摩尼珠在清江城
en: The Purple Jewel in Qingjiang City.

zh: 綠色摩尼珠在水城
en: The Green Jewel in Water City.

zh: 藍色摩尼珠在神池
en: The Blue Jewel at the Sacred Pool.

zh: 白色摩尼珠在青銅峽
en: The White Jewel in Bronze Gorge.

zh: 黃色摩尼珠在鉄辺城
en: The Yellow Jewel in Tiebian Castle.

zh: 你必須趕緊到西北方的鎖龍洞，去救
出被禁錮的火龍。牠能载你到任何地
方，去找回宝珠。找到七顆宝珠後，
你要儘快到海上的不凍泉，運用這七
en: Hurry to Suolong Cave in the northwest and
free the fire dragon. It can carry you
anywhere to find the jewels. With all seven,
go quickly to the Ice-Free Spring and use

zh: 顆宝珠，暫時鎮壓你身上的邪氣！如
果那時你體内早有浩然正氣，則你體
内邪氣，自然消弭於無形；如果，你
心中之氣，正邪不分，則你應即時運
en: the seven jewels to suppress the evil in
you! If by then your heart is filled with
righteousness, the evil will fade away on its
own. If good and evil are mixed in you, use

zh: 用這七顆宝珠，配合天劍月刀，化作
九道彩光，逼退邪惡因子；如果你體
内，早就邪氣滿佈，那麼‧‧‧這九
道光芒，將會‧‧‧毀掉你。
en: the seven jewels with the Sword and Blade
to make nine rays of light and drive out the
evil. But if you're already full of evil...
those nine rays will... destroy you.

zh: ‧‧‧孩子，勇敢地面對吧！千萬不
要恐懼；所有的邪惡力量，都是來自
恐懼‧‧‧
en: ...Child, face it bravely! Never be afraid. All
evil power comes from fear...

zh: 孩子呀！要勇敢啊！黑暗中還是會有
光明的存在啊！
en: My child! Be brave! Even in darkness there
is still light!
...Mother... Grandfather...

zh: 我不希望再有別離了‧‧‧不要再有
悲傷，不要再有死亡‧‧‧
en: I don't want any more partings... No more
sorrow, no more death...

zh: 只要打倒魔王，就可以停止這血腥的
一切了！是的，為了所有人，我都應
該這麼做。
en: If I defeat the Demon King, all this
bloodshed will end! Yes, for everyone's
sake, that's what I must do.

zh: 嗯！這樣我們也就放心了。
en: Mm! Then we can rest easy.

zh: 沈大哥，老爺爺等你等好久了呢！
en: Brother Shen, the old man has been waiting
for you a long time!

zh: 辛苦啦！這回可好好休息一下吧。待
會兒有空就來我們這兒坐坐！
en: Well done! Get a good rest this time. Drop by
our place when you have time!

zh: 沈哥哥，你趕快回去啊！白爺爺在等
你呢！
en: Brother Shen, hurry back! Grandpa Bai is
waiting for you!

zh: 我看你還是先去看看白爺一趟，再來
我們這裡吧。
en: I think you should see Grandpa Bai first,
then come to us.

zh: 嗯，這應該對你有用，你就拿去吧。
en: Mm, this should be useful to you. Take it.

zh: 發現子午刀
en: Found the Noon Blade.

zh: 啊！這不是小皓嗎？你終於回來了，
來來來，想要什麼武器呢？隨便你選
一個當見面禮‧‧‧
en: Ah! Isn't this Little Hao? You've come back
at last! Come, come, what weapon would you
like? Pick any one as a welcome gift...

zh: 怎麼樣，隨便選一項吧！
金魚劍
雙手斧
大鉄弓　　　　　　　　　不要
en: Go on, pick one!
{>13}Carp Sword
{>13}Great Axe
{>13}Iron Bow{>169}None

zh: 謝謝您的好意，不過無功不受祿！還
是再說吧！
en: Thank you, but I can't accept what I
haven't earned! Maybe another time!

zh: 小皓子，真的是你嗎？咖咖咖！真不
敢相信，已經長這樣大了，咖咖咖！
真是一表人材。這樣好了，我就送你
一副防具當你的成人禮吧！
en: Little Hao, is it really you? Ha ha ha! I
can't believe how big you've grown, ha ha!
So handsome. I'll give you a piece of armor
as a coming-of-age gift!

zh: 千萬不要客氣，一定要選哦！
青銅盔
銅　甲
鎖子甲　　　　　　　　　不要
en: Don't be shy, you must choose one!
{>13}Brass Helm
{>13}Brass Mail
{>13}Chain Mail{>169}None

zh: 皓子啊！東西買一買，得快些到白爺
那兒去，村尾那棟白土屋子便是！
en: Hao, once you're done shopping, hurry to
Grandpa Bai's. It's the white clay house at
the end of the village!
...Grandfather...
...Mother...
...Hao'er...

zh: 到底怎麼一回事？
en: ...Ah!... Mother... Grandfather, what is going
on?

zh: 皓兒，這一切的幻覺，都只是為了等
你回來，見你一面而已。想當年你娘
帶你逃離這裏時，不過足月而已‧‧
en: Hao'er, all these visions were only to see
you once when you came back. When your
mother fled with you, you were barely a
month old...

zh: 皓兒，我想你爹應該早就告訴你，娘
本是這白崖修煉的幽蘭‧‧‧，十六
年前遇到你爹，以為從此可以鍾愛一
生，沒想到‧‧‧
en: Hao'er, your father must have told you I
was an orchid spirit of White Cliff... Sixteen
years ago I met him and thought we'd love
each other forever, but...

zh: 不過，還能再見到你，也算是老天待
我不薄，為娘已經心滿意足了；現在
，塵緣已盡‧‧‧唯一放心不下的，
便是你爹跟你！
en: But seeing you again shows heaven has been
kind. I'm content. Now my ties to this world
are done... All I worry about is your father
and you!

zh: ‧‧‧爹‧‧‧爹已經死了‧‧‧
en: ...Father... Father is dead...

zh: 什麼！‧‧‧唉‧‧‧一切都是命；
現在終於可以真正跟你爹在一起，遊
盡碧落黃泉了！皓兒，你要好好地過
en: What!... Sigh... It's all fate. Now I can truly
be with your father, through heaven and
the underworld! Hao'er, live your life well...
Mother!......

zh: 別難過了，至少他們二老已經得到真
正的安息了！
en: Don't grieve. At least they're both truly at
peace now!

zh: 為了避免同樣的悲劇發生，我們更應
該番力前行，這才是你爹娘真正的希
望，不是嗎？
en: To keep this tragedy from happening again,
we must press on harder. That's what your
parents really wanted, isn't it?

zh: 謝謝你們，我一定要親手扭轉這個可
悲的命運！
en: Thank you all. I'll overturn this cruel fate
with my own hands!

zh: 誰！是誰好大膽子，敢來吵醒我！
en: Who! Who dares wake me!

zh: 發現牆上有一個按鈕
en: You find a button on the wall.

zh: 你要按下嗎？
要　　不要
en: Press it?

zh: 你們總說妖怪會危害人世，難道像你
們這樣到處殺我族類，到處搶宝物，
就值得學習嗎？你們跟殺人越貨的強
盜有何不同？人其実比妖怪更狠毒！
en: You say demons harm the world, yet you kill
my kind and steal our treasure. How are
you any different from robbers? Humans
are crueler than demons!

zh: 為什麼每隔一段時間，就會有自稱什
麼勇者啦，正義之士的小偷，來我們
這裏殺人，偷東西‧‧‧我們在地底
安靜過日子，這又招誰惹誰了？‧‧
en: Why, every so often, do thieves calling
themselves heroes or champions of justice
come here to kill and steal... We live quietly
underground. Who did we ever hurt?...

zh: ‧‧‧這是什麼東西啊！
en: ...What is this thing!

zh: ‧‧‧嘿！裏面好像有什麼呢！
en: ...Hey! There seems to be something inside!

zh: 啊！是火龍‧‧‧但它好像在沈睡呢
en: Ah! It's the fire dragon... But it seems to be
asleep!

zh: ‧‧‧該如何讓它醒來呢？
en: ...How do we wake it?

zh: 你一定就是沈皓吧！
en: You must be Shen Hao!

zh: 是的。我需要你帶我到不凍泉。
en: Yes. I need you to take me to the Ice-Free
Spring.

zh: 一切果真如預言一般！那些妖魔怕我
帶你去不凍泉，就把我囚禁了數百年
！沒想到你還是找到我了！來吧，也
是讓我活動一下筋骨的時候了！
en: All is as the prophecy said! The demons
feared I'd take you to the spring, so they
imprisoned me for centuries! Yet you found
me! Come, it's time I stretched my wings!

zh: 哇！爪子上竟封有妖怪！
en: Whoa! Monsters are sealed in its claws!

zh: 總算全解決了！
en: That's all of them at last!

zh: 啊！真舒服！
en: Ah! That feels good!

zh: 可是我們還沒找齊七顆摩尼珠！
en: But we haven't found all seven Mani Jewels
yet!

zh: 是啊！爺爺說，我們所缺的宝珠是在
en: Right! Grandfather said the jewels we lack
are...

zh: 紫色摩尼珠在清江城
en: The Purple Jewel in Qingjiang City.

zh: 綠色摩尼珠在水城
en: The Green Jewel in Water City.

zh: 藍色摩尼珠在神池
en: The Blue Jewel at the Sacred Pool.

zh: 白色摩尼珠在青銅峽
en: The White Jewel in Bronze Gorge.

zh: 黃色摩尼珠在鉄辺城
en: The Yellow Jewel in Tiebian Castle.

zh: 紅色摩尼珠在白崖
en: The Red Jewel at White Cliff.

zh: 來吧！夥伴們，咱們出發吧！
en: Come on, friends, let's go!

zh: 洪元通，你在幹什麼？
en: Hong Yuantong, what are you doing?

zh: 咖！咖！七顆宝珠終於還是到我手裏
了！你們這群笨蛋，我是闇冥之王的
愛將－地魔，為了這摩尼珠，才迫不
得已跟你們在一起！
en: Heh! Heh! The seven jewels are mine at last!
You fools, I am Earth Demon, favored
general of the King of Darkness! I only
stayed with you to get these jewels!

zh: 咖！咖！你不知道的事情還多著呢！
‧‧‧你以為你父親為什麼會死呢！
en: Heh! Heh! There's a lot you don't know!...
Why do you think your father died?

zh: 難道？難道是你？！
en: Could it be? Could it be you?!

zh: 咖！咖！到現在你才知道，誰叫你父
親那麼礙事！沈皓，命中註定，你是
魔王的人，不要再反抗了！今晚就是
你登基的日子！我現在就回托克托去
en: Heh! Heh! Only now you see! Your father
was in the way! Shen Hao, you belong to the
Demon King. Stop resisting! Tonight is your
coronation! I return to Tuoketuo

zh: 迎接魔王，你有種就來找我討回宝珠
吧！
en: to greet the Demon King. If you've got the
guts, come get your jewels back!

zh: 沒想到‧‧‧
en: I never thought...

zh: 現在我們該怎麼辦呢？
en: What do we do now?

zh: 已經沒有退路了。只有前往魔城決一
死戰了！
en: There's no turning back. All we can do is go
to the demon castle and fight to the death!

zh: 可是宝珠‧‧‧
en: But the jewels...

zh: 除此之外，我們還有別條路走嗎？
en: Do we have any other choice?

zh: 往前衝吧！這將是一場最後的搏鬥！
en: Charge ahead! This will be the final battle!

zh: 恭喜你，終於清除掉體内邪惡的因子
。‧‧‧但是，今天你雖然扭轉了命
運，但若不除去魔王，明天還是會有
第二個沈皓，第三個沈皓‧‧‧
en: Well done, you've cleansed the evil within
you... But though you changed your fate,
unless the Demon King falls there'll be a
second Shen Hao tomorrow, a third...

zh: 我明白，我會去面對那最後之戰的！
為了不再重複發生的悲劇，我一定會
去的‧‧‧
en: I understand. I'll face the final battle! So
this tragedy never happens again, I'll go...

zh: 魔王的巢穴就在托克托城的地底，牠
已經準備出動了，一切小心。今晚，
就是今晚‧‧‧
en: The Demon King's lair is beneath Tuoketuo.
He's ready to strike. Be careful. Tonight,
it's tonight...

zh: 我們準備出發了嗎？
en: Are we ready to go?

zh: 是的！
en: Yes!

zh: 太棒了！沈皓，我們終於成功了！
en: Wonderful! Shen Hao, we did it at last!
Yes!... Ah!... What?!...

zh: 怎麼了？！沈皓？你怎麼？
en: What's wrong?! Shen Hao? What's happening?

zh: 精靈！你不是說不凍泉可以清洗掉他
體内的邪惡因子嗎？！
en: Spirit! Didn't you say the Ice-Free Spring
could wash the evil out of him?!

zh: 是啊，但是很奇怪，在他心裏的某一
個角落，似乎有一股負面的力量，‧
‧‧對不起，我也無能為力‧‧‧
en: Yes, but strangely, in some corner of his
heart there seems to be a dark force... I'm
sorry, there's nothing I can do...

zh: 那我們該怎麼辦呢？
en: Then what do we do?

zh: 已經沒有時間了，魔城將在今晚現世
！當今之計，只有除掉魔王，沒有別
的辦法了！
en: There's no time. The demon castle appears
tonight! There's only one way now: destroy
the Demon King!

zh: 是的！如果今日不除去魔王，那明日
即是世界浩劫的開始了‧‧‧唉！魔
王的巢穴就在托克托的地底。牠已經
準備出動了。就是今晚了。
en: Yes! If the Demon King isn't destroyed
today, tomorrow the world's ruin begins...
Sigh! His lair is beneath Tuoketuo. He's
ready to strike. It's tonight.

zh: 現在我們該怎麼辦呢？
en: What do we do now?

zh: 已經沒有退路了，只有前往魔城決一
死戰了！
en: There's no turning back. All we can do is go
to the demon castle and fight to the death!

zh: 可是‧‧‧
en: But...

zh: 除此之外，我們還有別條路走嗎？
en: Do we have any other choice?

zh: 七顆宝珠沒找齊，還是找齊後再來吧
en: We don't have all seven jewels. Let's come
back once we do!

zh: 洪元通！我今天要為我父親報仇！
en: Hong Yuantong! Today I avenge my father!

zh: 可以，憑本事吧！
en: Go ahead, if you can!

zh: 沈皓！命中註定，你是魔王的人！何
苦一再反抗，不聽勸言呢？
en: Shen Hao! It's destiny, you belong to the
Demon King! Why keep resisting and ignoring
good advice?

zh: 咖！咖！我乃闇冥之王的愛將『地魔
』是也；奉大王之命除掉所有欲圖阻
礙之人，並恭迎您前來登基統領天下
en: Heh! Heh! I am Earth Demon, general of the
King of Darkness! By his order I remove all
who stand in the way, and welcome you to
your coronation...

zh: 所有的人....難道..我爹也是....
en: All who... Could it be... my father too...

zh: 統領群魔征服天下者，何必顧慮這些
en: Heh! Heh! Heh!... Heh! Heh!... One who will
lead the demons to conquer the world
needn't worry about such trifles!...

zh: 洪元通，你納命來！！....
en: Hong Yuantong, prepare to die!!...
What?! Could it be...

zh: 歡迎光臨！我是總機小姐小葉。
en: Welcome! I'm Xiaoye, the receptionist.

zh: 我們這兒是，現代化中文電視遊戲軟
體的研發中心單位——敦煌科技。也
是國產電視遊戲機 A'can的催生者。
en: This is Funtech, a development center for
modern Chinese video game software, and
the creator of Taiwan's own console, the
A'Can.

zh: 請隨意參觀，但請不要喧嘩。
en: Please look around, but keep your voice
down.

zh: 你需要醫療服務嗎？
要　　不要
en: Do you need medical care?
You are...

zh: 歡迎你們到訪，我們這兒是戰略模擬
遊戲——『恐龍戰記』的研發組。
en: Welcome! This is the team behind the
strategy game "Super Dragon Force".

zh: 有什麼事嗎？
敦煌科技
平台
軟體　　　　　　　　　　離開
en: What is it?
{>13}Funtech
{>13}The console
{>12}Software{>168}Leave

zh: 敦煌科技是國内大企業投資成立。自
４、５年前整合國内所有知名遊戲軟
體業者研訂平台規格起，經由多位傑
出工程師，歷經２年有餘的研發，從
en: Funtech was founded by big Taiwanese
investors. Years ago it gathered local game
makers to set a console spec. After 2+
years of work, from

zh: IC 基礎元件到奚統整合，終於在
1994年初完成國人第一部電視遊樂器
平台。緊接著完成此平台的軟體研發
工具——『發展奚統』，並結合國内
en: chips to system integration, Taiwan's first
console was finished in early 1994. Next
came its dev tools, the "Development
System", and work with local

zh: 、外軟體業者進行各式遊戲軟體之研
發，又經過１年多的開發才完成第一
波的軟體，搭配硬體奚統呈現給國人
en: and foreign developers on all kinds of
games. After over a year more, the first
wave of software was ready to launch with
the hardware.

zh: 敦煌科技與軟體夥伴，投入了極多心
血於此平台，除了這一夠水平的主機
功能外，敦煌於所有業者們，繼續以
慎重嚴謹的態度，秉持品質、品質、
en: Funtech and its partners poured their
hearts into this console. Beyond its capable
hardware, we'll keep working carefully,
holding to quality, quality,

zh: 還是品質的信念，以高水準之軟體呈
獻給大家，保證國内平台之成功。
en: and more quality, bringing you top-notch
software to make our console a success.

zh: 軟體產業欲茁壯，需要有可發揮的舞
台，除了 PC 外，國内業者到目前為
